title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in United Arab Emirates.   This is a senior-level quality engineering role focused on protecting the reliability, correctness, and scalability of critical payment flows.  You’ll combine exploratory testing with an automation-first approach across APIs, distributed services, and external financial integrations.  The role offers ownership of end-to-end quality, from test strategy and automation through production debugging and release readiness.  You’ll work closely with backend engineers and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and strengthen quality gates.  The environment is modern and cloud-based, with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, React, PHP, AWS, and Playwright at its core.  You’ll have the opportunity to influence engineering standards while working on a high-impact fintech platform used for global payments and financial operations.  This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable, reliable testing practices.  Accountabilities    Own end-to-end quality for critical payment journeys, including deposits, payouts, reconciliation, and other business-critical transaction scenarios.  Design and execute API-first test strategies covering REST, JSON, HTTP, and complex transaction lifecycles.  Build, maintain, and improve automated API and selective UI test suites using Playwright, RestAssured, or comparable frameworks.  Develop reusable automation components such as API clients, test data builders, and supporting utilities.  Test integrations with external providers, including payment processors and Open Banking services, with particular attention to asynchronous callbacks, polling, retries, and failure scenarios.  Investigate production incidents, reproduce defects, analyze logs, database records, and API traces, and contribute to root-cause analysis.  Collaborate with backend engineers to improve system testability and work with product teams to establish clear acceptance criteria.  Contribute to release quality gates, regression testing strategies, smoke tests, and pre-release validation within CI/CD pipelines.  Identify risks across distributed payment systems and proactively strengthen testing coverage, reliability, and engineering quality standards.  Explore AI-assisted QA and automation techniques where they can improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.     Requirements     Proven experience in QA engineering, test automation, or a closely related software quality role, with strong ownership of complex systems.  Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP, JSON, request/response validation, and API-driven workflows.  Strong understanding of backend systems, distributed services, and software integration patterns.  Practical experience with test automation

title: Quality Engineering – Automation (Playwright & GenAI)
description: Position Description  We are looking for a Quality Engineering – Automation professional with strong hands-on experience in modern test automation. This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring four days per week onsite at our/client's office in downtown Toronto.  The ideal candidate will have practical experience developing and enhancing automation frameworks using Playwright. Execute smoke, functional, regression, integration, system, UAT, end-to-end, and cross-browser testing.   Collaborate with developers, product owners, business analysts, and other Quality Engineering professionals in an Agile environment; analyze defects, document test results, contribute to quality metrics and release-readiness activities, and follow coding standards, automation best practices, and quality engineering principles.     Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role   Must-have:     3–5+ years of hands-on Quality Engineering / test automation experience.   Strong recent hands-on experience with Playwright automation.   Demonstrated ability to develop, enhance, and maintain Playwright automation frameworks, rather than only execute existing automated tests.   Experience using TypeScript/JavaScript for Playwright automation.   Strong understanding of automation framework concepts, including POM, fixtures, reusable components, data-driven testing, and test reporting.   Practical experience using AI/GenAI for Quality Engineering, particularly for creating test cases, test scenarios, automation scripts, or improving test coverage.   Experience with GenAI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar technologies.   API testing experience with REST APIs and tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or Karate.

Suunnittelet ja toteutat API-testausta sekä rakennat ja kehität testauksen integraatioita osaksi CI/CD-putkia.  Tuet projektitiimiä laadukkaiden, ylläpidettävien ja käyttäjälähtöisten ratkaisujen rakentamisessa. Toimit asiakkaan luotettavana kumppanina ja autat löytämään toimivia testaus- ja laadunvarmistuskäytäntöjä, jotka sopivat asiakkaan tarpeisiin ja ympäristöön. Roolin tarkemmat painotukset ja vastuun laajuus tarkentuvat kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Keskustelemme kanssasi roolin tarkemmista painotuksista ja vastuun laajuudesta kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Riippuen roolin kokonaisuudesta, kiinteä kuukausipalkkasi sijoittuu tyypillisesti 4700–5700 euron välille.      Mitä toivomme sinulta?     Useamman vuoden työkokemusta testauksesta ja testiautomaatiokehityksestä sekä kokemusta laadunvarmistuksen tekemisestä osana ohjelmisto

title: Sr. Test Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Test Engineer based in France.   This is a senior QA opportunity focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of applications in Agile and Scrum environments.  You’ll take ownership of comprehensive testing activities, from test case creation and execution through defect management and validation.  The role combines functional, integration, and regression testing with close collaboration across engineering and business teams.  You’ll help translate functional and technical requirements into effective testing strategies and actionable quality standards.  The position also offers the opportunity to improve testing processes and identify areas where automation can increase efficiency and coverage.  You’ll work independently while contributing to multiple Scrum teams and supporting complex technology initiatives.  This is a strong fit for a detail-oriented QA professional who enjoys solving problems and continuously improving software quality.   Accountabilities     Perform integration, regression, and functional testing to ensure applications meet business, technical, and system requirements.  Create, review, maintain, and execute comprehensive test cases for new and modified systems.  Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into effective testing scenarios and quality criteria.  Identify, document, track, and manage defects through resolution while ensuring appropriate validation and follow-up.  Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders and Scrum teams within Agile delivery environments.  Support multiple teams and complex assignments while maintaining consistent quality and testing standards.  Apply established software engineering disciplines, change-control standards, and testing procedures throughout the development lifecycle.  Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to maintaining engineering and quality standards.  Provide insights and recommendations to improve testing processes, coverage, efficiency, and overall product quality.  Identify opportunities for test automation and contribute to approaches that support Test Driven Development where appropriate.  Work independently while adapting to evolving technologies, methodologies, and testing approaches.  Use analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate issues, reconcile results, and identify root causes.     Requirements     5+ years of experience working in Scrum and Agile environments.  Extensive experience across the full software testing lifecycle, including test case development, test execution, defect management, and validation.  Strong experience performing functional, integration, and regression testing.  Advanced analytical, quantitative, deductive reasoning, reconciliation, and problem-solving capabilities.  Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy

title: Test Automation Engineer
description: Vill du ta din erfarenhet inom testautomation till nästa nivå och vara med och kvalitetssäkra framtidens fordon? DXC/Luxoft söker nu, tillsammans med Oddwork, en Test Automation Engineer som vill bli en del av deras växande team i Sverige.      Om DXC/Luxoft   DXC Luxoft är ett globalt mjukvaru- och teknikbolag som levererar lösningar inom bland annat automotive, finans och digital transformation. Inom Automotive samarbetar de med några av världens ledande fordonstillverkare och leverantörer och är särskilt kända för sin expertis inom avancerad mjukvaruutveckling. Verksamheten i Sverige fortsätter att växa och här får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett internationellt team som utvecklar och kvalitetssäkrar nästa generations system för en fordonsindustri där uppkopplade, autonoma och elektrifierade fordon står i centrum.      Om rollen   Som Test Automation Engineer kommer du att spela en viktig roll i utvecklingen och kvalitetssäkringen av komplexa embedded- och infotainmentsystem inom automotive. Du kommer att utveckla, underhålla och köra automatiserade tester med Python och PyTest samt arbeta med funktionella tester, enhetstester och regressionstester.  En central del av rollen är att integrera automatiserade testsviter i CI/CD-pipelines och säkerställa smidiga testkörningar, uppföljning och rapportering. Du arbetar i Linux-miljö och använder verktyg som Git, Gerrit och Jenkins för versionshantering, code reviews och automatiserade processer.  Du kommer även att arbeta med kommunikationsprotokoll inom automotive, såsom CAN och Ethernet, samt verktyg som CANoe, CANalyzer och CAPL för simulering och analys. Tillsammans med utvecklingsteam som arbetar inom områden som Android Automotive OS bidrar du till att säkerställa hög kvalitet och stabilitet genom hela produktens utvecklingscykel.  Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar där du identifierar och löser problem, utvecklar teststrategier och kontinuerligt förbättrar automatiserade testramverk för att öka testtäckning, effektivitet och den övergripande produktkvaliteten. title: Sr. Test Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Test Engineer based in Austria.   This is a senior QA opportunity focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of applications in Agile and Scrum environments.  You’ll take ownership of comprehensive testing activities, from test case creation and execution through defect management and validation.  The role combines functional, integration, and regression testing with close collaboration across engineering and business teams.  You’ll help translate functional and technical requirements into effective testing strategies and actionable quality standards.  The position also offers the opportunity to improve testing processes and identify areas where automation can increase efficiency and coverage.  You’ll work independently while contributing to multiple Scrum teams and supporting complex technology initiatives.  This is a strong fit for a detail-oriented QA professional who enjoys solving problems and continuously improving software quality. Create, review, maintain, and execute comprehensive test cases for new and modified systems.  Analyze functional and technical requirements and translate them into effective testing scenarios and quality criteria.  Identify, document, track, and manage defects through resolution while ensuring appropriate validation and follow-up.  Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders and Scrum teams within Agile delivery environments.  Support multiple teams and complex assignments while maintaining consistent quality and testing standards.  Apply established software engineering disciplines, change-control standards, and testing procedures throughout the development lifecycle.  Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to maintaining engineering and quality standards.  Provide insights and recommendations to improve testing processes, coverage, efficiency, and overall product quality.  Identify opportunities for test automation and contribute to approaches that support Test Driven Development where appropriate.  Work independently while adapting to evolving technologies, methodologies, and testing approaches.  Use analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate issues, reconcile results, and identify root causes.     Requirements     5+ years of experience working in Scrum and Agile environments.  Extensive experience across the full software testing lifecycle, including test case development, test execution, defect management, and validation.  Strong experience performing functional, integration, and regression testing.  Advanced analytical, quantitative, deductive reasoning, reconciliation, and problem-solving capabilities.  Strong attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy

title: QA Manager
description: 토스인컴을 소개해요     토스인컴은 금융이 시작되는 시점인 ‘소득’과 관련된 서비스를 제공하기 위해 토스커뮤니티의 새로운 계열사로 가장 최근에 출범했어요.  토스인컴은 특히 세무 영역에 집중하고 있어요. 세무는 고객이 매일 써야 하는 금융 서비스는 아니지만 금융 생활에서 반드시 마주치게 되는 영역인 만큼, 개인이 스스로 해결하기 어려운 세무 영역의 불편함을 해소하기 위해 노력해요.  토스가 모든 사람들이 보다 쉽고 편리한 금융 생활을 할 수 있도록 혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여 온 것처럼, 토스인컴은 ‘숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 전달하고 있어요.  토스커뮤니티의 가장 신생 계열사인만큼, 초기 멤버가 되어 함께 팀을 꾸려갈 수 있어요.       합류하면 함께할 업무예요     맡게 될 제품/도메인의 품질을 전담하여, 기획 단계부터 릴리즈까지 전 과정에 참여해요.  PO, 디자이너, 개발자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 제품 설계 단계부터 품질 이슈를 사전에 발견하고 해결 방향을 제시해요.  신규 기능과 개선 사항에 대한 테스트 전략 수립, 테스트 케이스 설계, 검증 수행, 회귀 테스트까지 전 과정을 책임져요.  서비스 특성과 팀의 개발/배포 문화에 맞는 QA 프로세스와 체크리스트를 설계·개선하고, 팀에 품질 문화를 정착시켜요.  필요하다면 자동화 테스트와 QA용 내부 툴 도입/개선 등을 통해, 더 효율적이고 재사용 가능한 테스트 구조를 만들어가요.  세무/운영/CS팀과 함께 실제 현장에서 발생하는 이슈를 분석하고, 근본 원인을 제품/프로세스 차원에서 해결하는 데 관여해요.       이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요     복잡한 구조의 제품 QA를 기획부터 릴리즈까지 A-Z 전 과정에 참여해 성공적으로 출시해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.  제품 팀과 협업하며 여러 프로젝트의 일정과 테스트 커버리지를 효율적으로 관리해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.  배포 주기가 빠르거나 변경이 잦은 환경에서, 제품 특성에 맞는 QA 프로세스를 구축하고 개선한 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.        이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요     QA로서 본인이 기여하고 집중한 부분과 성과(또는 실패 이후의 개선 사례)를 알고 싶어요.  빠른 개발/배포 사이클 속에서 QA를 수행해보신 경험이 있다면 작성해 주세요.  다양한 기술 스택을 활용 했다면, 해당 기술을 실제 QA에 어떻게 활용했는지 작성해 주세요.  포트폴리오를 같이 제출하시는 경우 현/전 직장의 대외비(테스트 케이스)는 첨부하지 말아주세요.       토스인컴으로의 합류 여정     서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우협의 > 최종합격  직무 인터뷰 전형에는 '라이브 과제'가 함께 진행됩니다. 약 50분 동안 화상 인터뷰 툴을 이용하여 수행하시게 됩니다.        함께할 동료를 위한 한마디     “토스인컴 서비스의 신뢰를 보증한다.”  토스인컴의 QA는 단순히 버그를 찾는 역할을 넘어, 사용자가 안심하고 세무/소득 서비스를 이용할 수 있는 ‘신뢰’ 자체를 설계해요.  “원래 이렇게 테스트해왔으니까”에 머무르지 않고, 새로운 방식의 테스트, 자동화, 툴 도입 등을 자유롭게 제안하고 시도할 수 있어요.  돈과 세금이라는 도메인 특성상 작은 실수도 크게 느껴질 수 있기 때문에, 토스인컴에서 QA의 역할과 임팩트는 더욱 크게 드러나요.  토스인컴에서 품질과 신뢰에 대한 새로운 기준을 함께 만들어갈 분을 기다리고 있어요.      📢 소득 그리고 세금 환급과 관련된 모든 불합리함과 불편함을 해소해 나갑니다. >혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여온 토스처럼, '숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 도전하고 싶으신가요? >누구나 손쉽게 앱 하나로 세무 문제를 해결하는 미래를 상상해보세요. >초기 멤버로 팀의 성장과 혁신의 중심이 되고싶다면, ‘토스인컴’에 지원해보세요. >토스의 가장 신생 계열사인 토스인컴의 초기멤버로 합류하실 수 있는 기회를 놓치지 마세요. ########토스인컴을 소개해요 - 토스인컴은 금융이 시작되는 시점인 ‘소득’과 관련된 서비스를 제공하기 위해 토스커뮤니티의 새로운 계열사로 가장 최근에 출범했어요. - 토스인컴은 특히 세무 영역에 집중하고 있어요. 세무는 고객이 매일 써야 하는 금융 서비스는 아니지만 금융 생활에서 반드시 마주치게 되는 영역인 만큼, 개인이 스스로 해결하기 어려운 세무 영역의 불편함을 해소하기 위해 노력해요. - 토스가 모든 사람들이 보다 쉽고 편리한 금융 생활을 할 수 있도록 혁신적인 금융 서비스를 선보여 온 것처럼, 토스인컴은 ‘숨은 환급액 찾기'와 같은 서비스를 통해 새로운 가치를 전달하고 있어요. - 토스커뮤니티의 가장 신생 계열사인만큼, 초기 멤버가 되어 함께 팀을 꾸려갈 수 있어요. 합류하면 함께할 업무예요 - 맡게 될 제품/도메인의 품질을 전담하여, 기획 단계부터 릴리즈까지 전 과정에 참여해요. - PO, 디자이너, 개발자와 긴밀히 협업하며, 제품 설계 단계부터 품질 이슈를 사전에 발견하고 해결 방향을 제시해요. - 신규 기능과 개선 사항에 대한 테스트 전략 수립, 테스트 케이스 설계, 검증 수행, 회귀 테스트까지 전 과정을 책임져요. - 서비스 특성과 팀의 개발/배포 문화에 맞는 QA 프로세스와 체크리스트를 설계·개선하고, 팀에 품질 문화를 정착시켜요. - 필요하다면 자동화 테스트와 QA용 내부 툴 도입/개선 등을 통해, 더 효율적이고 재사용 가능한 테스트 구조를 만들어가요. - 세무/운영/CS팀과 함께 실제 현장에서 발생하는 이슈를 분석하고, 근본 원인을 제품/프로세스 차원에서 해결하는 데 관여해요. 이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요 - QA 관련 경험이 7년 이상이신 분이면 좋아요. - 제품 단위를 넘어 조직 전체의 QA 프로세스를 설계하고 운영해보신 분이 필요해요. - 복잡한 구조의 제품 QA를 기획부터 릴리즈까지 A-Z 전 과정에 참여해 성공적으로 출시해본 경험이 있으신 분이면 좋아요. - 배포 주기가 빠르거나 변경이 잦은 환경에서, 제품 특성에 맞는 QA

title: [EnIT] IT Architect - Application Architect
description: 📃 누구나 마음 속에 이력서 한 장은 있으니까,  ⚡ 1분 컷 지원으로 현대오토에버로의 여정을 시작하세요. (이력서 자율양식)   ✅ IT Architect - Application Architect   🚀  합류하실 팀을 소개해요     기준정보시스템팀은 완성차 생산을 위한 CORE 정보인 BOM/Master Data/생기정보 등 기준정보를 관리하는 시스템을 개발/운영하는 팀입니다. 우리 팀은    기준정보의 무결성을 통해 완성차 전사시스템의 안정성 확보   IT 핵심역량을 보유한 최고의 전문가   긍정적/능동적인 마음가짐으로 행복한 직장생활 추구    라는 3대 목표를 가지고, 일과 삶에서 최선을 다해 행복을 추구하고자 노력하는 팀입니다!!  팀 내 운영 시스템은 RDBMS/X-FRAMEWORK 기반에 마이플랫폼으로 구현되어있으나, 현재 오픈소스기반 차세대 플랫폼을 준비하고 있어 팀 내 신기술 역량향상을 기대하고 있습니다.  💻  합류하시면 함께 할 업무예요     애플리케이션 설계 및 아키텍처 정의  API 아키텍처 설계  성능, 확장성, 보안을 고려한 설계  개발팀과 협력하여 기술 문제 해결  코드 리뷰 및 기술 표준 수립     🔍 이런 분과 함께 하고 싶어요     Java/Spring 기반 10년 이상 개발 경력  시스템 아키텍처 설계 경험 3회 이상  최근 2년 이내 본인이 직접 설계·구현한 프로덕션 코드 실적 보유    (PL/Architect 역할 수행 중에도 핵심 모듈 직접 구현 및 프로젝트 전 기간 상시 코드 리뷰·페어 프로그래밍 수행 필수)    코드 리뷰 문화를 직접 운영/정착시켜 본 경험  배치, 연동(ERP/MES/PLM 등 외부 시스템), API 설계 및 개발 경험  성능, 확장성, 장애 대응을 고려한 비기능 요구사항(NFR) 설계 경험  SOA 혹은 MSA 기반의 시스템 구축 경험    #시스템 구조 분석/설계 방법론 #아키텍처 이해 #아키텍처 구현/관리   🔍 이런 분이라면 더욱 좋아요     대용량 BOM 데이터(트리 구조, 버전 관리, 이력 추적) 처리를 고려한 DB/트랜잭션 설계 경험  Full stack 개발자  Oracle / MySql 기반의 DB 운영 경험     ⌛ 이렇게 합류해요     서류 접수 → 서류 검토 → 직무역량테스트(과제테스트) 및 인성검사 → 1차면접 → 2차면접     → 처우협의 및 채용검진 → 최종 합격🎉  ※ 상기 직무역량테스트 外 추가 역량평가가 진행될 수 있으며, 해당 결과는 종합적인 역량 검토를 위한 참고자료로 활용됩니다.    📍 만나게 될 근무지는 여기예요     서울 강남     📣 동료의 한 마디     안녕하세요, 기준정보시스템팀 A책임입니다! 우리 팀은 활발한 커뮤니케이션과 수평적 문화가 특징이에요. 팀원 개인 의견을 서로 존중하며 편안한 분위기 속에 개인의 역량이 최대로 발휘하여 개인과 조직의 성장을 함께 하고 있어요. 또한 업무에 필요한 역량 교육을 권장하는 문화 및 제도가 잘 마련되어 이를 업무에도 적극 활용하여 정체되지 않고 성장할 수 있답니다. 가끔은 팀원들과 같이 인근 산책 및 티타임을 하면서 좀 더 자유로운 의견 교류와 함께 서로에게 힘이 되어주고 격려하고 있어요. 우리 팀과 함께 하고 싶은 분들은 언제나 환영이니 많이 지원해 주세요 :)  (팀 리더) 기준정보시스템팀은 밝고 긍정적인 에너지로 채워진 기술/업무 전문가들로 구성되어 있으며, 많은 경력의 선배들이 후배들의 기술/업무 역량 향상을 위해 적극적으로 지원하는 팀입니다. 팀 내 주요 업무인 BOM/MDM/생기 정보는 완성차 근간에 CORE로 사용되는 정보로써 완성차 연구소/생산/판매등 다양한 부문과 인터페이스되며 전반적인 업무 경험을 할 수 있습니다. 우리 팀에 합류한다면 기술개발 뿐만 아니라, 완성차 기준정보 전문가로 발전하여 각 영역에서 활약하는 리더로서 성장 가능합니다.    📌  참고해 주세요     채용 시 마감되는 상시 채용 공고로 운영되며, 채용 절차와 일정은 변동될 수 있어요.  사회적 배려 대상자(보훈 취업지원대상자, 장애인)는 관계 법령과 내규에 따라 우대해요.  모집 분야 및 담당 업무에 따라 영어 구술평가, 레퍼런스 체크, 또는 기타 전형이 실시될 수 있어요.  지원자의 경험과 역량을 고려하여 다른 포지션이 더 적합하다고 판단되는 경우 지원 분야가 변경될 수 있어요.  배치 부서 및 근무지는 회사 사정에 따라 변경될 수 있어요.  아래의 경우, 합격이 취소되거나 전형 진행에서 불이익을 받으실 수 있어요.  지원서가 사실과 다르거나 증빙이 불가할 경우  해외여행 결격 사유가 있는 경우 (남성의 경우, 회사가 지정한 입사일까지 병역 필 또는 면제 필요)  최종 합격 후 회사가 지정하는 입사일에 입사 불가한 경우

title: QA Lead with Spanish (Madrid)
description: About the role:      We are looking for an experienced QA leader with deep testing expertise and the credibility to lead the QA function effectively in a complex project environment. You understand QA best practices, manage client expectations confidently, and provide strong people leadership. You are able to build trust with clients and colleagues, develop team capabilities, and establish a high-performing and scalable QA organisation.  You will:   Lead the QA function within the project environment, ensuring a strong, credible, and effective quality organisation.  Define and drive the QA strategy, test approach, governance, and quality standards across the project lifecycle.  Act as the main QA counterpart for clients, managing expectations, building trust, and providing clear quality leadership.  Lead, mentor, and develop QA team members, helping raise capability, confidence, and overall team maturity.  Build strong collaboration across business, delivery, and technical teams to embed quality throughout the delivery process.  Oversee test planning, execution, defect management, reporting, and quality risk management.  Ensure the QA area is not only operationally effective, but also seen as a trusted and value-adding function by both client and internal stakeholders.  Support UAT and coordinate with client stakeholders where needed, while maintaining ownership of the broader QA direction. title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About The Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.  That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:  you own the release gate.  If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.  That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks  like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.  You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.  Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.  What You'll Own     The release gate: One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.    API test automation: Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.    End-to-end front-end automation: Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.    AI-driven test generation and maintenance: Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point. title: Client Retention Specialist
description:
At Beyond Finance, we've made it our mission to help everyday Americans escape the endless cycle of crippling debt and step into a brighter financial future. Through compassionate, individualized care, a culture focused on compliance and ethics, supportive user-centric technology, and customized financial solutions, we've helped over 1 million clients on their path to a brighter future.

While we're proud of what we've already accomplished, we're searching for new collaborators to help us get to the next level! If you're looking to join a forward-thinking, rapidly growing organization with helping people as its number one goal, we want to hear from you.

About The Role

Our Customer Success Team serves as the primary point of contact for valued customers enrolled in Beyond Finance’s financial hardship programs. Our Retention Specialists play a critical role in ensuring the continued loyalty of our Beyond customer base. As a Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility will be to educate and assist clients who are facing financial hardship and exploring options to become debt-free. You will play a crucial role in retaining clients within the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program. In this position, you will interact with clients primarily through inbound phone calls and be responsible for deescalating upset clients, empathizing with their financial difficulties, and helping them navigate the Beyond Finance program. Their primary focus is on our at-risk customers who are struggling with the use and/or value of their enrolled program, requiring creative problem solving to help them better realize and understand the value of their decision.

  • Educate Clients: Provide comprehensive information about the Beyond Finance financial hardship debt program to clients, ensuring they have a clear understanding of the benefits, process, and available options.
  • Empathize and Deescalate: Display empathy and active listening skills to understand and deescalate upset clients, addressing their concerns and alleviating their stress regarding their financial situation.
  • Navigate CRM System: Effectively use our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system to quickly access and comprehend client information, including their current financial status and program progress. Maintain accurate and detailed records of all client interactions and program progress in the CRM system.
  • Analyze Financial Situation: Assess the client's current financial situation and determine the most appropriate options to help them achieve their goal of becoming debt-free.
  • Retain Clients: Collaborate with clients to develop customized solutions that align with their financial goals, and encourage them to remain in the Beyond Finance program.

Shaping the data architecture. title: Junior QA Engineer (m/f/x)
description:
We are Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. the leading fertility and family-building benefits provider in the US.

Our shared mission? To make fertility and family-forming care accessible everywhere, breaking down barriers so that anyone can start a family, no matter where they are. With Progyny’s support, we're set to amplify our impact globally, reaching more individuals and families than ever before.

Come and join us for a diverse and inclusive workplace and use “Tech for Good”!

As a Junior QA Engineer, you’ll support software quality through both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with Product Managers, Frontend and Backend Engineers, Designers, and other QA colleagues to test new implementations and improve our testing processes.

Our product includes different systems and integrations working together, so curiosity, communication, and a willingness to learn are important. You won’t be expected to know everything from day one, but we’re looking for someone who can gradually take more ownership as they learn the product and our processes.

Tasks

  • Manually test new features, bug fixes, and existing product flows.
  • Create and execute clear test cases.
  • Write and maintain automated tests using Playwright.
  • Report, track, and retest bugs using Jira.
  • Review user stories and raise questions when requirements are unclear.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Product Managers throughout the testing process.
  • Support test automation within our GitHub Actions workflows.
  • Learn how different product areas and third-party integrations work together.
  • Explore how AI tools can support testing, documentation, and automation.

Requirements

  • Some practical experience with manual software testing, through work, an internship, training, or personal projects

The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.

About Us

We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity.

Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next.

The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve.

Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost.

Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

title: iOS Engineer - Design System

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp.   • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

 

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each

Tegelijkertijd wordt er veel samengewerkt en vinden collega's het belangrijk om elkaar te helpen. Je wordt vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Samen met developers bespreek je requirements en bepaal je welke scenario's getest moeten worden. Your Primary Responsibilities      Take professional ownership of quality and testing in complex credit solutions   Plan, design, and execute tests – both manual and automated   Create and maintain test cases, test scenarios, and test strategies   Ensure test coverage of both functional and non‑functional requirements   Identify risks early and contribute to solutions before issues reach production   Work closely with developers, Product Owners, and Business Analysts on quality and defect handling   Provide a clear, consolidated overview of test status for reporting purposes and to support teams   Ensure compliance with QA requirements and standards   Share knowledge and act as a professional sparring partner for other QA Engineers       To succeed you will have:       Solid experience in testing and quality assurance within complex system landscapes, with the ability to work comfortably on solutions involving many integrations and dependencies.  Hands-on experience working in agile development teams (Scrum/Kanban), including test strategies, defect management, reporting, and quality assurance across teams and releases.  A strong technical understanding of modern development and operations environments, with confidence working in setups involving CI/CD, automation, integrations, and monitoring.  Ideally, experience or an understanding of several of the following tools and technologies (or similar):Test and QA tools such as Jira/Xray and JQL   Databases and testing of data and integrations (SQL and Postman)   CI/CD, build pipelines, and code quality tools (e.g. Jenkins and SonarQube)   Containers and platforms (e.g. Docker and Kubernetes)   Logging and observability (e.g. Elastic dashboards)   Event‑driven and integration‑based architectures (e.g. Kafka)   A proactive and responsible mindset, taking ownership of driving testing and quality forward. You thrive on picking up tasks and needs as they arise and actively contribute to creating overview and momentum

title: Senior IREG & Network Test Engineer
description: The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo.   Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it.  Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started.  At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible.  When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places.   This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works    This role is based in Espoo, Finland, one of Skylo's core engineering hubs and fastest-growing sites. You'll work onsite three days a week as part of a team that's scaling quickly. You will collaborate with a high-velocity, global team spanning multiple time zones.     About The Role   Every Mobile Network Operator (MNO) onboarding timeline ends at a critical technical test gate. We are hiring an automation-oriented Senior IREG & Network Test Engineer to own that gate—from initial attach and authentication through SGd, MAP, SMS, IP NIDD, and roaming sign-off. You will replace manual, partner-dependent execution with a repeatable test strategy, a scalable testing environment, and an automated regression pipeline.   Responsibilities     Develop Test Strategy: Define the comprehensive IREG test strategy, pass/fail metrics, network tracing protocols, and official sign-off processes for each partner MNO.  Execute Roaming Validation: Run end-to-end roaming testing across network registration, attach sequences, S6a/S6d authentication, SGd SMS-over-NAS, and IP/NIDD data paths.  Optimize for NTN: Execute the standard GSMA-defined Roaming test suite while ideating and introducing custom validation test cases built specifically for NTN (Non-Terrestrial Networks).  Build Automation Harnesses: Build and maintain an automation test harness and lab capable of running core GSMA and Skylo-specific routing scenarios consistently.  Trace Analysis: Analyze Diameter/SS7 traces along with device and network logs to cleanly isolate configuration issues across Skylo, IPX, and MNO domains.  Defect Management: Turn production and onboarding failures into repeatable regression test cases,

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (편의 기능)
description: About The Team & Mission   Quality Assurance Engineer (편의 기능)는 SDV 아키텍처 전환 환경에서 차량 바디/편의 소프트웨어의 통합 기능·성능 검증을 수행하며, 제어기 간 연동을 포함한 시스템 완성도를 확보합니다. 도어, HVAC, 시트 등 주요 편의 장치와 제어 소프트웨어 간 상호작용을 통합 관점에서 검증하고, 시나리오 기반 테스트 설계 및 자동화 체계를 구축하여 검증 효율성과 정확성을 향상시킵니다. 또한 Linux/RTOS 기반 환경과 차량 네트워크를 이해하고, 로그 데이터 분석 및 CI/CD 기반 검증 프로세스를 통해 양산 전·후 품질 지표를 관리하며 지속적인 품질 개선과 내재화를 리딩합니다.   Responsibilities     검증 계획 수립   SDV 통합 소프트웨어 QA 엔지니어는 새로운 설계(zonal architecture 등)와 동작 방식에 기반한 통합 소프트웨어 검증 계획을 수립합니다.   검증 설계   테스트 케이스 설계와 테스트 환경/조건을 설계하고, 단일 소프트웨어가 아닌 통합 검증 관점에서 검증 수행을 준비합니다.   검증 수행   주요 마일스톤(릴리스나 게이트 등)의 품질 목표 달성을 위한 검증을 실행합니다.   소프트웨어 통합 검증 외에 제어기와 연동되는 테스트 벤치 조건 및 실차 환경에서 검증을 수행할 수 있습니다.   검증 자동화   자동화 도구를 개발 또는 적용하여 통합 검증 활동을 효율화합니다.   결과 분석   검증 결과를 문서화하고 분석 내용을 구조화합니다.  필요에 따라 분석 내용에 대한 대시보드를 구성하여 시각화할 수 있습니다.   프로세스 구축 및 개선   통합 소프트웨어 검증의 효율성과 정확성을 높일 수 있는 프로세스와 절차를 정의하고 개선합니다.     Qualifications     7년 이상 자동차 소프트웨어 기능/성능 평가 업무 경험을 보유하신 분  Linux와 RTOS와 같은 운영체제에 대한 이해가 높으신 분  자동차 네트워크 평가 툴(CANoe, CANape 등) 사용 경험이 있으신 분  자동차 평가 로그 데이터 분석 경험이 있으신 분  Agile 프로세스와 CI/CD 환경에서 검증 활동을 진행한 경험이 있으신 분  최신 기술에 관심이 많고 변화에 유연하게 대처할 수 있는 역량을 보유하신 분     Preferred Qualifications     임베디드 개발환경에서의 프로그래밍 언어(C/C++, Python, Rust 등)에 대한 높은 이해도  클라우드 환경(AWS, Azure 등)에서의 소프트웨어 품질 관리 업무 경험  제어기 또는 차량 평가 자동화 구축 경험 (HIL, SIL 등)  A-SPICE 또는 ISO 26262 적용 경험  Cloud service(fleet management 등)와 실차간 연동 경험  LLM을 이용한 검증 업무 자동화 진행 경험

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description: At AROA, our people come to work every day with passion and ideas that fuel our business and go home knowing they have made a real difference in the lives of others.     AROA, which is Maori for ‘understanding’, is proudly New Zealand born and based. We develop, manufacture, and export innovative wound care products, improving the lives of millions around the world by unlocking extraordinary outcomes for our patients. Our mission is to be the global leader in regenerative healing, making our products and services accessible to everybody.      About the role:   We’re looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer  to join our Quality team. In this critical role, you’ll provide technical quality oversight across validation, equipment qualification, risk management, and continuous improvement activities ensuring our systems, products, and processes meet the highest standards of compliance and safety. Other key responsibilities include:   Provide quality oversight and approval of validation activities and documentation.  Actively engage with production floor processes, equipment, and personnel to ensure quality standards are upheld throughout design transfer and manufacturing.  Collaborate with cross-functional teams and effectively support multiple projects, balancing priorities to meet deadlines.  Serve as a point of contact for QA technical issues, drive root cause analysis, and communicate quality concerns to cross-functional teams.  Contribute to AROA’s continuous improvement efforts by identifying areas for improvement in product quality and safety       What you'll bring:     Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, or equivalent.  3+ years’ experience in Quality Assurance within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industry.  Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and cGMP.  Working knowledge of ISO 13485 and 21 CFR Part 820.  Hands-on experience with process validation.  Strong technical writing skills, with experience reviewing documentation for compliance and clarity.  Experience with or interest in computer system/software validation is desirable.       What we offer:   At AROA NZ, we value our people and make sure working with us is rewarding, both professionally and personally. Here’s what you can enjoy as part of our team:    Health & Wellbeing  – Free on-site gym and fitness classes, plus an annual paid health and wellbeing allowance.   Birthday Leave  – A paid day off to celebrate your special day!   Convenient Location  – Free carparking onsite at our Airport Oaks sites with easy motorway access.   Sustainable Travel Support  – Fareshare public transport subsidy, WorkRide program, onsite bike shed, and electric bike charging stations.   Family-Friendly Benefits  – Generous parental leave entitlements to support you and your loved ones.   Social & Team Culture  – Join a social club and enjoy team events and activities in a supportive, inclusive workplace.   GROW

title: Senior QA Engineer – API Testing

With over 14 years of experience and a multicultural team of more than 100 professionals, we deliver projects for highly complex industries such as pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, healthcare, and consumer goods.  At our company, we value international talent, diversity, flexibility, and a collaborative environment that fosters both professional growth and personal well-being.   About The Role   At Nuvolar, we are looking for a  Senior QA Engineer  to join one of our  healthcare projects , working on digital health solutions that support complex workflows and critical software platforms.  You will become part of a technical team responsible for ensuring the quality of a platform that manages sensitive healthcare information, integrations, and services within a complex digital health ecosystem.This role is a great opportunity for a QA Engineer who enjoys understanding  complex products, defining quality strategies, designing meaningful test scenarios , and collaborating closely with developers and product teams to deliver reliable software.  As the first QA Engineer joining this product team, you'll have the opportunity to shape how quality is built into the product from the early stages. Rather than joining an established QA function within the team, you'll define testing strategies, introduce best practices, and help embed quality throughout the development lifecycle while working closely with developers and product stakeholders.   🧠  What You’ll Do     Define and execute the QA strategy  for backend services, APIs, integrations, and critical product workflows.  Understand the product domain and translate business requirements into effective test scenarios.   Design, maintain, and execute test plans  covering functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, exploratory testing, and edge cases.  Perform backend and API testing using tools such as Postman and OpenAPI/Swagger specifications.  Validate REST APIs, data consistency, error handling, authentication flows, and integration scenarios.  Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL to validate data integrity and support testing activities.  Contribute to test automation initiatives by maintaining and improving automated test suites.  Analyse logs, traces, and system behaviour using monitoring and observability tools.  Collaborate closely with developers, Product Owners, and technical stakeholders to identify risks early and ensure release readiness.   Drive continuous improvement of QA practices  and help establish quality standards within the team.     ✅  What We’re Looking For    Proven experience as a QA Engineer working on software products, backend services, REST APIs, or integration-heavy platforms. title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description: Department:  AssetOps Engineering   Employment Type:  Permanent   Location:  Madrid   Description    About the role   Assets Ops is part of the osapiens HUB platform's Efficiency suite, helping enterprise customers manage maintenance, facilities, and operational workflows at scale. As a Senior Quality Engineer embedded in the Assets Ops team, you will own the quality strategy end-to-end — from defining testing approaches to shipping and maintaining automation frameworks that keep the product stable and reliable for thousands of users.  You'll work side by side with developers, product managers, and business stakeholders to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle, not just at the end of it. That means fast feedback loops, meaningful test coverage, and a clear-eyed view of product health at all times.  You will be working in a hybrid work setup, with a collaborative and international team. You'll join a fast-growing company at the intersection of AI, compliance, and enterprise software — where the quality of what you ship genuinely matters to the customers relying on it.   What You'll Do    Quality strategy & ownership     Define, implement, and continuously improve testing strategies in close alignment with the product and engineering teams.  Serve as the team's subject matter expert on QA processes, tooling, and best practices — raising the bar for the whole squad.  Maintain clear, accurate, and actionable test documentation and reporting for both developers and business stakeholders.     Hands-on testing     Test newly implemented features using a diverse range of testing techniques, with a focus on uncovering gaps early.  Perform exploratory testing to proactively identify regressions and edge cases before they reach production.  Provide fast, reliable feedback on product health and stability to developers and stakeholders throughout each sprint.     Automation & tooling     Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites covering E2E and API testing for both web and mobile applications.  Perform root cause analysis on failing automated tests and drive their resolution.  Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous quality gates are in place (Azure DevOps preferred).  Contribute to AI-assisted development efforts and explore how emerging tooling can improve the team's quality workflows.     Collaboration & communication     Report bugs clearly and follow up on their resolution, monitoring the bug backlog to keep it actionable.  Support developers in investigating and reproducing issues, acting as a trusted partner rather than a gatekeeper.    Your Responsibilities    Test the products applying diverse testing techniques to uncover bugs  Report bugs and follow up their resolution  Develop new and maintain the existing automated end-to-end and API tests  Contribute in the AI assisted development efforts and tooling  Setup and maintain CI/CD pipelines  Perform root cause analysis of failing automated test

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description: About the role   We're looking for a Product Quality Owner to take ownership of a question nobody at Zendr owns today: what we validate before we ship, in what order, and why. As we roll out the next generation of our B2B freight platform through late 2026 - shipping continuously behind feature flags - you'll build and defend the risk model of our product, decide where validation effort goes, and stand behind every release decision with real evidence rather than gut feel or a completed checklist.     This is a strategy and ownership role with hands-on validation at its core. It's deliberately not a test-execution role, a QA engineering role, or a team lead role - our development teams own automated unit and integration testing, written and maintained with modern AI tooling. Your time goes to the judgment work automation can't do: risk thinking, release readiness, and deep exploratory and regression testing of the flows that matter most.  You'll work closely with the Head of Product and the Head of Engineering in a fast-moving environment where pragmatism, collaboration and craft matter more than buzzwords. Your recommendation is what every release decision is based on, so this role comes with real mandate - and the accountability that goes with it. This is a role for someone who reasons analytically about risk and generates structure in ambiguity - not someone who waits to be told what to test.      Key responsibilities    Own and maintain the product's risk model - what can break, what it costs the customer, and where validation effort should go  Own release readiness: your recommendation is the basis for every release decision - you define what "ready" means per release and back each ship-or-hold call with documented evidence  Drive bug refinement on a regular cadence and keep the backlog honest and prioritised against real customer and business impact  Inventory, risk-triage and validate features shipped behind feature flags before they roll out to customer segments  Run exploratory testing of new functionality and regression on critical flows - carrier integrations, rates, labels and the messy real-world edge cases of a logistics product  Drive the regression automation you need through the development teams rather than building it all yourself  Bring risk thinking into product discovery, acceptance criteria and definition of done, before development starts       About you   You came up through testing and have since moved well beyond manual test execution into analytical, risk-based quality work, with genuine product sense. You reason about risk, impact and probability, and you can justify what deserves testing effort and what doesn't. You're comfortable owning decisions, setting your own testing agenda, and turning ambiguity into structure. You communicate clearly - making risk tangible for both technical and non-technical people - and you build trust across product and engineering as a force multiplier, never a bottleneck. title: Chief Architect
description: CatalystOne is building the next generation of HCM products for the Nordic and Northern European market. Our platform is built by 15 product teams across Scandinavia and India, and we are scaling on several fronts at once: product complexity, AI adoption, platform modernisation, and the integration work that follows growth.     Each of those is manageable on its own. Together, they need a single architectural owner who can see the whole picture and set the direction. That is why we are hiring a Chief Architect.      As a Chief Architect in CatalystOne, some of your day-to-day tasks will be:    Owning and evolving the overall product architecture and target state across our HCM platform, including platform direction, domain boundaries, integration patterns and long-term modernisation priorities.  Owning, maintaining and evolving our architectural north star, balancing long-term sustainability with near-term delivery needs.  Curating our Technology Radar, providing transparency and guidance on technology choices.  Taking ownership of our architecture toolset (principles, patterns, reference architectures, ADR practices and decision records) that gives product teams practical guardrails and decision support as they move toward the target architecture.  Enabling autonomous, agile teams by setting constraints that increase flow, predictability and compliance.  Stepping in where local choices carry system-wide consequences, such as shared platform services, data ownership, identity, security, AI infrastructure or the integration of acquired systems.  Acting as a strategic partner for the product trios, collaborating closely with Product and Engineering leadership.  Supporting architectural decision-making across teams by enabling fast, well-documented decisions close to where the work happens, and by building architectural capacity within the teams themselves.  Representing architectural perspectives in strategic discussions within the CTO leadership group and Executive Management Team.       What this role focuses on:   You own the long-term, product-wide architecture. Implementation stays with the teams, and your job is to give them the tools and guardrails that make their decisions easier and safer.     In practice, that means working across 15 small teams of four to six people, each with a PM, a UX designer and a Tech Lead. You'll spend your time with the Tech Leads on technology choices and trade-offs, and just as much with the Product Owners, because what we build matters a great deal for how it should be built. You lead through principles, clarity and trust rather than approval queues.     AI is changing how our software is built and operated, and you help us adopt it in ways that make us more effective without loosening our grip on quality, security and compliance. title: Senior Solution Architect (m/f/d)
description: Über Atos/Eviden    Eviden ist ein Unternehmen der Atos-Gruppe mit einem Jahresumsatz von rund 5 Mrd. Euro und weltweit führend bei der datengesteuerten, vertrauenswürdigen und nachhaltigen digitalen Transformation. Als international führender Player in den Bereichen Digital, Cloud, Data, Advanced Computing und Digital Security verfügen die 55.000 Eviden Expertinnen und Experten über tiefgehende Expertise für alle Branchen in mehr als 47 Ländern.  Eviden Austria entwickelt unter anderem innovative, hochverfügbare, sicherheitskritische Systeme im Bereich kritischer Infrastruktur wie z.B Bahn, aber auch Energieversorgung und dem öffentlichen Sektor.  Gestalten wir gemeinsam leistungsfähige, nachhaltige und zukunftssichere digitale Plattformen! Design und Umsetzung von Sicherheitskonzepten (Security by Design)  Analyse und Transformation von 3GPP- und ETSI-Standards sowie Kundenanforderungen in umsetzbare technische Spezifikationen für Software-Entwicklungsteams  Technische Leitung, Coaching und Mentoring von Software-Engineering-Teams entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycle  Bereitschaft und Willen, Umsetzungsherausforderungen gemeinsam mit dem Entwicklungsteam zu lösen (Hands-on Mentalität)  Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Produkt Management und internationalen Entwicklungsteams über alle Projektphasen hinweg  Repräsentation des Unternehmens in Standardisierungs- und Industrie-Gremien      Dein Profil      Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik, Nachrichtentechnik oder Telekommunikation  Fundierte Kenntnisse von 3GPP- und ETSI-Telekommunikationsstandards, MCx sowie FRMCS Knowhow als Plus  Senior System / Software Architekt mit mehrjähriger Hands-on Erfahrung in komplexen Carrier Grade Telekommunikationssystemen über alle Projekphasen hinweg unter Einsatz von State-of-the-Art Technologien und Werkzeugen.  Mehrjähriger Arbeitshintergrund als Senior Entwickler in OOO-Sprachen wie C++, Java, Go sowie CI und DevOps  Offen für neue Technologien wie AI basierte Entwicklung  Sehr gute Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Tetra, GSM, GSM-R, 4G/5G-Netzen, PSTN und Telco-Infrastrukturen, Cloud Umgebungen, Netzwerkinfrastukturen, Hypervisor  Gute Kenntnisse gängiger Netzwerkprotokolle (SIP, VoIP, MCx, TCP/UDP IP, NTP, SNMP, RTP/RTCP, RTSP), STUN.  Starkes Bewusstsein und Kenntnisse von Security Themen (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, AAA, Firewalls, IPSec, OVPN, KMS, CRA/NIS-2) sowie Lizenzthemen / SBOM  Domain-Know-how im Bereich Bahn /

title: Test Engineer

As a Test Engineer, you’ll be responsible for running tests and verifications across the full hardware product portfolio, identifying issues and ensuring top-tier performance before release. Preparation of formal test specifications and the set-up of test plans in cooperation with product developers.   Execution and automation of tests  Issue reporting, including route cause analysis and follow-up as part of the development process.   Ownership of the entire testing lifecycle, responsibility for reporting to Project and Product Managers, tracking of test performance against KPIs and responsible for ensuring defects are found early. Improving the AutoStore product range from A to Z through acquiring system-wide knowledge, including from a customer perspective. Excellent communication skills in Norwegian and English, written and oral.   Collaborative and communicative problem solver: Strong communication skills, enjoys working with others, takes initiative, and remains focused and patient when tackling complex issues.  Curious, structured, and growth-oriented: A creative thinker with a willingness to learn, who approaches tasks with accuracy and a structured mindset. Stakeholder Intelligence is a unit within Rambøll, with SaaS products including SurveyXact, PeopleXact and Heart&Mind. These products help organizations across the Nordics and Europe understand and improve the lives of the people who matter most to them, whether customers, patients, citizens, employees or children. For some, that means listening to stakeholders and turning their feedback into insight they can act on. For others, it means giving managers what they need to improve the working lives of their teams, or supporting practitioners in daycare and schools in their work on quality and children's development.  We work with sensitive data, and keeping it safe shapes how we build: we primarily run models on our own GPU servers, on-prem. We're expanding our SaaS portfolio with AI-driven value creation, and we're looking for a senior engineer to help us do it responsibly and at scale.   Where you fit in   We're early in our AI journey. We have a mature software organization (50 developers and designers) with deep strength in traditional software engineering, and a Platform Engineering team that builds the shared platform our product teams build and run on. But ML and LLM work is new to us, and our practices for evaluating, testing and operating these systems are still forming. We've recently begun building a dedicated AI Engineering function; it's still small, and much of its work happens alongside Platform Engineering.  AI Engineering at Stakeholder Intelligence is a shared craft. Our AI Engineers are talented but early in their careers. Each is primarily attached to a product team and works closely with that team, while spending a significant portion of their time on shared methods and tooling across products. As our senior engineer, you'll spend even more of your time working broadly across products, and your job is to shape that craft.  You won't own product direction; that stays with the product teams and their Tech Leads. What you'll shape is how we do ML/LLM engineering: the methods, standards and practices for how we develop, test, evaluate, deploy and operate the AI parts of our products. You'll provide direction, bring proven experience, and represent AI engineering in cross-functional discussions with Product Managers, Tech Leads and other senior voices.  This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role with real influence, scoped to the experience you bring.   What You'll Do      Define our evaluation practice: how we determine whether one model, prompt or system genuinely outperforms another, drawing on methods such as golden datasets, deterministic checks, reference-based metrics, LLM-as-a-judge and human evaluation. This is central to the role.  Es

title: AI SPECIALIST
description: WE'RE HIRING: AI SPECIALIST   📍 Abha, Saudi Arabia · On-site · Full-time     Since 2019, we've been building PVP from Abha: 10,000+ custom PC builds sold, 90,000+ registered users.     AI at PVP isn't a tool we're experimenting with; it's an employee working in every department:     • Customer Service: an AI agent closes 60–70% of conversations with zero human intervention at 88–92% customer satisfaction. Satisfaction went up, not down.  • Marketing: 80% of our published content is fully AI-generated; our standard: if you can tell it's AI, it failed.  • Sales: a catalog that rearranges itself for every customer, one personalized version per customer.  • Finance & Operations: a full ERP and an accounting agent built entirely in-house, replacing systems that used to cost us tens of thousands a year.     We got here without a single full-time AI hire.  The problem? Every system runs on its own, and no one owns the whole file.  That's why this seat exists.      WHAT YOU'LL OWN:   1. Improve what's running: the agents and systems working today raise the quality of their output  2. Build the new: automation for any department that needs it, from idea to production  3. Chase the models: every new release test it, measure it, and deploy it if it wins  4. Automate the repetitive: anything recurring goes automatic with clear, justified human checkpoints  5. Unify the foundation: bring our scattered projects onto one base that runs in a closed loop      THE SKILLS WE NEED:   • Advanced prompt engineering: system instructions that produce consistent, dependable output, not casual Q&A  • Loops & scheduled automation: build a loop that starts from an event or a schedule, then plans, executes, verifies, delivers, and repeats on its own  • Automation tooling: n8n / Make or plain code. What matters is work you can show us running  • AI-powered building & shipping: turn an idea into a deployed tool or app using platforms like Replit and similar  • You keep up with the field because it changes every single week  • You communicate clearly in Arabic and English      WHAT WE DON'T CARE ABOUT:   Your major, GPA, years of experience, or certificates. This entire field is two years old; show us your work.      GROUND RULES BEFORE YOU APPLY:    •  This job is open to Saudi nationals only.  • Work is on-site at our Abha office. Priority goes to Abha residents, and the interview is in person  • The job description is flexible: it will change and evolve as models evolve and as the business needs. If you want fixed boundaries, this role isn't for you  • We're expanding: anything under the PVP umbrella, current or future stores and ventures, in our sector or others, you should be ready to take it on  • Apply with your work, not your CV: send links to things you've built with your own hands  • After the interview comes a practical challenge drawn from our real work, and it's the judge. description: Motiveres du av kontinuerlig forbedrings- og kvalitetsarbeid?  Vi ser etter en kvalitetsrådgiver som har god forståelse for helhetlig administrativ styring og som motiveres av kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid. Du evner å arbeide systematisk og strukturert, og har kapasitet til å følge opp prosesser over tid med fokus på framdrift og kvalitet. Stillingen inngår i klinikkens stab og rapporterer til klinikksjef. I rollen vil du være en viktig støtte for klinikksjef, avdelingssjefer og ledergruppen. Derfor søker vi deg som er trygg i samarbeid med ledere og bidrar med faglige råd innen administrative styringsprosesser, kvalitets- og forbedringsarbeid. Du har evne til å se sammenhenger, identifisere forbedringsområder og omsette behov til praktiske løsninger. Videre er du fleksibel og serviceorientert, og kan lede eller bistå med prosess- og prosjektstøtte ved behov. Høy grad av selvstendighet og gjennomføringsevne er viktig i stillingen.  St. Olavs hospital er universitetssykehuset i Midt-Norge og kombinerer pasientbehandling, forskning, utdanning og innovasjon. Sykehuset er de siste årene kåret til Norges mest innovative sykehus. Kvinneklinikken er blant landets ledende fagmiljø innen kvinnehelse, fødselshjelp, gynekologi, fertilitetsbehandling og fostermedisin. Med rundt 340 årsverk, et budsjett på ca 650 millioner kroner og lokal-, regional- og nasjonale funksjoner, tilbyr vi høyspesialiserte tjenester til pasienter i hele Midt-Norge. Klinikken samarbeider tett med det medisinske fakultet ved NTNU.  Kvalifikasjoner    Relevant høyere utdanning fortrinnsvis på mastergradsnivå, f.eks innenfor samfunnsvitenskapelige emner, ledelse logistikk, samfunnssikkerhet og beredskap etc. Kandidater med bachelorgrad og tilstrekkelig relevant erfaring kan også blir vurdert.  Erfaring med internkontroll/kvalitetsarbeid  Kompetanse innen kvalitetsstyring  Kompetanse innenfor ledelse av prosjekt- og prosessarbeid  Erfaring med internkommunikasjon  God digital kompetanse og systemforståelse    Personlige egenskaper    Strukturert og systematisk  Fleksibel og serviceorientert  Jobber selvstendig og målrettet, og har god gjennomføringsevne  Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter, både muntlig og skriftlig  God på samhandling, og jobber godt i team  Analytisk med godt helhetlig blikk og god strategisk forståelse  Personlig egnethet vektlegges    Vi benytter oss av personlighetskartlegging som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess for å sikre at vi finner den beste kandidaten.  Vi tilbyr    En sentral rolle i utviklingen av klinikkens arbeid med kvalitet, forbedring, HMS og internkontroll  Mulighet til å påvirke og videreutvikle arbeidsprosesser, styringssystemer og organisasjonsutvikling  Varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver i skjæringspunktet mellom fag, ledelse og administrasjon  Tett samarbeid med ledere og fagmiljøer på alle nivåer i organisasjonen  Deltakelse i spennende utviklings-, prosjekt- og forbedringsarbeid  Mulighet til å bidra til bedre tjenester gjennom

title: Quality Manager
description: Job Summary   The  Quality Manager  is responsible for developing, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving the organization’s healthcare quality and patient safety systems. The role ensures compliance with applicable  healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, clinical policies, quality indicators, patient safety requirements, and internal procedures . The Quality Manager works closely with clinical and non-clinical departments to identify risks, monitor performance, conduct audits, investigate incidents, implement corrective and preventive actions, and promote a culture of continuous quality improvement. Should be familiar with  DHA requirements  as well as relevant international accreditation standards. DHA maintains healthcare standards, inspection checklists, performance measures, and regulatory requirements for licensed facilities.  Key Responsibilities     Quality Management System  Develop, implement, and maintain the healthcare facility’s Quality Management System (QMS).  Develop annual quality and patient safety plans aligned with organizational objectives.  Establish quality objectives, indicators, targets, and improvement priorities.  Maintain quality policies, procedures, guidelines, forms, and controlled documents.  Ensure effective document control and version management.  Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement across all departments.   Patient Safety & Risk Management  Lead patient safety initiatives and risk-reduction programs.  Monitor and analyze patient safety incidents, adverse events, near misses, medication errors, falls, complaints, and clinical risks.  Coordinate incident investigation and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).  Develop and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).  Conduct risk assessments and maintain risk registers.  Escalate serious incidents and high-risk findings to appropriate management.   Clinical & Quality Audits  Develop and execute annual clinical and operational audit plans.  Conduct medical record/documentation audits.  Monitor compliance with clinical policies, procedures, and approved guidelines.  Audit infection prevention and control, medication management, patient identification, consent, documentation, emergency preparedness, and other quality-sensitive processes.  Prepare audit reports and follow up on action plans.  Track closure and effectiveness of corrective actions.   Quality Indicators & Performance Monitoring  Develop and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and quality indicators.  Prepare monthly and quarterly quality dashboards.  Analyze trends, variances, and performance gaps.  Present quality performance to senior management and relevant committees.  Use data to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes.   Accreditation & Regulatory Compliance  Coordinate organizational readiness for DHA inspections and other regulatory assessments. title: Business Development Director
description:
Do you have the right sales skills to win new business for LanguageWire and at the same time contribute to our growth trajectory? Yes? You should definitely read on!

The role you’ll play 

The Business Development Director will be a key factor in our current growth. The ideal candidate will work across our ecosystem of technology and services to deliver high value solutions to enterprise clients. You will have a consultative mindset and be comfortable managing the large volume of inbound requests we receive as well as cold contacting new prospects up to C-Level stakeholders. 

You’ll be given the training, tools and solutions to target and approach prospective clients, highlight the value of our ecosystem and convert them from prospect to customer. 

The team you’ll be a part of 

You’ll have a crucial role in our LanguageWire Business Development Team for the DACH region and be a key driver of our business in your country. You will report to our Head of Business Development and be a member of his regional teams. You’ll interact with local colleagues in your branch office, but you will also work with colleagues across our value chain up to the C-Team. 

 

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by… 

  • Understanding and articulating LanguageWire’s services, capabilities, benefits and competitive advantages and knowing when to involve colleagues for best results 
  • Working across value chain to close inbound leads 
  • Creating leads by researching prospective clients through a mix of strategies 
  • Outreach & follow up prospects & new clients 
  • Representing LanguageWire at commercial events/trade fairs/thought leadership occasions 
  • Pipeline management & forecasting of revenues

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python/Django + Vue.js)
description:
Important: You must be based in Berlin for this role. We offer flexibility to work from home, but this is not a remote-from-anywhere position.

Hivebuy is a Berlin-based B2B procurement SaaS transforming how companies manage purchasing, approvals, orders, invoices, budgets and suppliers.

We’re building much more than a CRUD application. Our platform combines complex procurement workflows, multi-tenant architecture, ERP and accounting integrations, real-time functionality and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend focus to help us build and evolve this platform.

We’re looking for a T-shaped engineer: someone with deep backend expertise who is also comfortable following a feature across the entire stack. You don’t need to be equally strong in Django and Vue, but you should be willing and able to understand, change and ship both.

Our core stack includes Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Elasticsearch, Vue 3, TypeScript and AWS. We run our services on ECS Fargate, manage infrastructure with Terraform, and use Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry and CloudWatch to understand what’s happening in production.

AI coding agents are a normal part of how we develop software. We believe they make strong engineers significantly more effective, but they also make judgment, verification and ownership more important, not less.

Tasks

  • Own features end-to-end. Understand the problem, challenge requirements when necessary, design the solution, implement it, test it, deploy it and verify that it actually works in production.
  • Design and build backend services and APIs using Python, Django and Django REST Framework.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Elasticsearch to build reliable, scalable application and background-processing workflows

title: Clinical Implementation Manager  (m/f/d)
description:
Company Overview

Mindpeak is building cutting-edge AI technology to transform cancer diagnostics for the better. Our AI-powered software is already in clinical use across more than 25 countries, helping pathologists assess tumour tissue faster, more accurately, and more consistently. Every year, tens of thousands of cancer patients already benefit from quicker and more accurate diagnoses enabled by our technology.

Our mission is to scale this impact worldwide and help make personalised, effective cancer treatment accessible to every patient no matter where they are. By combining state-of-the-art AI with real-world clinical impact, we’re working toward a future where every cancer patient gets the best possible diagnosis and, ultimately, the best possible care.

Position Summary

Every new laboratory that implements our AI for routine diagnostics is a project with a lot of moving parts. The software is connected to the laboratory's image management and information systems, our AI is validated on their cases, pathologists are trained, and the requirements of their market and accreditors are met. Each of these projects brings together laboratory directors, pathologists and IT teams on the customer side, scanner and software partners, and our product, ML, engineering and quality teams internally.

As Clinical Implementation Manager you lead those projects. You own the plan, direct the specialists who do the technical work, and carry the go-live date. Once a laboratory is live you stay with them as their main contact, owning support and our long-term success with the partner. This is not a sales role and you do not carry a sales target.

Je schakelt dagelijks met leveranciers, supply chain, purchasing en productie om ervoor te zorgen dat producten, specificaties, labels en documentatie voldoen aan alle kwaliteitseisen binnen food & supplements. title: Lead Quality Engineer
description: Duetto's quality engineering function is being built from the ground up — and this is the role that defines what it becomes. As Lead Quality Engineer, you'll architect the test automation infrastructure, quality gate logic, and shared tooling that make high-quality testing the path of least resistance for every engineering team. You'll be operating in a system actively in transformation: a live monolith-to-microservices migration, a consolidation to Playwright, and a codebase where 50–70% of code is AI-generated at scale. If you're a senior quality engineer who leads with coaching rather than gatekeeping and thrives on building things that last, this is your role.   What Makes Us Different?   Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue & Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.   What You'll Be Doing    You'll architect quality gate logic within GitHub Actions CI pipelines — defining coverage thresholds, mutation score gates, contract test enforcement, flaky test quarantine rules, and automated result reporting — and build DataDog quality dashboards tracking test health, coverage trends, and flaky test rates across the engineering organisation.  You'll spearhead the migration from Selenium and Cypress to a consolidated Playwright framework — owning the shared configuration, CI sharding strategy, and page object library design — while driving PR pipeline test execution toward the P90 target of under 15 minutes through systematic flakiness reduction and pipeline optimisation.  You'll design and implement Pact contract testing for service boundaries created during the monolith-to-microservices extraction — managing the Pact broker, establishing consumer-driven contract testing as standard practice, and owning API contract testing across service boundaries.  You'll design and maintain Testcontainers configurations for MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, LocalStack, and RabbitMQ to support reliable, reproducible integration test environments across the engineering organisation.  You'll champion AI-augmented testing practices using Claude Code, CodeRabbit, and Augment — accelerating test generation, migration, and review at scale, and evaluating AI-generated test code for correctness, coverage gap

Strong multi-domain testing experience across hardware, software, mechanical, safety and/or system-level testing.  Hands-on understanding of advanced testing methodologies, including automation, AI-enabled and predictive testing, with strong use of test data for continuous improvement.  Experience with third-party/competitive product testing, certification and compliance testing.  Strong executive presence and ability to communicate technical risks and influence senior Engineering, Product, Quality and Supply Chain stakeholders.  Consumer electronics or complex engineered product experience is highly desirable.  Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline.
