title: Staff QA Engineer (EE Excellence)
description: 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      Staff QA Engineer - [EE Excellence / eCommerce Platform]    직무 요약:   이 포지션은 이커머스 플랫폼의 Staff QA Engineer 역할로서,  다중 도메인 테스트, End-to-End(E2E) 테스트를 포함하며, 통합된 도메인 전반에 테스트 자동화를 적용하고 Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment(CI/CD) 파이프라인과의 연계를 수행합니다.  또한 글로벌라이제이션, 국제화(Internationalization), 로컬라이제이션(Localization) 테스트 경험은 우대 사항입니다.      직무 소개:   이커머스 플랫폼의 Staff QA Engineer로서, 통합된 도메인의 품질을 보장하기 위해 종합적인 테스트 계획을 설계, 구현 및 실행하는 역할을 담당합니다.  엔지니어링, 프로덕트 매니지먼트, 디자인 등 다양한 조직과 긴밀하게 협업하여 테스트 요구사항을 정의하고 우선순위를 설정합니다.  테스트 방법론에 대한 전문성, 애자일 환경에서의 업무 경험, CI/CD 파이프라인에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 다양한 도메인에 걸쳐 매끄러운 쇼핑 경험을 제공하는 데 중요한 역할을 하게 됩니다.      주요 업무:    Design and Execute Test Plans - 이커머스 플랫폼의 모든 영역(프론트엔드, 백엔드, API 연동, 시스템 성능, E2E 테스트 포함)을 포괄하는 종합적인 테스트 계획을 수립하고 실행합니다.  Collaborate with Cross-functional Teams - 엔지니어링 팀과 긴밀히 협력하여 테스트 요구사항을 정의하고 테스트의 우선순위를 설정하며, 각 스프린트에 품질이 내재화될 수 있도록 보장합니다.  Test Automation - Selenium, Appium, TestNG 등의 도구를 활용하여 자동화 테스트 스크립트를 설계 및 구현함으로써 수작업 테스트를 줄이고, 다양한 도메인(예: 결제 게이트웨이, 배송 API, 재고 관리)의 테스트 커버리지를 확대합니다.  Manual Testing - 자동화 테스트에서 놓칠 수 있는 버그 및 결함을 식별하기 위해 이커머스 플랫폼에 대한 수동 테스트를 수행합니다.  Report Defects - 테스트 과정에서 발견된 결함을 문서화하고 보고하며, 개발자가 이슈를 재현할 수 있도록 명확한 재현 절차를 제공합니다.  Test Data Management - 여러 도메인에 걸친 이커머스 플랫폼 테스트에 적합하도록 테스트 데이터의 정확성, 최신성 및 적합성을 유지하며 관리합니다.  Quality Assurance - 모든 테스트 활동이 회사의 품질 기준 및 규제 요구사항에 부합하도록 보장합니다.  Integrate Test Automation with CI/CD Pipeline - 자동화 테스트를 CI/CD 파이프라인에 통합하여 고품질 소프트웨어 제품이 원활하게 배포될 수 있도록 합니다.  E2E Testing - 실제 사용자 시나리오를 기반으로 End-to-End(E2E) 테스트를 수행하여 로그인부터 결제까지 이커머스 플랫폼이 정상적으로 작동하는지 확인합니다.  Multiple Domain Testing - 결제 게이트웨이, 배송 API, 재고 관리 등 이커머스 플랫폼에 통합된 다양한 도메인을 테스트합니다.       자격 요건:    컴퓨터공학, 정보기술 또는 관련 분야 학사 학위 이상 (석사 또는 박사 우대)  QA 엔지니어링 분야에서 8년 이상의 경력, 이 중 이커머스 플랫폼에서의 경력 3년 이상  Selenium, Appium, TestNG 또는 Pytest와 같은 테스트 자동화 프레임워크에 대한 검증된 전문성  Agile, Scrum, Test-Driven Development(TDD)와 같은 테스트 방법론에 대한 높은 이해도  다양한 협업 조직과 원활하게 일할 수 있는 뛰어난 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 능력  Scrum 또는 Kanban과 같은 애자일 개발 방법론 환경에서의 업무 경험  주니어 QA 엔지니어를 관리 및 멘토링한 경험은 우대       우대 사항:    업무상 영어 또는 중국어 가능자  품질 엔지니어링 관련 자격증 (예: ISTQB)  클라우드 플랫폼(AWS, Azure, GCP), 컨테이너(Docker), 또는 마이크로서비스 아키텍처에 대한 경험  Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD 또는 CircleCI와 같은 DevOps 도구에 대한 이해 및 사용 경험  Globalization testing - 언어 번역 및 문화적 적응을 포함한 글로벌 이커머스 플랫폼 테스트에 대한 전문성  Internatio

title: Quality Manager
description: To lead and manage quality assurance across the Aftersales operation, ensuring that service, repair, warranty, and customer-handling processes consistently meet company and manufacturer/OEM standards. The role will focus on reducing repeat repairs, improving customer satisfaction, driving continuous improvement, and maintaining strong quality performance across the workshop and Aftersales functions.    Key Responsibilities     Develop and implement quality standards, procedures, and control processes for Aftersales operations.  Ensure all service and repair activities comply with manufacturer/OEM standards, technical procedures, and company policies.  Conduct regular quality audits and inspections across workshop, service, warranty, and related Aftersales operations.  Monitor vehicle repair quality and ensure vehicles are properly inspected before delivery to customers.  Identify quality issues, repeat repairs, technical defects, and process gaps and ensure timely corrective action.  Lead root-cause analysis using structured problem-solving methods and implement preventive measures.  Monitor customer complaints, feedback, CSI/NPS results, and quality-related concerns to identify improvement opportunities.  Work closely with Service, Technical, Parts, Warranty, and CRM teams to resolve quality issues.  Establish and monitor quality-related KPIs and provide regular performance reports to management.  Track repeat repair rates, first-time-fix performance, warranty issues, customer complaints, and service quality indicators.  Coordinate with OEM/Principal representatives regarding quality audits, technical concerns, campaigns, and corrective actions.  Ensure compliance with manufacturer audit requirements and prepare departments for periodic quality assessments.  Develop and maintain quality documentation, checklists, inspection reports, and standard operating procedures.  Conduct process reviews to identify inefficiencies and implement continuous improvement initiatives.  Monitor workshop housekeeping, safety, equipment condition, and adherence to required operating standards.  Train and coach Aftersales staff on quality standards, processes, customer satisfaction, and quality awareness.  Ensure lessons learned from quality issues are communicated across relevant teams to prevent recurrence.  Act as the escalation point for major quality-related customer complaints and operational issues.  Prepare management reports highlighting quality performance, trends, risks, and recommended corrective actions.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description: Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.   Din roll  Som Quality Assurance Manager har du ett övergripande och strategiskt ansvar för att leda, utveckla och stärka kvalitetsarbetet i vår organisation Business Unit (BU) Digital Battlespace Solutions (DBS) inom Business Area (BA) Surveillance. Du ansvarar för ett team av Project Quality Managers (på två olika orter) och driver utvecklingen av både människor, arbetssätt och strukturer inom kvalitet.  Rollen är i första hand strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, där ditt fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för ett effektivt och enhetligt kvalitetsarbete. Samtidigt förväntas du kunna gå in operativt vid behov, exempelvis i kritiska projektfaser eller vid särskilda kvalitetsutmaningar, kund, - eller interna revisioner.  Du spelar en nyckelroll i att säkerställa att kvalitetsarbetet möter högt ställda krav i en mjukvarutung och tekniskt avancerad miljö, där arbetssätt kontinuerligt anpassas och vidareutvecklas med stöd av agnostisk AI och LLM.  I ett nära samarbete med chef, projektkontor och andra funktioner är du en viktig drivkraft i att forma vår kvalitetsstrategi och säkerställa långsiktig efterlevnad, effektivitet och ständiga förbättringar.  Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:    Leda, coacha och utveckla ett team av Project/Product Quality Managers med fokus på kompetens, prestation och engagemang.  Säkerställa en kontinuerlig och hållbar bemanning av kvalitetsresurser i verksamhetens projekt genom nära samarbete med projektkontor och beställare.   Sätta riktning för och vidareutveckla vårt kvalitetsarbete, processer och metoder genom nära samarbete med andra kvalitetsfunktioner och stödfunktioner på BA och Group nivå.  Säkerställa efterlevnad av relevanta standarder, regelverk och interna krav som ställs på oss.  Driva förbättringsinitiativ med hjälp av AI och utveckla skalbara arbetssätt anpassade för en mjukvaruintensiv verksamhet och dess kundkrav.  Ansvara för övergripande revisioner, uppföljning och kvalitetsmätningar med regelbunden rapportering både på Business Unit (BU) och Business Area (BA) nivå, samt representera BUt i kvalitetsforum på BA nivå.  Fungera som ett strategiskt stöd till alla funktioner inom BUt i kvalitetsrelaterade frågor från tidigt offertarbete mot kund till domänspecifika frågor.  Vid behov gå in operativt för att säkerställa kvalitet i kritiska projekt leveranser.     Tjänsten är baserad i Solna. Resor inrikes och utrikes kan förekomma.  Din profil  För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en erfaren kvalitetsledare med tidigare personalansvar och med ett starkt driv att utveckla både organisationer och människor. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategiskt tänkande med ett nära och engagerat ledarskap.  Du har god förståelse för kvalitetsarbete i komplexa, gärna mjukvaruintensiva miljöer, och du är van att utveckla strukturer och processer som fungerar i praktiken.  So

You will have a dual mandate: ensure the stability and security of the platform while also building the necessary infrastructure for AI at scale. title: Werkstudent (all genders) – Robuste Feed-Forward-3D-Rekonstruktion für dynamische Szenen
description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Feed-Forward-Modelle zur 3D-Rekonstruktion können Szenengeometrie direkt aus Bildern oder Videos vorhersagen, ohne eine aufwendige szenenspezifische Optimierung zu benötigen. Durch die Kombination von großskaligem Pre-Training, Multi-View-Reasoning und starken geometrischen Priors stellen sie eine effiziente Alternative zu klassischen Rekonstruktionsverfahren wie Structure-from-Motion, NeRF und optimierungsbasiertem 3D Gaussian Splatting dar.

Trotz aktueller Fortschritte reagieren bestehende Modelle weiterhin empfindlich auf anspruchsvolle reale Bedingungen. Verdeckungen, bewegte Objekte, wechselnde Beleuchtung, Nachtaufnahmen, Reflexionen, Regen, Nebel und Schnee können zu unvollständiger Geometrie, unzuverlässigen Korrespondenzen und zeitlich inkonsistenten Vorhersagen führen. Eine höhere Robustheit unter solchen Bedingungen ist daher insbesondere für autonomes Fahren und robotische Wahrnehmung von großer Bedeutung.

Als Werkstudent*in unterstützt du die Entwicklung robuster Feed-Forward-Rekonstruktionsmodelle für dynamische Szenen. Du untersuchst Methoden zur Behandlung von Verdeckungen, Beleuchtungsänderungen und widrigen Wetterbedingungen. Darüber hinaus erforschst du, wie große Rekonstruktionsmodelle als universelle geometrische Backbones für nachgelagerte Aufgaben des 3D-Szenenverständnisses eingesetzt werden können, insbesondere für Semantic Occupancy Prediction und 4D Occupancy Forecasting.

  • Entwicklung und Evaluation von Feed-Forward-Modellen zur Rekonstruktion dynamischer 3D-Szenen aus monokularen oder Multi-View-Bildsequenzen.

Strategie und Beratung

  • Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit.

  • Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen.

As Platform and Integration Engineer at RedMimicry, you will connect our security-analysis services to real security telemetry and make them deployable in cloud, on-premises, and restricted customer environments.

You will work with SIEM, EDR, NDR, operating-system, and network exports; containerised services; GPU-backed workloads; and enterprise environments with strict security and data-residency requirements.

This is not a pure DevOps position. You must understand the structure and failure modes of security telemetry and build reliable interfaces between customer systems, our analysis services, and the existing RedMimicry platform.

  • Build Reproducible Test Environments: Maintain fixtures and environments for ingestion and regression testing.
  • Package and Operate the Services: Containerise our services and implement deployment automation, monitoring, logging, and health checks.
  • Support On-Premises and Restricted Environments: Develop reliable installation and upgrade processes for customer-operated environments.
  • Automate Validation and Recovery: Build environment checks, smoke tests, backup and restore workflows, and diagnostic tooling.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer, Security Log Intelligence
description:
We are building a new capability that turns fragmented, noisy security logs into explainable, AI-powered threat analysis, delivered inside the RedMimicry platform.

As Senior AI/ML Engineer at RedMimicry, you will lead the applied AI/ML work behind new analysis capabilities for our breach and attack emulation platform. The core challenge is extracting useful structure from heterogeneous, partially unstructured security telemetry and relating it to known attacker activity.

The problem is broader than prompt engineering. You will determine where LLMs, embeddings, retrieval, learned ranking, and deterministic heuristics are justified. The standard is measurable improvement against reproducible baselines, not architectural fashion. Everything you build must operate under realistic latency, reliability, and deployment constraints.

This is a fixed-term position running until 31 October 2027.

Tasks

  • Develop Security-Log Parsing Methods: Design and implement methods for extracting typed events from heterogeneous SIEM, EDR, NDR, operating-system, and network telemetry.
  • Design Embeddings and Retrieval: Select, evaluate, and tune representations and retrieval methods for security events.
  • Handle Ambiguity Explicitly: Implement confidence scoring, calibration, and controlled treatment of ambiguous evidence.
  • Ground Results in Evidence: Ensure that results are supported by traceable evidence from the original telemetry.
  • Build Rigorous Evaluations: Define datasets, baselines, ablations, and metrics, and analyse failure modes systematically.
  • Optimise Inference: Make the pipeline practical for cloud operation and on-premises deployment.
  • Productise the Research: Work with backend, integration, and offensive-security engineers to turn experimental methods into maintainable

title: Junior AI/ML Engineer, Data and Evaluation
description:
We are building a new capability that turns fragmented, noisy security logs into explainable, AI-powered threat analysis, delivered inside the RedMimicry platform.

As an AI/ML Engineer at RedMimicry, you will build the datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation infrastructure behind our applied AI/ML work on security telemetry.

The quality of this work depends on accurate ground truth, disciplined data handling, reproducible experiments, and systematic error analysis. Your work will determine whether reported improvements are real and whether regressions are caught before deployment.

You will work closely with the Senior AI/ML Engineer and Offensive Security Engineer. This role is suitable for an early-career or intermediate engineer with strong programming and data skills who wants to work on applied AI in a technically demanding cybersecurity environment.

This is a fixed-term position running until 31 October 2027.

Tasks

  • Curate Security Datasets: Prepare telemetry from controlled engagements and test environments.
  • Build Ground Truth: Create and maintain labelled examples, annotation guidelines, and consistency checks.
  • Maintain Evaluation Partitions: Separate training, validation, and test data along relevant dimensions.
  • Automate Benchmarks: Implement metrics and maintain reproducible benchmark and regression pipelines that run locally and in CI.
  • Run Experiments and Error Analysis: Evaluate models and methods, and identify recurring failure modes and data-quality issues.
  • Maintain Data Quality: Implement schema checks, provenance tracking, deduplication, validation, and dataset versioning.
  • Document Experiments: Produce clear experiment records, plots, tables, and technical summaries that support engineering decisions.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Security Analytics
description:
We are building a new capability that turns fragmented, noisy security logs into explainable, AI-powered threat analysis, delivered inside the RedMimicry platform.

As a Full Stack Engineer at RedMimicry, you will take a leading role in developing a new security analytics capability within our platform. You will build the user interface and the application layer that connects the underlying components into a reliable workflow for security analysts.

This is a fixed-term position running until 31 October 2027.

Tasks

  • Build Backend Services and APIs: Implement services and stable interfaces for ingestion, analysis, and reporting workflows.
  • Design Domain Models: Define maintainable data models for security events, analysis results, and supporting evidence.

  • Build Secure Multi-Tenant Components: Apply authentication, authorisation, tenant separation, and secure data-handling patterns.
  • Maintain Engineering Quality: Add tests, review code, document interfaces, monitor performance, and translate analyst feedback into concrete improvements.

Wer Non-Food-Ware aus Asien nach Europa bringt, gewinnt heute nicht mehr über den Einkaufspreis, sondern über Verlässlichkeit: geprüfte Lieferketten, belastbare Zertifizierungen, planbare Termine. Dafür suchen wir für Carstensen eine zweite starke Stimme im Finanzbereich: jemanden, der das Bankenreporting und den Konzernabschluss verlässlich trägt und daneben die Themen aufbaut, die bisher zu kurz gekommen sind — Kostenrechnung, Controlling-Systeme, Beteiligungscontrolling.

Its modular technology and in-house expertise enable customers to create tailored payment solutions that are flexible, scalable and secure.  As a regulated payments partner, Enfuce holds Electronic Money Institution licences from both the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority and the UK Financial Conduct Authority and is a principal member of Visa and Mastercard. Its PCI-DSS-certified, cloud-native platform is designed for enterprise-grade reliability and global scalability, with 99.999% platform uptime.  Enfuce has raised €73.5 million in funding and has received industry recognition including Fintech of the Year and Best ESG Campaign at the 2024 European Fintech Awards.       About The Role:    We're looking for a Senior Exploratory QE Engineer to strengthen how we find risk before our customers do. This is not a scripted test-case role. You'll use structured exploratory testing, charter-based sessions and deep product intuition to probe our card issuing and payment processing platform for the failure modes that automated suites and requirements documents miss: edge cases in transaction flows, race conditions, state corruption, security gaps and usability breakdowns. You'll work closely with automation engineers, developers and product owners, but your craft is distinct: you go where the tests don't, and you make the invisible risks visible.       What You'll Be Doing:    Design and run structured exploratory testing charters against new features, APIs and high-risk areas of the platform, guided by risk, not scripts.  Dig into complex payment and card lifecycle flows to uncover edge cases, state issues and integration gaps.  Partner with automation QE engineers to decide what should be automated, what needs a human eye, and feed exploratory findings back into the regression suite.  Perform risk-based test planning for releases, identifying the areas most likely to break and why.  Investigate production incidents and near-misses to find the underlying gaps in test coverage, then close them.  Champion a quality mindset across engineering, and raise the bar on what 'done' means.  Contribute to and evolve our exploratory testing practice: charters

title: Senior Software Engineer (Elixir)
description:
Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join our product teams and help build the next generation of workforce management. This isn't a traditional engineering role - at Sona, engineers are deeply embedded in the product development process, working directly with customers to understand their pain points and turning those insights into shipped solutions.

AI tooling is central to how we work. Coding agents produce the majority of our code, and your job is to direct, correct, and architect - not type every line yourself. You'll use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or similar as a core part of your daily workflow, and we'll assess that proficiency as part of the interview process. To do that well, you need strong Elixir expertise - enough to know when an agent's output is wrong and how to fix it.

Day to day, you'll work within a cross-functional product team with significant autonomy over how to reach outcomes. You'll participate in defining features and scope from PR FAQs and kick-off conversations rather than picking up fully specified tickets. You'll also have the opportunity to rotate across different product domains throughout the year - scheduling, payroll, HR, staff engagement - giving you breadth that most engineering roles don't offer.

This role is remote-first for anyone based in a European timezone, with quarterly in-person team alignment sessions and client workshops in London. It's not a fully isolated remote setup - you'll need flexibility to travel for the moments that matter.

Responsibilities

  • Own features end-to-end across Sona's platform, from scoping through to delivery, including in the mobile app

  • Use AI development tooling as your primary workflow - directing and evaluating agent-

title: Product Design Director - Doctors & Clinics (100% Remote-friendly, Spain)
description:
Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

title: Condition Monitoring Application Engineer
description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

What's the Opportunity

The primary function of the Condition Monitoring Application Engineer (CMAE) is to support the sales process by providing technical expertise and tribal knowledge to the sales team. As a CMAE you will be a main factor in engineering a solution for our customers with our offerings. This role works closely with sales, the condition monitoring team, and customers. You will:

  • Support solutions architects in the sales process as the subject matter expert in condition monitoring.
  • Establish credibility with customers to encourage higher opportunity-to-trial conversion rates.
  • Ensure high-quality asset lists to enable higher trial-to-subscription rates.
  • Assist in engineering a solution that best fits the needs of the customer.
  • Track the success of the asset review call and provide recommendations to enhance the same.
  • Track and suggest ways to improve the average monitoring point/trial.
  • Acquire extensive expertise in AssetWatch products, encompassing technical aspects, to effectively secure trials that incorporate a diverse range of AssetWatch offerings.
  • Analyze vibration and temperature data at client sites, customizing data processing to the client's asset and determining if maintenance is needed.
  • Attend tradeshows to assist the sales team with technical knowledge and lead capture.
  • Evaluate machinery health and condition through the detailed analysis of vibration data.
  • Expand AssetWatch's expertise in machine condition monitoring, beyond vibration analysis, to include other condition-monitoring technologies.
  • Work closely with the product development team to create high-value hardware and software solutions and expanded product offerings.
  • Provide high-quality, actionable information to clients (e.g., setting appropriate alarm levels with analytical tools, to alert customers of pending failures).

Qualifications

  • Strong communication skills and ability to discover pain points for the customer and drive towards a solution.
  • Valid Vibration Category II, MLA/MLT Certifications preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience with vibration data collection and analysis.
  • Strong mechanical background with industrial equipment — centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, hydraulics, pneumatics, etc.

title: Buyer
description:
The Finance team at Clover Health is a group of strategic partners providing financial and operational insights that drive informed decision-making and efficient capital allocation. Guided by our core values of excellence, accountability, and collaboration, we provide actionable recommendations to improve health outcomes and reduce costs while ensuring financial integrity and innovation.

Clover is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Buyer to join our Procurement team. This role is ideal for an early-career procurement professional looking to build expertise in procurement, supplier management, contract administration, sourcing, and commercial negotiations. The Buyer will partner with internal stakeholders, suppliers, Legal, Finance, Compliance and business teams to support purchasing activities, contract renewals, vendor relationships, and procurement operations. ● Collaborate with cross functional workstream approvers to facilitate contract review, approval, and execution processes.
● Maintain supplier, contract, and procurement records within the contract lifecycle management system.
● Ensure compliance with procurement policies, approval requirements, signatory and contracting processes.
● Support spend analysis, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives across the procurement function.

Success in this role looks like:

● Strong stakeholder management and customer-service orientation.
● Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments and levels of the organization.
● Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn procurement, contract management, and negotiation skills.
● Sound judgment when reviewing commercial terms and identifying issues requiring escalation to Procurement, Legal, Security, Compliance, Privacy etc...
● Comfortable leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, contract review

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

title: Product Owner - momox Product Catalog (m/f/d)
description:
Our mission

We are on a mission to save our planet - one second hand product at a time.

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to take ownership of the momox Product Catalog (MPC) - our central catalog system and single source of truth for product master data. MPC ingests, enriches and standardizes product data from external sources and distributes it to all downstream systems, including our buying platform, storefronts and marketplaces.

  • Data Quality & Product Matching: Improve product matching across identifiers and ensure validity and correctness of product data and attributes
  • Internationalization & Localization: Scale catalogue coverage and multi-language enrichment to support European expansion including relevant regulatory logic
  • Analytics & Monitoring: Further develop and maintain product catalogue monitoring and reporting to track catalogue health

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

title: Senior Product Manager - Fraud (all genders)

title: Head of Privacy
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we’re on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We’re trusted by more than 10,000 companies worldwide, including Wise, On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we’re tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks  like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.  You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.  Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.  What You'll Own    The release gate: One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.  API test automation: Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.  End-to-end front-end automation: Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.  AI-driven test generation and maintenance: Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point.  Failure triage that arrives with an answer: When the gate goes red, the team should get the failing assertion, the diff or deploy most likely responsible, and a first hypothesis — not a link to a log. title: Seksjonsleder Test og Kvalitet
description: Om oss   I Bane NOR har vi ett felles mål – å sette spor vi er stolte av, som kan drive samfunnet fremover. Derfor jobber vi hver dag med å utvikle og forvalte løsninger som bidrar til en trygg, effektiv og bærekraftig jernbane.  Det er kanskje ikke alle som vet hvor mye teknologi som ligger bak norsk jernbane. Hver dag støtter digitale løsninger alt fra trafikkstyring og kapasitetsplanlegging til kundeinformasjon og operative prosesser. Dette er tjenester som er avgjørende for at togtrafikken skal fungere sikkert og effektivt.  For å lykkes trenger vi sterke fagmiljøer og dyktige ledere. Nå søker vi en leder for Test og Kvalitet som vil være med på å styrke et viktig fagområde og bidra til at Bane NOR fortsetter å levere stabile og fremtidsrettede digitale løsninger.  Vil du lede og videreutvikle test- og kvalitetsfaget i Bane NOR?  Som leder for Test og Kvalitet får du personalansvar for et fagmiljø på rundt 13 medarbeidere med kompetanse innen testledelse, testautomatisering, kvalitetssikring og testfaglig rådgivning.  Du får en viktig rolle i å videreutvikle test- og kvalitetsområdet i Bane NOR. Sammen med medarbeidere, leverandører og øvrige fagmiljøer skal du bidra til at vi utvikler og kvalitetssikrer digitale løsninger som er avgjørende for norsk jernbane.  Vi ser etter deg som kombinerer god faglig forståelse med trygt lederskap. Du vet hva som skal til for å utvikle mennesker, bygge fagmiljøer og sikre høy kvalitet i leveransene.  Dette er en rolle for deg som ønsker å kombinere personalledelse med faglig utvikling og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring på tvers av organisasjonen.   Om rollen   Som leder for Test og Kvalitet får du ansvar for et etablert fagmiljø som spiller en sentral rolle i utviklingen og forvaltningen av Bane NORs digitale tjenester.  Du vil ha ansvar for medarbeidere som arbeider med testledelse, testgjennomføring, testautomatisering, kvalitetssikring og testfaglig rådgivning på tvers av produkter, prosjekter og tjenester.  Rollen kombinerer personalledelse, faglig utvikling og forbedringsarbeid. Du skal sikre at test- og kvalitetsområdet utvikler seg i takt med virksomhetens behov, samtidig som du bidrar til å videreutvikle metoder, standarder og beste praksis innen test og kvalitetssikring.   Om fagområdet   Test og kvalitet er en sentral del av Bane NORs digitale leveranser.  Fagområdet bidrar til at løsningene som understøtter trafikkstyring, kapasitetsplanlegging, kundeinformasjon, logistikk, operative prosesser og andre samfunnskritiske funksjoner holder høy kvalitet og fungerer som forventet.  Vi har ambisjoner om å videreutvikle testområdet gjennom moderne arbeidsformer, økt grad av automatisering, sterkere faglige fellesskap og tydelige standarder for kvalitetssikring på tvers av organisasjonen.  Som leder får du en viktig rolle i å drive denne utviklingen videre. title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer (SQA)
description: Company Description   At Polygon Technology, we specialize in building cutting-edge software solutions that empower businesses around the world. With a strong focus on innovation, quality, and user experience, we are proud to deliver high-performance applications across platforms. Our team is driven by a passion for technology, a commitment to excellence, and a collaborative spirit.   Job Description   We are looking for a detail oriented Software Quality Assurance Engineer (SQA) with a minimum of 2 years of hands on experience in testing web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate is passionate about quality, has a strong understanding of QA processes, and is comfortable working closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure reliable, high quality releases.  Candidates with 3 to 5 or more years of experience in SQA or QA automation will be given strong preference.   Key Responsibilities    Test Planning and Strategy     Analyze requirements, user stories, and technical specifications to identify test scenarios and edge cases.   Prepare and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, and test checklists for new and existing features.      Manual Testing     Execute functional, regression, integration, and system tests for web and mobile applications.   Validate UI, UX, and cross browser behavior to ensure consistency and usability.   Perform exploratory testing to uncover hidden issues and improve product robustness.      Automation and Tools     Design and maintain automated test scripts for critical user flows using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar.   Contribute to building and improving the test automation framework, including test data, reporting, and CI integration.      Defect Management     Log clear, reproducible defects with proper steps, screenshots, and logs in tools such as Jira, ClickUp, or similar.   Work closely with developers to clarify issues, retest fixes, and ensure timely closure of defects.      API and Backend Validation     Test RESTful APIs using tools like Postman or similar, validating responses, error handling, and performance.   Verify data integrity and business rules with the help of database queries when needed.      Performance and Reliability Checks     Support basic performance and load testing activities by designing scenarios and using appropriate tools where applicable.   Monitor and validate application stability across releases.      Process and Documentation     Contribute to improving QA processes, standards, and best practices across the team. title: Quality Assurance Lead
description: Job Title:  QA Lead   Reports to:  Engineering Manager, SRE & QA   Location:  Ireland (remote)   Purpose   We are hiring a QA Lead who starts hands-on to run our QA team day to day. You will be embedded in one pod as a Quality Engineer, the same as the rest of the team, and you will also lead that team: three Quality Engineers report to you. You are the connection between the Engineering Manager and the QA team. The Engineering Manager sets quality strategy and direction. You turn it into day-to-day practice, feed the team's reality back up, and carry the operational load of goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and reviewing your team's work. You stay hands-on and technical throughout.  Most of your quality leverage is upstream. Our pods spec features in depth and hand them to coding agents that build the feature and its tests together. Inside your pod you are the advocate, not the executor: the voice asking the awkward questions, pushing the failure modes nobody thought of, and making sure the spec and our shared testing skills are good enough that the agent produces the right tests, at the right level, catching the right things. Expect to be hands-on early while that foundation is still thin. Expect that to reduce deliberately over time as the skills sharpen and the pod's own quality thinking matures.   Key Responsibilities     QA Team Leadership:  Lead the three Quality Engineers who report to you. Set their goals, run their performance reviews, coach them day to day, and review their work. You are the senior voice they turn to on what good looks like and what to do next, and the first escalation point when they are stuck.   Spec-Time Advocacy:  Be in the room while the pod specs a feature, before any code exists. Ask the awkward questions, push the edge cases and failure modes nobody has thought of, and hold the line that acceptance criteria are testable and traceable. A vague spec produces vague tests, so this is where most of your quality leverage lives.   Agentic Test Quality:  Our coding agents write most of our tests. Curate what they are told: the shared testing skills, patterns, and guardrails that decide what gets tested, at what level, and how. Verify the output is load bearing using mutation testing, rather than assuming a green suite means a covered feature.   Coaching & Culture:  Focus on coaching over absorbing workload. Review the tests that arrive with a pull request, whether a developer or an agent wrote them, asking probing questions to ensure they prove meaningful outcomes. You raise the developers' ceiling by mentoring them on test efficacy.   Fold Back and Compound:  A lesson that only lands in one spec is a lesson we pay for twice. When something is missed, get the reasoning back into the shared skills, gates and patterns so the next feature starts better than the last. This is what makes the role shrink rather than grow: every fold-back reduces how much intervention the next feature needs from you.

title: QA Lead
description: We’re Heidi.  We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.  Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.  We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.  If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.   About The Role   We ship atoms daily. Two million patient visits a week run through what we ship, and a clinician mid-shift has no appetite for our bugs.  This role owns quality at Heidi. Not as a gate at the end, but as the thing that lets every engineer here ship fast and be right. You'll decide what good testing looks like across our stack, build the frameworks and infrastructure that make writing a good test the easy path, and make deploying to production a boring, verifiable event rather than an act of faith.  You'll lead the QA function and stay in the code while you do it. Release management sits inside this role, because the person who understands the risk should be the person who decides it's safe   What You’ll Do     Own the testing strategy across Heidi's stack, from web and mobile to our AI pipelines and EHR-connected enterprise deployments, and make deliberate calls about what belongs in unit tests, what needs integration coverage, what only a real end-to-end run will catch and what we're better off detecting in production.   Choose and build the frameworks. You'll select the tooling, write the harnesses and fixtures, and get our test suites to the point where engineers reach for them because they're fast and reliable rather than because a policy says so.   Make deployment safe by design. Quality gates in CI/CD, staged rollouts, canaries, feature flags and rollback paths that get exercised before anyone needs them, so a bad change is caught by the pipeline instead of by a clinic.   Raise the testing bar across the engineering team through code review, pairing and documentation, so quality is something every engineer owns rather than something they hand to you.   Own the quality signal end to end: escaped defect rate, change failure rate and time to detect, alongside the DORA metrics we already run on. You'll be the person who can say what our real quality is, with evidence.   Run release readiness and go/no-go, weighing coverage, change size, dependency risk

title: Quality Manager
description: Job Type  Full-time   Description    Come build quality on purpose.    Balanced Body  builds Pilates equipment the way a master craftsman builds anything — nothing leaves the shop until it's right. Every reformer, tower, and accessory that leaves our Sacramento facility carries a promise to studios and instructors around the world — and we're looking for the person who makes sure that promise never breaks.  Who We Are  Balanced Body has been the world's leading manufacturer of premium Pilates equipment since 1976. We're headquartered right here in Sacramento, California, and we build more than equipment — we build the tools that help people move better, feel better, and enjoy their lives more. That mission starts on our production floor, and it depends on the quality of everything we ship.  What You'll Do  This is a newly consolidated role — and a rare chance to build something from the ground up. Today, quality lives in pieces: incoming inspection here, in-process checks there, supplier quality somewhere else. We're bringing it all under one leader. As our Quality Manager, you'll be the single owner of quality across the entire flow, from the supplier's dock to the customer's door, turning quality decisions from one-off fire drills into a disciplined, criteria-driven system.  You'll be the voice of the customer inside our factory. Your standard isn't "does it match the drawing" — it's "would the customer be proud to own this."  Especially in year one, this is hands-on work. You'll be on the floor inspecting parts, writing the standards yourself, and working supplier floors directly — not just directing a team to do it. This is a player-coach role, not a seat where you lead exclusively through managers.  What You'll Own    Customer-facing quality: complaints, field failures, and warranty claims route through you — 8D reports, corrective actions, and closing the loop from field data back to the factory floor.  Standards and decisions: author the written acceptance criteria for every part family, chair the Material Review Board, and give inspectors and technicians a clear, consistent rulebook to work from.  The QMS: drive QT9 as a living system — CAPA pipeline, non-conforming product trends, audit readiness — and build the dashboard leadership actually looks at: cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, rework by supplier.  Supplier quality: one end-to-end process from supplier quality agreements through first article and incoming inspection, with structured improvement programs for your highest-impact suppliers. Most of our roughly 1,200 suppliers are small, local shops with little or no formal quality system — you'll spend real time on their floors helping them build the processes and controls they don't have yet, not just auditing against ones they already do.  Cross-functional leadership: a weekly quality/supply cadence with Supply Chain, and a team of inspectors, technicians, and supplier quality engineers who look to you for standar

You'll join a small, high-leverage Infrastructure team with a clear mandate: multiply what every engineer and agent can do through automation, self-service, and guardrails-by-design. We're hiring a Support Manager on our global Support leadership team to clear the way for our APAC Support Engineers.

A quick word on what Support means here, because it shapes everything about this role. We don't think of Support as a ticket queue with a manager attached to it. We are seeking a Senior Software Asset Manager to join our Global IT team and help drive our software asset management (SAM) initiatives worldwide.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented IT Software Asset Manager to oversee the lifecycle management, optimization, governance, and operational support of enterprise SaaS and AI software platforms. Wir ermöglichen EV-Besitzern einen Verkauf innerhalb von 48 Stunden und geben Händlern in ganz Europa Zugang zu neuen Kundengruppen. Der Markt ist fragmentiert, undurchsichtig und schwer vertrauenswürdig. Wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die das löst, damit mehr E-Autos ein zweites Leben bekommen und der Umstieg auf Elektro wirklich Fahrt aufnimmt.

Und es funktioniert: Jahr für Jahr vervierfachen wir unseren Umsatz und halten bereits über 1% der Wiederverkäufe von E-Autos an Endkunden in Deutschland. Unser Team kommt aus der deutschen Startup-Szene und der Automobilwelt, mit Erfahrung bei Autarc, Limehome, Cardino, Wemolo, Alasco, Porsche, Mercedes und KPMG.

Ein Logenplatz dafür, wie ein Startup gebaut und geführt wird. Du sitzt dort, wo das Unternehmen gesteuert wird, arbeitest über alle Funktionen hinweg und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab der ersten Woche. Wenn du lernen willst, wie man ein Startup von innen betreibt, von People über GTM und Finance bis Ops, gibt es kaum bessere Plätze.

title: Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and skilled Software Engineer to join our Geo Information Systems team – Supply Division. We build and operate an end-to-end platform that ingests, processes, and visualizes real-time vehicle and ride data, providing valuable insights to both customers and internal users. 

You'll work on some of Flix's most visible products, building backend services that process large scale streaming data and power real time experiences for millions of passengers every day. Our backend has recently been rewritten in Scala 3 around Kafka Streams, so you'll be building on a modern foundation rather than maintaining legacy systems. 

You'll join a well-staffed, friendly, and diverse team where engineers take ownership, share knowledge, and help each other grow. While our stack includes Scala, Kafka Streams, AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform, we care more about strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and a willingness to learn than experience with any particular technology.

EU GTM | Berlin, Germany

SumUp's Sales team in Germany is on a roll — and we need a Key Account Executive in Berlin who's built different. You'll be great for this role if…

  • You've got experience in account management, sales, or a customer-facing B2B role — SMB experience is a big plus

  • You're just as comfortable hunting for new business as you are nurturing existing accounts — you see both as wins

Production Suite is how we get there.  It ships alongside each new release of our autonomy stack and wraps installation, configuration, acceptance testing, and sign-off into a guided flow.  The work is less about deep architecture and more about getting a lot of moving parts to work together cleanly: software packaging, deployment to edge devices, test automation, Linux plumbing, and an operator experience reliable enough that a non-engineer at a production site can run it on their own.  We are looking for several engineers to join this team early. As one of the first in, you will help shape what we build and how we build it. You will have a broad responsibility from low-level flashing and test orchestration up to the interface the production operator actually interacts with. That includes dependable quality gates, reusable validation flows, strong observability, and developer-facing workflows that reduce friction instead of adding more process. title: Senior Software Engineer (Java / Kotlin)
description:
Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Legacy banking and payment infrastructure struggles to support the demands of today's low-volume, high-velocity payouts, leading to inefficiencies in global payouts. Businesses worldwide send over $20 trillion annually in rewards, remittances, and disbursements often incurring costs of up to 50% per transaction and subjecting recipients to lengthy delays.

Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. The Runa API empowers thousands of businesses to make payments to 5 billion+ consumers in 190+ countries instantly to cards, wallets, bank accounts and gift cards. Leading companies such as Sodexo, TopCashback, Perkbox, Sweatcoin, Coinbase, and Globetopper rely on Runa to facilitate instant, flexible global payouts to tens of millions of consumers.

The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, implementing and deploying software services from end to end. You'll produce clean, scalable, and reusable code to build products which will have a big impact on our customers.

You will have the opportunity to work with a modern, event-driven architecture running on containerised cloud infrastructure, whilst guiding and mentoring more junior engineers in the team.

Our Tech

This role will be building with Java and Kotlin, leaning heavily on event-driven architectures to move money reliably at scale. Services will run in containers on EKS, backed by both SQL and NoSQL databases on AWS.

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

What we're looking for

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing backend systems that power our innovative products. You’ll collaborate with a talented team to create solutions that drive financial inclusion and transform the way people manage their money.

What you'll be doing

  • The work will focus on greenfield development and improvement of existing systems

  • Projects will include building REST APIs, engineering microservices and evolving a number of systems that our business depends on (e.g. card payments, treasury management, transactions booking, crypto liquidity)

  • Our technology stack is based predominantly on Java 25 on the backend with Postgres database

  • We rely on Spring Boot for quick and quality delivery

  • We have a pragmatic approach to develop our business logic, focusing on clean code, with emphasis on maintainability and fast turnaround with TDD, DDD and continuous integration & delivery

What you'll need

  • Demonstrable experience in Backend development, with fluency in Java

title: Software Test & Validation Engineer
description: About Us   Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.  Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.   About The Role   As a  Software Test & Validation Engineer , you build the systems that let us trust our drones' software before it ever flies a mission. You design the automated tests and pipelines that put our flight software through its paces, from pure simulation (SITL) to hardware-in-the-loop (HITL), and turn the results into clear signal for the engineering teams. Our validation team is scaling fast, from testing a handful of drones to testing them by the hundred, and you are how that scale becomes possible.  Your main instrument is the SITL/HITL simulation environment built by our tooling team. A big part of the job is to use it to its full potential and to help improve it continuously: it's recent and not yet fully representative of reality, so your feedback and contributions are what will make it a trustworthy test bench. On top of that, new systems to validate arrive on a regular basis, so you'll repeatedly stand up test coverage for platforms you're seeing for the first time.  This is a broad role, and we're deliberately hiring for a range of profiles rather than a single narrow one. We're looking for engineers with scope beyond pure software, system-level thinking, a feel for architecture, a statistical approach to noisy data, and some physical intuition. Depending on your strengths, you might focus on test-scenario design and coverage, on the automation and CI pipeline that runs tests on every build, on capturing and replaying flight telemetry, or on deepening the simulation itself. Tell us in your application where you fit best.   What you'll do   (the mix depends on your profile, you won't do all of it)     Test design & content: Define the scenarios that catch real bugs, decide what to measure, and turn noisy flight metrics into stable, meaningful pass/fail and regression signals.  Drive and improve the SITL/HITL environment: Use the tooling team's simulation bench as your primary test instrument, push it hard, and feed back concrete improvements to make it more representative, models, scenarios, missing capabilities.  Automation & tooling: Write clean Python tools to load, parse and analyse test outputs, detect regressions, and produce reports the engineering teams act on.  CI/CD integration: Integrate simulation and hardware tests into the continuous-integration pipeline so every new build is validated automatically, fast, and reproducibly.  Onboard n

I teamet arbetar utvecklare och testspecialister tillsammans under ledning av en engagerad produktägare. Vi har ett nära samarbete och löser utmaningar gemensamt för att säkerställa hög kvalitet och effektivitet i bankens utvecklingsarbete.  Teamet är en del av DEVX-tåget, Handelsbanken Development Platform. Vårt mål är att bygga en stark intern utvecklingsplattform efter användarnas behov som ger utvecklingsteamen möjlighet att fokusera på att skapa affärsvärde.   Din roll   Kärnan i rollen är att vidareutveckla bankens gemensamma lösningar för testautomation och prestandatest tillsammans med teamet. Teamet ansvarar för utveckling, förvaltning och förbättring av testverktyg och testinfrastruktur som används av flera utvecklingsteam inom banken.  Rollen kombinerar teknisk utveckling med kunskapsdelning och nära samarbete med andra team. Samtidigt är rollen under fortsatt utveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att påverka både lösningar, arbetssätt och framtida fokusområden.  Dina arbetsuppgifter varierar och kan bland annat omfatta att:    Utveckla och vidareutveckla gemensamma verktyg, ramverk och lösningar för testautomation  Hantera livscykeln för våra verktyg och plattformskomponenter  Ta fram exempelkod, guider och återanvändbara lösningar för utvecklingsteamen  Stötta team genom utbildningar, vägledning och kunskapsdelning kring våra verktyg och arbetssätt  Bevaka omvärlden och utvärdera nya tekniker, trender och verktyg     Din profil   Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av IT-utveckling, där du under de senaste åren har arbetat med objektorienterad programmering i JavaScript samt verktyg och arbetssätt som Git, CI/CD-pipelines och DevOps. Erfarenhet av teknisk testning, ReadyAPI, TestCafe, API-utveckling eller IT-säkerhet ses som meriterande.  Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta i team, där vi stöttar varandra och delar kunskap för att nå gemensamma mål. Du tar ansvar, arbetar självständigt och driver proaktivt fram lösningar.  Du kommunicerar tydligt och lättförståeligt på svenska och engelska både i tal som skrift då rollen innebär många kontaktytor med andra utvecklingsteam och presentationer och föreläsningar.   Välkommen med din ansökan!   Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.  Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handel

title: DevOps Engineer
description: We are looking for a  DevOps Engineer  to join Teleste's Public Safety and Mobility business. In this role, you'll help develop and improve the tools, automation, and environments that enable our software teams to build, test, secure, and deliver high-quality solutions efficiently and reliably.  This is not just a maintenance role. You will play an important part in shaping how software is delivered across teams, working closely with developers, QA specialists, architects, security experts, and Operational Excellence stakeholders.  What you'll do    Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Jenkins-based environments  Improve software build, test, release, and delivery automation  Support Linux-based development infrastructure and shared development tools  Administer and develop Jira workflows and automations  Improve software delivery reliability, traceability, and security  Help development teams solve tooling and delivery challenges  Contribute to DevOps roadmap and continuous improvement initiatives    What we're looking for    Experience with Jenkins and CI/CD environments  Strong understanding of DevOps practices and software delivery automation  Linux administration skills  Experience with Jira administration and automation  Familiarity with scripting (Python, Bash, Groovy, Go or similar)  Understanding of Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Ansible  Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills    Why join us?  You'll have a direct impact on how software is delivered across an international technology company whose solutions are used daily in public transport systems around the world. We offer a collaborative environment, opportunities to shape our DevOps capabilities, and the chance to work on meaningful technology that supports safer and smarter mobility.   Got interested?   If this sounds like the next step for you, send us your application and CV latest on 5th of September 2026. We review candidates throughout the process and will be in touch as soon as possible.  More information about the role from Juha Lintula (@teleste.com)   At Teleste Public Safety and Mobility, we develop technology that helps millions of people move safely and smoothly every day. Our solutions are used in trains, metros and public transport systems across the world, where reliability is not a nice-to-have but a requirement.   Teleste offers an integrated product and service portfolio that makes it possible to build and run a better networked society. Our solutions bring television and broadband services to you, secure your safety in public places and guide your use of public transport. With solid industry experience and drive for innovations, we are a leading international company in broadband, security and information technologies and related services. We connect with our customers through a global network of offices and partners. Teleste is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki.

description: Role : Test Automation Engineer- (Temenos Core Banking/Private Banking/ Wealth Management)  Location : Zurich Switzerland  Years of Experience : Min. 6+ Years   Please share only EU/Swiss Nationals or with Valid B/C Work Permits.    Job Description    Experience in Temenos Core Banking/Private Banking/ Wealth Management is must.   The Test Automation Engineer will be responsible for designing, developing, executing, maintaining, and optimizing automated test scripts across UI, API, regression, and integration layers using approved automation tools and frameworks.    Analyse manual test cases and business flows to identify automation feasibility, priority and complexity  Banking, financial services, payments, lending, digital banking, or core banking automation experience is preferred. Automate UI, API, regression, smoke, sanity, and end-to-end business scenarios using tools such as Selenium, Appium (Optional), REST-assured, Postman, Cucumber, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.  Integrate automation scripts with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Maven, Git, or equivalent tools.  Create and manage test data, parameterization, reusable libraries, page objects, utilities, and common automation components.  Execute automated test suites, analyse failures, identify script defects versus application defects and report execution outcomes.  Maintain automation code in a version-controlled repository and follow coding standards, peer review practices and branching strategy.  Prepare automation execution reports, defect links, screenshots, logs, script handover notes and runbooks for ongoing maintenance.  Experience in test automation for web, API, mobile, or enterprise applications.  Hands-on expertise in Selenium WebDriver, Java, Cucumber/BDD, TestNG/JUnit, Maven, Git, and CI/CD integration.  Experience in API automation using REST-assured, Postman, SOAP UI, or equivalent tools.  Good knowledge of framework design patterns such as Page Object Model, data-driven testing, keyword-driven testing, reusable components, and reporting libraries.  Working knowledge of SQL, test data handling, backend validation, debugging, exception handling, and script maintenance.  Experience with Agile teams, sprint-based automation, regression pack maintenance, and automation reporting dashboards.

title: Snr QA Automation Engineer - Pro
description: Building the Future of Open Finance   Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.  Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.   The team   Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.  The Pro team is responsible for everything to do with the trading backend services such as the matching engine, market data gateways, internal and external APIs, and various other trading services. The team is located globally and responsibilities are split into sub-teams, working with various tech stacks. Our teams code in Rust and work agile around the globe. Recently, the team played a critical role in scaling Kraken's trading infrastructure.  As part of the team, you'll partner closely with frontend and mobile engineers to build quality into every stage of development, helping deliver reliable, intuitive experiences across both web and mobile platforms.   The opportunity     As a QA Automation Engineer within Kraken Pro Engineering, you'll be embedded directly within engineering teams, partnering with frontend and mobile engineers throughout the software development lifecycle.  You'll design and maintain automated UI tests, validate customer journeys, and ensure our web and mobile applications meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. This role combines automation engineering with exploratory and manual testing to ensure every release delivers an exceptional user experience. Vi söker en testarkitekt som vill kliva in i en nyckelroll med huvudansvar för testområdet inom flera domäner. Idag finns ingen dedikerad testfunktion, men teamen arbetar redan med viss automation. Rollen innebär att du vidareutvecklar en redan påbörjad teststruktur och ges mandat att etablera en långsiktig och sammanhållen strategi.  Du arbetar nära flera fullstack-team (frontend och backend) och får en central roll i att bygga robusta E2E-flöden och integrera test i våra pipelines. Våra system är affärs- och samhällskritiska, vilket gör kvalitet och stabilitet till en avgörande faktor.  Rollen är både strategisk och operativ. Du definierar hur vi ska arbeta med test - och är själv med och bygger lösningarna.  Arbetet sker i hybridform med hög flexibilitet, då teamen är geografiskt utspridda över flera orter.  Det här är en roll för dig som vill:     Äga och utveckla ett testområde med stort mandat   Kombinera strategi med praktisk implementation   Påverka tekniska vägval och kvalitet i fullstack-miljö   Bygga strukturer som håller över tid    Your future duties and responsibilities  I den här rollen får du ett helhetsansvar för hur vi arbetar med test och kvalitet. Du kombinerar strategiskt tänk med praktiskt genomförande och blir den som sätter strukturen samtidigt som du bygger lösningarna tillsammans med teamen. I arbetsuppgifter ingår att:     Sätta och äga den övergripande teststrategin för flera utvecklingsteam   Bygga upp och vidareutveckla E2E-testautomation samt integrera den i CI/CD-pipelines   Strukturera och vidareutveckla befintlig automation med frihet att påverka verktygsval   Säkerställa att testbarhet är en naturlig del av arkitektur och utvecklingsprocess   Vara rådgivande inom kvalitet, testbar kod och testdesign   Stötta teamen i enhetstester, TDD och god testpraxis     Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role      Cirka 5 års erfarenhet inom test, testarkitektur eller avancerad testautomation   Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att ta fram och implementera teststrategi i komplexa system   Erfarenhet av E2E-testautomation och arbete i CI/CD-miljö   Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta ägarskap för ett helt testområde   Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team i DevOps-kultur   God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med utvecklare och produktägare    Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Playwright eller liknande moderna testautomationsramverk samt har arbetat i molnbaserade miljöer. Vi ser även positivt på om du är nyfiken på och håller dig uppdaterad kring nya tekniker, inklusive AI.  Vi vet att ingen uppfyller alla krav. Om du drivs av att bygga upp något nytt, gillar att ta ansvar och vill arbeta med lösningar som gör verklig skillnad i samhället, ser vi gärna att du söker. description: Jeppesen ForeFlight    Quality Assurance Engineer    Location:  Denmark |  Employment Type:  Full-time |  Team:  Engineering & Quality   About Jeppesen ForeFlight   Jeppesen ForeFlight brings together decades of Jeppesen's aeronautical data expertise with ForeFlight's award-winning flight planning and navigation platform. Our software supports pilots, airlines, and flight departments around the world, delivering mission-critical tools for safe and efficient flight operations. As we continue to grow our presence in Europe, we're building out our Denmark-based team to help ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.   About The Role   We're looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team in Denmark. In this role, you'll design and execute test strategies for aviation software used by pilots and operators worldwide, where reliability and precision are non-negotiable. You'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and aviation data specialists to identify defects early, improve test coverage, and help ship high-quality releases.   What You'll Do     Design, develop, and maintain manual and automated test cases for web, mobile, and backend applications.  Collaborate with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle to define acceptance criteria and quality gates.  Build and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, and integration) to support continuous delivery.  Identify, document, and track defects, working with developers to reproduce, triage, and verify fixes.  Perform exploratory testing on new features, with particular attention to edge cases relevant to aviation data and flight-planning workflows.  Contribute to test plans and quality documentation for releases, including regulatory and compliance-related testing where applicable.  Monitor production quality metrics and participate in root-cause analysis of escaped defects.  Advocate for quality best practices across the team, including code reviews, CI/CD pipeline checks, and test automation standards.      What We're Looking For     2+ years of experience in a software quality assurance or test engineering role.  Solid understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.  Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar frameworks).  Familiarity with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured) and basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, or similar).  Experience working with bug tracking and test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, or equivalent).  Strong analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.  Based in Denmark or willing to work from our Denmark location, with authorization to work in the EU.      Nice to Have     Experience testing software in aviation, geospatial, or other safety-critical,

title: Senior Technical Architect
description: Vil du lede arkitekturen bak morgendagens digitale løsninger og skape verdi gjennom moderne teknologi, data og AI?  Vi er Forte, et europeisk konsulentselskap som hjelper virksomheter med å forbli relevante og realisere sitt fulle potensial – uansett hva fremtiden bringer. Navnet vårt betyr styrke, og det er akkurat det vi gir våre kunder: styrken til å tilpasse seg, handle og vokse.  Gjennom å kombinere teknologi, strategi og brukeropplevelse hjelper vi kundene våre med å lede – ikke bare følge etter.  Nå ser vi etter en erfaren teknisk arkitekt som vil være med å bygge moderne, sikre og fremtidsrettede løsninger for kundene våre – og bidra til å forme hvordan vi jobber med arkitektur, utvikling og AI i Forte.  Om rollen  Som teknisk arkitekt hos Forte får du en sentral rolle i komplekse teknologi- og transformasjonsprosjekter. Du vil jobbe tett med kunder, utviklere, produktmiljøer, forretning og andre arkitekter for å forstå behov, sette retning og bygge løsninger som skaper reell verdi.  Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å kombinere strategisk teknologiforståelse med praktisk gjennomføring. Du trives med å tegne målbilder, ta arkitekturvalg og forklare konsekvenser – men du er også komfortabel med å gå ned i koden, sparre med utviklere og bidra direkte i implementeringen.  Hos oss får du jobbe med moderne skyarkitektur, .NET, Azure, integrasjoner, data, sikkerhet og KI. Vi tror AI vil endre måten vi utvikler, designer og forvalter digitale løsninger på, og vi ser etter deg som både har praktisk erfaring med AI-verktøy og en tydelig nysgjerrighet på hvordan teknologien kan brukes ansvarlig og verdiskapende.  Ansvarsområder    Lede tekniske avklaringer og arkitekturarbeid i komplekse kundeprosjekter  Designe moderne, skalerbare og sikre løsninger basert på forretningsbehov  Være en hands-on arkitekt som også bidrar i kode, tekniske vurderinger og implementering  Jobbe med .NET, Azure og moderne utviklingsplattformer  Bidra til gode teknologivalg, arkitekturprinsipper og stegvis modernisering fra legacy til målbilde  Utforske og bruke AI-verktøy i utviklingsprosessen, for eksempel kodeassistenter, LLM-er og agentbaserte arbeidsflyter  Vurdere hvordan AI kan brukes i kundeløsninger på en ansvarlig, robust og verdiskapende måte  Dokumentere og formidle arkitektur på en måte som er nyttig for både utviklere, forretning og beslutningstakere  Bidra aktivt til Forte sitt fagmiljø gjennom sparring, mentoring og kunnskapsdeling    Hvem er du?  Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du er en erfaren teknolog som er nysgjerrig, proaktiv og ønsker å spille de rundt deg god. Du har vært med på store og komplekse leveranser før, og du vet at god arkitektur ikke bare handler om mønstre, diagrammer og teknologivalg – men om mennesker, forretning, tempo, kvalitet og evnen til å ta gode beslutninger under usikkerhet.   Vi Ser Gjerne At Du Har     Minimum 10 års erfaring som utvikler, arkitekt eller teknisk leder i komplekse IT-prosjekter  Dyp og bred
