title: Test & QA Manager (m/w/d)
description: Gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der HYPO OOE!      Als eine der führenden Regionalbanken in Oberösterreich steht die HYPO OOE für Stabilität, Innovation und Kundenorientierung. Um unseren erfolgreichen Weg weiterzugehen, entwickeln wir unsere Organisation kontinuierlich weiter und investieren gezielt in moderne Strukturen, effiziente Prozesse und innovative Lösungen.     Als Test & QA Manager verantworten Sie die Qualität unserer Lösungen über alle Squads hinweg. Sie bauen unsere Teststrategie und die Automatisierung auf, definieren die Qualitäts-Gates und sorgen dafür, dass wir schnell liefern können, ohne bei Verlässlichkeit oder regulatorischem Nachweis Abstriche zu machen.      Ihre Rolle:      Teststrategie:  Sie entwickeln unsere Teststrategie und verankern sie in der Arbeitsweise aller Squads.   Testautomatisierung:  Sie bauen die automatisierte Teststrecke auf und entwickeln sie weiter, über alle Teststufen hinweg bis zur Freigabe eines Releases. Wir setzen dabei auf Playwright.   Qualitäts-Gates:  Sie definieren, ab wann eine Lösung produktionsreif ist, und verankern das in der Definition of Done. Diese Entscheidung treffen Sie unabhängig von Termindruck.   Regulatorischer Nachweis:  Sie stellen sicher, dass Tests und Freigaben nachvollziehbar dokumentiert und prüfungsfest sind.   Zusammenarbeit im Squad:  Sie begleiten die Squads von der Anforderung bis zum Go-live und verankern Qualität früh statt am Ende.   Den Weg frei machen:  Sie erkennen Qualitätsrisiken früh, lösen sie gemeinsam mit den Squads und schaffen Transparenz über den Reifegrad der Lösungen.       Ihre Profil:     Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Softwaretest und Qualitätssicherung, idealerweise über mehrere Teams hinweg  Praxis in Testautomatisierung über alle Teststufen, idealerweise mit Playwright  Erfahrung mit Testmanagement in agilen Umgebungen  Sicherer Umgang mit Jira und Confluence  Hands-on: testet und automatisiert selbst, statt nur zu koordinieren  Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse      Nice to have:      Zertifizierung im Testumfeld (ISTQB o. Ä.)  Erfahrung mit Low-Code-Plattformen (Appian, Pega o. Ä.)  Erfahrung in reguliertem Umfeld (Banken, Versicherungen o. Ä.)       Für diese Position ist ein Jahresbruttogehalt von EUR 70.000,-- bis EUR 90.000,-- vorgesehen. Die tatsächliche Vergütung richtet sich selbstverständlich nach Ihrer Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung. Die konkrete Höhe des Jahresgehalts legen wir gerne gemeinsam mit Ihnen in einem persönlichen Gespräch fest.

title: Munitions QC
description: The  Munitions QC  audits and monitors the performance of the Munitions Department in respect to all explosives processes to include internal quality control management measures, effectiveness of training and compliance with all safety (explosive and industrial) and environmental programs for the Munitions Department. Site focal point for all Amentum Weapons Safety issues/requirements. This may include measuring, observing, inspecting, testing, analyzing, classifying and recording inspection results of inspections documented in the Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System (TICMS). Ensures compliance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS).   Principal Accountabilities     Perform random quality inspections on munitions inspection, receiving, shipping, storage, accountability maintenance, supply, procurement and transportation processes, including storage and operating facilities, to verify compliance with explosives, technical directives and the PWS.   Perform random in-process and final product quality inspections on accountability, inspection, maintenance, storage, transportation and shipping operations.   Monitor workshop practices and housekeeping, explosive and industrial, to identify compliance, identifying discrepancies and negative trends for managerial attention and corrections.   Perform quality control inspections on outbound munitions shipments, including validation photography.   Perform random inspection on tools, shop equipment, safety equipment and protective clothing.   Perform spot checks on material requisition, storage and parts tracking management processes.   Randomly review production and inspection schedules, work orders and historical records to ensure accuracy and timely completion.   Review technical order files and Air Force standards for currency and adequacy.   Review and evaluate work processes and facilities to ensure compliance with ISO 9001/Weapons Safety.   Coordination point for review of written procedures and emergency action checklists; validate for currency and accuracy annually.   Coordinate with other departments and PSO for standardization of processes and procedures.   Assist with the development and implementation of departmental training programs. title: Senior QA Engineer
description: About the Role   We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer to own the health of every release.       That sentence is the whole job, and we mean it literally:   you own the release gate.   If your suite is green, we ship. If it's red, we don't. Nobody overrides a red gate by asserting that it's probably fine; they either fix the product or fix the test with you.      That authority only works if the gate is trustworthy, which is where the engineering is. A gate that flakes gets ignored within a week. A gate that takes ninety minutes gets bypassed. A gate that passes vacuously — a suite that asserts nothing, a check that skipped, a probe that read an empty response as healthy — is worse than no gate at all, because it  looks   like coverage. Your real product is a signal the whole company believes without checking.      You'll build that signal with AI as your primary lever, not as a garnish. Generating, maintaining, and repairing tests is exactly the kind of work modern models are good at, and a single engineer using them well can hold coverage that used to need a team. We expect you to industrialise that: agents that turn a merged spec into API and end-to-end coverage, that triage a failure to a probable cause before a human opens it, and that keep selectors and fixtures current instead of letting them rot. We're a small, distributed, AI-first team — this is a high-autonomy, high-consequence role, not a ticket queue.     Our surface today: a Python/Django + DRF backend on Postgres and Redis, a TypeScript/Next.js customer-facing app, GitLab CI, Terraform, Docker, and a set of third-party carrier, airline, and tracking integrations that misbehave in ways no unit test will ever predict.     What You'll Own    The release gate:   One command, one verdict, on every release. You define what must be true before code reaches customers, you make that decision automated and repeatable rather than a judgement call, and you keep the runtime short enough that nobody wants to skip it.    API test automation:   Broad, fast, deterministic coverage of our Django/DRF surface — contracts, auth and permission boundaries, pagination, error shapes, idempotency, and the integration seams where a carrier or airline API changes its mind without telling us.    End-to-end front-end automation:   Real browser coverage of the journeys that earn revenue and the ones that generate support tickets, in a modern framework (we'd reach for Playwright), stable enough to run on every merge rather than nightly.    AI-driven test generation and maintenance:   Build the pipeline that turns a spec into a first-pass suite, keeps suites current as the product moves, and drafts the fix when a selector or fixture goes stale. Maintenance cost is the thing that kills automation programmes; automating maintenance is the point. We are seeking a Maintenance Planner to join our Engineering Stores team. Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsmanager (m/w/d).

Sie verantworten die Weiterentwicklung des Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsmanagements. Dabei übernehmen Sie die Funktion des Energiemanagementbeauftragten, koordinieren technische und organisatorische Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und stellen die Einhaltung relevanter Normen und regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher.

Die BREMSKERL-REIBBELAGWERKE EMMERLING GMBH & CO. KG ist ein weltweit agierendes, mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Estorf-Leeseringen. Wir sind einer der führenden Reibbelaghersteller in Europa und entwickeln, produzieren und vertreiben seit 1929 verschiedene Reibbeläge für die Anwendungsgebiete Schienenfahrzeuge, Industrieanwendungen und Nutzfahrzeuge.

Aufgaben

  • Weiterentwicklung des Energie- und Nachhaltigkeitsmanagements sowie Umsetzung entsprechender Unternehmensziele
  • Übernahme der Funktion des Energiemanagementbeauftragten und Betreuung des Energiemanagementsystems nach ISO 50001
  • Eigenständige Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung von Projekten zur Steigerung der Energieeffizienz und Nachhaltigkeitsleistung
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Nachhaltigkeitsberichten sowie Betreuung relevanter Nachhaltigkeitsratings, insbesondere VSME und EcoVadis
  • Monitoring gesetzlicher und regulatorischer Anforderungen/Verordnungen im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit, Umwelt und Energiemanagement sowie Ableitung erforderlicher Maßnahmen
  • Ergänzende Unterstützung des Qualitätsmanagements und der Qualitätsvorausplanung (APQP) bei entwicklungsbezogenen Themen

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Maschinenbau, Energietechnik, Umwelttechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung; alternativ eine technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung und relevanter Berufserfahrung

title: QA Automation Engineer
description: Technology, Almere   Apply now   QA Automation Engineer      Technology   Almere    Apply now  Back to overview  QA Automation Engineer  Ben jij een ervaren QA Automation Engineer die graag vanaf de basis een kwaliteitsfunctie opzet? Krijg je energie van het bouwen van geautomatiseerde testoplossingen en wil je een directe impact hebben op de kwaliteit van een innovatief AI- en voiceplatform? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!  DE FUNCTIE  Als QA Automation Engineer speel je een sleutelrol binnen DialoX. DialoX is een innovatief low-code platform voor conversational AI en voice-oplossingen. Het platform ondersteunt onder andere web-, telefoon-, WhatsApp- en e-mailkanalen en maakt gebruik van moderne technologieën zoals AI, LLM's en geavanceerde integraties met telefoniesystemen. title: Quality Manager
description: Come build quality on purpose.       Balanced Body  builds Pilates equipment the way a master craftsman builds anything — nothing leaves the shop until it's right. Every reformer, tower, and accessory that leaves our Sacramento facility carries a promise to studios and instructors around the world — and we're looking for the person who makes sure that promise never breaks.      Who We Are   Balanced Body has been the world's leading manufacturer of premium Pilates equipment since 1976. We're headquartered right here in Sacramento, California, and we build more than equipment — we build the tools that help people move better, feel better, and enjoy their lives more. That mission starts on our production floor, and it depends on the quality of everything we ship.      What You'll Do   This is a newly consolidated role — and a rare chance to build something from the ground up. Today, quality lives in pieces: incoming inspection here, in-process checks there, supplier quality somewhere else. We're bringing it all under one leader. As our Quality Manager, you'll be the single owner of quality across the entire flow, from the supplier's dock to the customer's door, turning quality decisions from one-off fire drills into a disciplined, criteria-driven system.  You'll be the voice of the customer inside our factory. Your standard isn't "does it match the drawing" — it's "would the customer be proud to own this."  Especially in year one, this is hands-on work. You'll be on the floor inspecting parts, writing the standards yourself, and working supplier floors directly — not just directing a team to do it. This is a player-coach role, not a seat where you lead exclusively through managers.      What You'll Own     Customer-facing quality:  complaints, field failures, and warranty claims route through you — 8D reports, corrective actions, and closing the loop from field data back to the factory floor.   Standards and decisions:  author the written acceptance criteria for every part family, chair the Material Review Board, and give inspectors and technicians a clear, consistent rulebook to work from.   The QMS:  drive QT9 as a living system — CAPA pipeline, non-conforming product trends, audit readiness — and build the dashboard leadership actually looks at: cost of poor quality, first-pass yield, rework by supplier.   Supplier quality:  one end-to-end process from supplier quality agreements through first article and incoming inspection, with structured improvement programs for your highest-impact suppliers. Most of our roughly 1,200 suppliers are small, local shops with little or no formal quality system — you'll spend real time on their floors helping them build the processes and controls they don't have yet, not just auditing against ones they already do.   Cross-functional leadership:  a weekly quality/supply cadence with Supply Chain, and a team of inspectors, technicians, and supplier quality engineers who look to you for standards and coaching. Q

Deine Aufgaben als Quality Assurance Manager*in      Unterstütze den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung eines GMP-konformen QMS  Implementiere gezielt Maßnahmen zur Einhaltung hoher Qualitätsstandards  Sorge für die Umsetzung nationaler und internationaler GMP-Vorgaben  Übernimm Verantwortung für Risikobewertungen, Lieferantenqualifizierungen, Prozessvalidierungen, Änderungs- und Abweichungsmanagement sowie Schulungen und Kundenbeschwerden  Erstelle und prüfe SOPs, Spezifikationen sowie Validierungs- und Qualifizierungsunterlagen  Unterstütze interne und externe Audits und trage aktiv zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Abläufen bei     Qualifikationen     Das wünsche wir uns      Abgeschlossenes naturwissenschaftliches Studium in Biologie, Chemie, Biotechnologie, Pharmazie oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet  Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit Qualitätsmanagementsystemen in der pharmazeutischen Industrie (GMP), idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in der Qualitätssicherung  Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift  Fundierte Kenntnisse in pharmazeutischer Herstellung sowie chemischer, biochemischer oder mikrobiologischer Analytik von Vorteil  Hohes Engagement und ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, klar, präzise und wirkungsvoll zu kommunizieren  Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung, Zuverlässigkeit und ein starkes Verantwortungsbewusstsein    Deine Vorteile       Strukturierte Einarbeitung und Mentoring für einen gelungenen Start   Die Chance, unseren neuen Standort mit aufzubauen    Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und attraktive Arbeitgeberzuschüsse   Verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben und individuelle Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten in einem innovativen, internationalen Unternehmen   Offene Unternehmenskultur, in der Integrität, Respekt sowie Leidenschaft und Neugierde für zukunftsweis

title: QA Manager
description: Ben jij een ervaren QA professional die kwaliteit niet alleen wil bewaken, maar echt verder wil bouwen? Voor een groeiende organisatie binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie zoeken wij een QA Manager.     De organisatie zit midden in een professionaliseringsslag. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen een bestaand kwaliteitssysteem beheert, maar juist de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan de volgende fase. Je geeft leiding aan een klein kwaliteitsteam en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor Operations en andere afdelingen.      Wat ga je doen?   Als QA/QC Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteit en voedselveiligheid binnen de organisatie.  Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:   Borgen, onderhouden en verbeteren van het kwaliteitssysteem volgens HACCP en FSSC 22000;  Analyseren van klachten en afwijkingen en inzetten van structurele verbetermaatregelen;  Voorbereiden, begeleiden en opvolgen van interne en externe audits;  Versterken van de kwaliteitscultuur op de werkvloer;  Aansturen en ontwikkelen van een team   Samenwerken met productie, productontwikkeling, inkoop en logistiek;  Verbeteren van processen, procedures en werkwijzen;  Rapporteren over kwaliteit en verbeterinitiatieven aan interne en externe stakeholders;  Contact onderhouden met klanten, certificerende instanties en toezichthouders;  Adviseren van management en collega's over kwaliteits- en voedselveiligheidsvraagstukken.       Wat breng je mee?    HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Levensmiddelentechnologie of vergelijkbaar;  3 tot 5 jaar ervaring binnen QA/QC in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie;  Ervaring met FSSC 22000 en HACCP  Kennis van BLK en Trace1 is een pré       Wie ben jij?   Je bent iemand die makkelijk schakelt tussen de werkvloer en het management. Je brengt structuur, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet mensen mee te krijgen in veranderingen.  Daarnaast:   Sta je stevig in je schoenen;  Ben je mensgericht en benaderbaar;  Communiceer je duidelijk en proactief;  Werk je planmatig en resultaatgericht;  Weet je een visie op kwaliteit te vertalen naar concrete acties.       Wat krijg je ervoor terug?    Een zelfstandige QA-managementrol met veel verantwoordelijkheid;  Directe invloed op kwaliteit, voedselveiligheid en organisatieontwikkeling;  De ruimte om het kwaliteitssysteem verder vorm te geven;  Een betrokken team  Een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is;  Marktconforme arbeidsvoorwaarden, afhankelijk van je ervaring;  32 tot 40 uur per week.       Interesse?   Lijkt dit op de volgende stap in jouw QA-carrière? Stuur mij dan je cv of neem vrijblijvend contact met mij op. Ook als je eerst wat meer wilt weten over de organisatie en de rol, vertel ik je er graag meer over.

title: QA Lead
description: About Us   Kumaran Systems: Engineering Future-Ready Transformations Since 1992, Kumaran Systems has been helping enterprises bridge the past and the future, reimagining legacy systems and embracing AI-led possibilities. With over 34 years of delivery excellence, we specialise in re-engineering core applications, driving cloud transformation, and building automation-first, GenAI-enabled ecosystems across the Banking and Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, and Automotive sectors. We help organisations not just upgrade their systems but reimagine what’s possible.  Why Kumaran?  We blend engineering discipline with AI innovation, helping clients modernise with confidence, automate with clarity, and scale with purpose. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in end-to-end testing across UI, API, and database layers, along with strong automation expertise using Playwright with Python. Design and execute test strategies, test plans, and test cases for functional and integration testing.  Perform API testing, backend testing, and data validation/comparison across multiple systems.  Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Playwright with Python.  Coordinate with business analysts, developers, product owners, and vendor teams to ensure quality deliverables.  Identify defects, track resolutions, and ensure timely closure of issues.  Support SIT, regression, integration, and UAT testing activities.  Mentor offshore QA team members and provide technical guidance.  Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.   Required Skills & Experience   7–10+ years of QA experience with at least 2+ years in a QA Lead role.  Strong domain expertise in Capital Markets and Wealth Management Technology (WMT).  Hands-on experience with UI, API, and database testing.  Strong experience in integration testing and data hub validation.  Experience with backend testing and data comparison across systems.  Automation testing experience using Playwright with Python.  Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or Swagg

title: Senior Quality Assurance Specialist
description: G2 are partnering with a market leader based near to Rotterdam, South Holland, who are looking for a Senior QA Specialist to join their team on a permanent basis.     The client specialise in the medical device manufacturing sector, with a primary focus on hardware, from R&D/NPI through to product manufacturing and validation phases.     You will be working on QA responsibilities and playing a lead role within the team, working closely with the engineering and manufacturing teams, ensuring relevant standards are adhered to, with a specific focus on GMP, root cause analyses and CAPAs. The client ideally want people who have experience with MedTech, specifically ISO 13485.      Permanent Opportunity – Senior QA Specialist – Rotterdam Region      Start date: September, October, November 2026  Contract type: Permanent  Salary: €4,500 - €5,800 per month + 8%  Package: Bonus, travel allowance, pension, 26 days annual leave + 5.5 ADV days     Essential Skills:   Bachelor's degree in an engineering or scientific discipline  Background as QA Officer, Specialist, Quality Engineer, or similar  Experience working on QA, documentation, GMP, CAPAs and GLP  Working history in the Medical Manufacturing sector strongly preferred, pharmaceuticals can also be considered  Experience working with ISO 13485 essential  Ability to work independently, coordinating multiple processes simultaneously  Fluent English essential, Dutch beneficial      The company currently has multiple new products going to market in Q4, and look set to have a very busy 2027, so the role comes with great progression opportunity, as you will also be mentoring and coaching junior team members.

title: Test System Designer
description: Would you like to develop testing methods while learning more about software, hardware and radio technologies?     We are now looking for a Test System Designer to strengthen our Test Systems team in Salo, Finland.      What will you be doing?      Your main focus will be on software and device testing, test development and test automation.  You will develop testing methods to ensure that the software on our devices works as intended, is compatible with other systems and meets the required standards. Your work will involve testing different radio technologies and collaborating closely with our software and hardware development teams.     The role offers plenty of room for your own ideas and initiative. You do not need to know everything from day one, curiosity, motivation and willingness to learn are more important.      What are we looking for?      We are looking for someone with a solid technical foundation, an interest in testing and the courage to learn and try new things. You can be an experienced testing professional or at the beginning of your career.     Basic programming skills are important, as our testing methods are built using technologies such as Python, Java, C and C++.      Experience or knowledge in the following areas is an advantage:       Software and device testing or test automation  Electronics, embedded systems or radio technologies  Programming with Python, Java, C or C++  New technologies and AI tools      You do not need to tick every box. We value your ability and motivation to learn more than a long list of existing skills.      Why SATEL?      At SATEL, you will work alongside experienced technology professionals and contribute directly to the quality and reliability of our products. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills and take on responsibilities according to your experience and interests.     You'll be based at our Meriniitynkatu office in Salo, Finland. The role is mainly on-site, but there's flexibility for hybrid working when your tasks allow it.     If technology interests you, learning new things motivates you and you like to get things done, we would love to hear from you.     There's no need to submit your CV or any other attachments at this stage. Just answer a few short questions to get started.       SATEL    develops and manufactures wireless data communication solutions for demanding applications. Our products are used in industry, construction, mining and automated systems where reliable data communication is essential.

title: Area Software Architect
description: Every day, millions of messages are created, personalized, scheduled, and delivered through Voyado Engage. Behind that seemingly simple experience lies one of the most complex distributed systems in our platform.     As retailers expect richer personalization, more channels, and increasingly real-time experiences, that complexity is only growing. Our Communication Area owns the end-to-end communication platform, from content creation and personalization to orchestration, delivery, and message tracking across multiple channels.  We’re now continuing to evolve the architecture behind that platform. This isn’t about maintaining what already exists. It’s about making sure a business-critical system can keep evolving as our ambitions, volumes, and customer expectations grow.  About the role     As Area Architect, you’ll help set the technical direction across the Communication Area. You’ll work closely with engineering teams, tech leads, Area Leadership, and fellow architects, helping teams make architectural decisions that balance what we need to deliver today with where the platform needs to be years from now.  This role is about seeing the system beyond individual services and features. You’ll challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities before they become blockers, and help teams understand how local decisions affect scalability, reliability, and the evolution of the communication platform as a whole.  As part of the Area Leadership, you’ll work alongside our Engineering Manager, Product Lead, and UX Lead, shaping both what we build and how we build it.      Some of the things you'll be up to:    Shape the technical direction of the Communication Area together with tech leads, engineering teams, and Area Leadership  Guide teams through architectural trade-offs around scalability, reliability, performance, developer experience, and long-term maintainability  Review and challenge significant technical proposals, exploring alternatives and strengthening designs before decisions become difficult to reverse  Look beyond today’s roadmap to identify emerging technical risks, opportunities, and foundational investments that will matter in the years ahead  Facilitate architectural discussions across teams, creating shared direction rather than isolated solutions  Coach tech leads and senior engineers, helping them strengthen their architectural thinking and technical leadership  Collaborate with architects across Voyado to ensure the Communication Area evolves as part of a coherent Engage platform       So, who are you?   We believe you’re an experienced architect or senior technical leader who enjoys working with complex distributed systems where technical decisions have real impact at scale. title: (桂川)ソフトウェア・サービス開発のQMO
description: 求人カテゴリー / Recruiting Category  ◆情報（オムロン デジタル(株)）  ◆募集背景  全社横断のQMO(Quality Management Office)の一員として、組織全体のソフトウェア製品やサービスの品質を横断的に管理・向上させる人材を募集しています。プロジェクト品質・プロセス・成果物の標準化と継続的改善を担うQMO機能の強化を目的とし、プロジェクトマネジメント力の強化に加え、品質の観点で事業・IT双方に価値を提供できる人材を求めています。  従来は各事業部・プロジェクト単位で品質を担保してきましたが、品質課題の高度化・複雑化に伴い、組織横断で品質を統括・高度化する専門組織としてQMOを新設しました。本ポジションは、単なる品質保証の枠を超え、「品質＝価値」という観点から、事業成長に直結する品質戦略を牽引いただく役割を担います。  ◆担っていただきたい具体的な仕事内容  ・ソフトウェア・サービス開発での品質保証・品質管理の構築・展開。  ・AI、クラウド等の先行技術を活用した開発における品質管理プロセスの構築と展開。  ・開発プロジェクトでのQAおよびPMO機能の実践または支援。  ・品質管理・保証プロセスの改善・組織内教育。  ・個別プロジェクトに入り込みながらも、全社最適の視点で品質課題を抽出し、改善提言・仕組み化までリードします。  ・品質マネジメントシステム（QMS）の設計・標準化・ドキュメント化および全社展開。  ・プロセス・成果物の可視化やデータ活用（例：統計解析・分析）による品質向上施策の推進。  ・現場への指導・伴走支援を通じた品質文化の醸成。  ・将来的にはオムロングループ全体への品質展開・教育にも関与いただきます。  ◆具体的な仕事内容に対しての期待する成果  ・QCD/CXを高める規定やプロセスの構築/整備  ・品質力向上のための育成プログラム策定  ・個別最適ではなく、全社横断で再現性ある品質プロセスの確立  ・「守りの品質（不具合抑止）」と「攻めの品質（価値創出）」の両立  ・現場メンバーの品質意識・スキル向上（育成・教育体系の構築）  ◆必須条件【経験】  ・組込み開発含むIT領域での品質管理経験5年以上。  ・品質マネジメントシステムの導入・運用経験がある方。  ・テスト経験に加えて、品質改善やプロセス改善に関わった経験。  ・品質に関する課題を定義し、改善に繋げた経験。  ◆必須条件【スキル】  ・組込みソフトウェア開発のプロセスおよび製品品質の特徴を理解している。  ・ITサービスの開発と運用における品質保証・品質管理を理解している。  ・アジャイル、AI、クラウド等を活用した開発プロセス、および、製品品質を理解している。  ◆歓迎条件  関連するISO標準規格に関する知識  QMO／PMO組織での実務経験  IT統制、内部統制、監査対応の経験  ◆歓迎する人物像  論理的思考力・課題整理力・ドキュメンテーション能力  関係者と合意形成を行うためのコミュニケーション能力  ◆この仕事の魅力  当たり前品質を高める守りの品質だけでなく、CX (Customer Experience)やUX (User Experience)観点で、顧客への提供価値を高めるための攻めの品質戦略を推進しています。  ・QMO機能の設計と実装、さらに、継続的な強化と改善に取り組むポジションです。  ・品質領域でありながら、経営・事業・顧客価値に直接影響を与える上流ポジションです。  ・ 「プロジェクトの納期やリソース」だけでなく「実現する品質や価値の本質」を軸に意思決定に関与できます。  ・将来的には、オムロングループ全体の品質向上を牽引する中核人材として活躍可能です。  ・品質を軸に、プロダクト・サービス・プロセスのすべてを俯瞰できるキャリアが構築できます。  ◆業界動向と自社事業の特徴  オムロンのデジタル戦略子会社として、オムロングループ全体のソフトウェア・ITサービス開発を担っており、機器組込みのソフトウェア開発から、クラウドのITサービスシステム開発まで、幅広い領域をカバーしています。  従来の「不具合を減らす品質」から、「CX/UXを高め顧客価値を創出する品質」へと、品質の役割は進化しています。当社では、組込み領域で培った高信頼性開発に加え、クラウド／AI／データドリブン領域におけるサービス品質の高度化にも注力しており、「OT×IT両面の品質」を追求できる稀有な環境です。  ◆部・チームの業務概要  全社横断のPMO/QMO組織として、システム開発のQCD向上、顧客への提供価値向上のための仕組みづくり（育成プログラム、プロセス制定等）を推進しています。  QMOは、個別プロジェクトを超えた「組織全体の品質」を対象とし、プロジェクト横断でのレビュー・改善提言・仕組み化を推進します。  PMOと連携しつつも独立した視点で、品質観点からプロジェクト・プロセス・成果物に対して提言を行うポジションです。  ◆配属先の課・チームの人数や雰囲気  課の人数：7名程度  雰囲気：2026年度から新設のグループ。プロジェクトマネジメント、品質マネジメントのスペシャリストが揃っています。  ◆職種カテゴリ  品質, IT  勤務地 / Work location  桂川事業所（京都府）

description: Sveriges a-kassor söker nu en Systemtestare   Arbetsmarknaden förändras i allt snabbare takt och arbetslöshetskassornas uppdrag har kanske aldrig varit viktigare.     Det finns 24 a-kassor i Sverige. Sveriges a-kassor är deras gemensamma service- och intresseorganisation. Det betyder att vi hjälper a-kassorna med bland annat IT-utveckling, utbildning och opinionsbildning. Syftet är att a-kassorna ska kunna administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen på ett så snabbt och effektivt sätt som möjligt. Sveriges a-kassor sitter i nya fräscha lokaler vid Skanstull samt är en modern arbetsgivare som månar om sina anställda. Vi tycker arbetslivet ska vara hållbart över tid och erbjuder flexibilitet och goda villkor för våra anställda.     På Sveriges a-kassor jobbar vi med att vidareutveckla och förvalta de IT-system som a-kassorna nyttjar i sitt dagliga arbete med att administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen för sina medlemmar.  Vi söker nu en erfaren systemtestare som ska förstärka vår testgrupp. Du kommer att arbeta i en stimulerande miljö hos en viktig samhällsaktör med mycket bra villkor och goda möjligheter att påverka dina arbetsuppgifter och utveckla dig själv. title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Test Engineer

description:
Siehe AufDU KANNST FOTOGRAFIEREN?

BEWEIS ES UNS.

YAMMY sucht eine:n Fotograf:in in Hamburg für YAMMY ORIGINALS.
Kein Studio nötig.
Kein Abschluss nötig.
Keine zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung nötig.
Eigentlich ist uns ziemlich egal, was in deinem Lebenslauf steht.
Wir wollen sehen, wie du die Welt siehst.
Das Start-Up YAMMY ist Hamburgs coolste und fairste Bestellplattform. Und weil wir
keinen Bock auf die immer gleichen Hochglanzbilder von perfekt ausgeleuchteten
Burgern und Menschen mit Serviette überm Arm haben, bauen wir unsere eigene
Bildwelt auf.

YAMMY ORIGINALS.
Wir ziehen durch unsere Partnerrestaurants und fotografieren das, was dort wirklich
passiert.
Pizza fliegt durch die Luft.
Mehl hängt noch in der Küche.
Flammen kommen aus dem Wok.
Jemand beißt gerade irgendwo rein.
Zwei Leute lachen hinterm Tresen.
Ein Teller ist schon halb leer.
Kein Set. Keine Inszenierung. Kein „Bitte alle lächeln“.
Wir suchen Street Photography im und rund ums Restaurant.
Rough. Nah dran. Spontan. Ein bisschen 90s. Gerne Blitz. Gerne Körnung. Gerne
Bewegung. Handyshot-Vibe, nur eben mit einer guten Kamera.

WIE DER JOB AUSSIEHT
Zum Start bekommst du ein ausführliches YAMMY Originals Briefing mit
Beispielbildern, Moodboard und allem, was du für die Shootings wissen musst.
Du bekommst von uns eine Route mit YAMMY Partnerrestaurants in Hamburg. Die
Restaurants sind vorab gebrieft, du wirst also wissen, wo du hinmusst, und vor Ort
erwartet. Wahrscheinlich musst du dafür eine YAMMY-Cap tragen. Wichtigste
Qualifikation also: Dir müssen Caps stehen.
Dann heißt es:
Rein. Kurz gucken. Fotografieren. Weiter.
Pro Restaurant ungefähr 5 bis 10 Minuten. Kein Licht aufbauen, keine halbe Küche
umräumen, kein großes Shooting daraus machen. Im Idealfall schaffen wir an einem
Tag ungefähr 20 bis 25 Restaurants.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part is not the software, it is that every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that is where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

Forward Deployed Engineering is how we close that gap. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. You are one of the first FDEs at Tacto, so you are not slotting into a playbook, you are writing it while shipping in real accounts.

Your Tasks

Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents, and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data.

Own the technical side of a deployment. Extraction, mapping, validation, enrichment, until the customer's procurement team can actually work with the result.

Be in the room, on site. Run data workshops with key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

Turn what you learn at the edge into product. Document the pattern and push it to Product and Engineering instead of quietly rebuilding the same one-off for the next customer.

Automate your own job. If a step in a deployment can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

Make it one team. Hold the boundary with Solution Engineering and Customer Value so the customer experiences one Tacto, not three.

title: QA Manager Operations
description: Voor onze productielocatie Almere zijn we op zoek naar een QA Manager Operations. Onze producten moeten niet alleen lekker zijn, maar ook van de allerbeste kwaliteit. Als QA Manager Operations ga jij samen met jouw team het QA-beleid van onze Bouter Borrelgemak productielocatie in Almere verder ontwikkelen, borgen en implementeren.   Wat ga je doen?   Jij hebt een belangrijke rol: je bent verantwoordelijk voor het formuleren, handhaven en uitbouwen van het vastgestelde kwaliteits- en voedselveiligheidsbeleid voor onze productielocatie in Almere. Dit doe je samen met jouw QA Operations team van 3 QA medewerkers. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een grote QA afdeling (17 medewerkers) en rapporteert aan de QA Manager divisie Borrelgemak. Jouw team staat op nummer één en krijgt de coaching en begeleiding die nodig is. Daarnaast zijn er veel projecten en productintroducties, wat zorgt voor een dynamische werkomgeving.  Jij bent hét aanspreekpunt wat betreft QA-zaken en voedselveiligheidscalamiteiten. In deze rol werk je veel samen met de afdelingen Productie, Logistiek en TD van de site Almere. Je levert een essentiële bijdrage aan de bewaking en implementatie van kwaliteits- en voedselveiligheidsstandaarden. Je initieert, organiseert, begeleidt en voert root cause analyses en interne audits uit om continu te verbeteren. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor alle voorkomende QA-werkzaamheden, zoals klachtenbehandeling, het uitvoeren van onderzoeken, het opstellen van trendanalyses, overzichten en rapportages en je bewaakt en implementeert wet- en regelgeving.   Wie ben jij?      Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding richting levensmiddelentechnologie of vergelijkbaar;   Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in soortgelijke QA functie(s) binnen een grote levensmiddelenproductie omgeving;   Je hebt kennis van normering, wetgeving, HACCP en kwaliteits- en voedselveiligheidssystemen;   Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift;   Je hebt aantoonbare leidinggevende ervaring (pré) of hebt sterke ambities om een leidinggevende rol te gaan vervullen;   Je bent een zelfstarter die implementatie- en verbeterprocessen aanstuurt op resultaat;   Je werkt graag samen, bent communicatief vaardig, proactief en nauwkeurig.     Waar ga je werken?   Bouter Group is onderdeel van Royal A-ware Food Group. Royal A-ware bedient haar klanten wereldwijd in de segmenten Retail, Food Service en Industrie. Royal A-ware is een groeiend internationaal familiebedrijf met circa 3,2 miljard omzet. Samen met ruim 3.000 collega's maken we op ruim 27 locaties over de hele wereld de lekkerste dagverse zuivel, room, tapas, melkpoeder en allerlei soorten kaas. Bij ons werk je in een hecht team en ben jij, samen met je team, hét aanspreekpunt binnen onze organisatie waar de klantwens centraal staat.   Wat bieden wij?      Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van jouw werkervaring, met laptop en telefoon;   Een reiskostenver

title: Automation & Quality Specialist
description: Job Description:     Are you a skilled and detail-oriented tester with a passion for delivering high-quality digital solutions?   At Satair, we are looking for a Backend API Automation Tester who will ensure our e-commerce platform and underlying services meet the highest standards of functionality, performance, and reliability. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on building robust automation frameworks and ensuring that the "engine" of our digital ecosystem is flawless.  The position will be located in Copenhagen, Denmark.   What The Job Is...   You'll play a crucial role in shaping the quality of our platform by leveraging your expertise in backend automation, security validation, and defect analysis. You will work closely with developers, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure our backend services are scalable and resilient, contributing directly to our mission of delivering seamless customer experience.   Key Responsibilities:     Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks specifically for backend services and APIs.  API Automation: Create and execute sophisticated API tests using Playwright .Security & Auth: Automate complex authentication flows, including OAuth, JWT, and API keys, to ensure secure service-to-service communication.  Validation: Validate RESTful (and SOAP) APIs for functionality, performance, and schema integrity (JSON/XML).  CI/CD Integration: Implement and manage automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable continuous quality.  Defect Management: Analyze test results, identify root causes of defects, and collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolutions.  Strategy & Documentation: Develop comprehensive test cases, test plans, and data strategies for backend systems, ensuring high test coverage and clear API documentation.  Full Lifecycle Testing: Conduct regression, smoke and integration testing to support frequent production releases.     How You Will Contribute To The Team     Technical Expertise: 5-7 years of experience in backend/API testing with deep hands-on experience in Playwright.  Scripting Skills: Proficiency in automation scripting using JavaScript or TypeScript.  Protocol Mastery: Solid understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, headers, status codes and version control (Git).  Agile Knowledge: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira and modern test management tools like XRAY, HP ALM, Practi Test.  Problem-Solving Mindset: A proactive approach to identifying bottlenecks and optimizing automation frameworks for speed and reliability.  Stakeholder Acumen: Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical backend requirements and business needs.  Collaboration: Ability to work within diverse teams and foster a positive, solutions-oriented environment.     Nice to Have     Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or K6.  ISTQB Foundation Certification.  Experience with E-commerce platform architectures.

description: Meet the Team  The Cisco Lysaker Platform team are looking for a creative and curious Embedded Software Test Engineer to join our QA team. You will be working closely with other test engineers as well as embedded software, hardware, camera and audio teams to develop the next Cisco collaboration video products.  Your Impact  We are a team of creative software engineers, trying to uncover where the weak points of our technology are, and how they can be addressed. You will be part of a team with a variety of tasks, ranging from early prototype testing to developing automated tests for various regression testing of released products. This includes participating in creating new solutions for test setups and contributing to the development of new video collaboration products.   In This Role, You Will     Be an important part of the product development process, testing functionality and giving feedback  Participate in test development  Be a key driver for the quality of our products  Be responsible for qualitative, ad hoc and exploratory testing, configuring test setups, digging through logs, analyzing data and troubleshooting technical problems  Work closely with colleagues from multiple disciplines to achieve our common goal of developing high quality products     Minimum Qualifications     A degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (CS, CE, EE or similar)  Experience with Python  Experience with automated testing for embedded software     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with embedded development  Attention to details and quality  Creative problem solving and troubleshooting skills  Like to share your knowledge and are willing to learn and adapt  Ability to communicate clearly and effectively in English    Why Cisco?  At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.  Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.  We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Over time, and depending on how the role and the person develop, it may also grow to include people-leadership responsibilities. The teams keep a high degree of autonomy over how they build and test, while you set the broader quality direction, own the shared practices and  tooling, and keep quality engineering strong and coherent across the organization. You'll work in close partnership with the Principal Engineer, Engineering Managers and product teams. Part of what makes the role interesting is shaping how Finnair approaches quality going forward, including where AI-assisted testing genuinely helps. title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (계약직)
description: 회사 소개   쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다. 쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다. 대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다. 보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.      직무 소개   쿠팡페이의 QA (SDET) 엔지니어는 프로덕트 사양, 기술 구현, UI 설계, 기능 및 성능 측면에서 제품의 품질을 평가하여 업무와 관련된 팀에게 의미 있는 피드백 및 프로덕트 품질 향상을 위한 업무를 진행합니다. 쿠팡페이의 QA 엔지니어는 프로덕트 배포 이전의 중요한 게이트키퍼 역할을 담당합니다.      업무 내용     Test Strategy and Planning  - 제품 요구사항과 기술적 위험을 기반으로 테스트 범위와 자동화 전략을 수립합니다. 테스트 대상의 우선순위와 완료 기준을 정의하고, 회사의 품질 기준 및 관련 규제 요구사항이 테스트 계획에 반영될 수 있도록 합니다.   Test Automation Development  - Selenium, Appium, Playwright 등의 도구를 활용하여 UI, 모바일 및 API 테스트 자동화 프레임워크와 테스트 코드를 설계하고 구현합니다. 반복적인 수작업 테스트를 줄이고 테스트 커버리지와 테스트 코드의 재사용성 및 유지보수성을 높입니다.   CI/CD Pipeline Integration  - 자동화 테스트를 CI/CD 파이프라인에 통합하고 테스트 실행 조건 및 품질 게이트를 구성합니다. 테스트 결과를 신속하게 피드백하여 결함을 조기에 발견하고 안정적인 배포를 지원합니다.   API and End-to-End Testing  - 실제 사용자 및 결제 시나리오를 기반으로 API와 End-to-End(E2E) 테스트를 설계하고 수행합니다. 정상 결제뿐만 아니라 실패, 취소, 환불, 재처리 등 주요 예외 흐름과 시스템 간 연동의 안정성을 검증합니다.   Test Data Management  - 여러 도메인에 걸친 결제 플랫폼 테스트에 적합하도록 테스트 데이터의 정확성, 최신성 및 적합성을 유지하며 관리합니다.   Collaborate with Cross-functional Teams  - 엔지니어링 팀과 긴밀히 협력하여 테스트 요구사항을 정의하고 테스트의 우선순위를 설정하며, 각 스프린트에 품질이 내재화될 수 있도록 보장합니다.       자격   요건    5년 이상의 소프트웨어 엔지니어 또는 테스터 경력이 있는 분  소프트웨어 개발 라이프 사이클(Software Development Life Cycle) 전반에 걸쳐 품질관리 경험이 있는 분  소프트웨어 QA 엔지니어링 또는 SDET(Software Development Engineer in Test) 경력이 1년 이상인 분  자동화 테스트 툴(Selenium, Appium, Device Farm, TestNG or Pytest 또는 유사한 관련툴) 경험이 있는 분  프로그래밍 언어에 대한 기본 지식이 있으신 분 (Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java 등)       우대   사항    결제 도메인에서의 근무 경력이 있는 분  QA팀을 운영하고 리드한 경험을 보유한 분  영어로 기본적인 업무 소통 및 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분  유연하고 독립적으로 업무가 가능하고, 자기 동기 부여가 가능한 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 여러 경쟁 우선 순위를 처리 할 수 있는 능력이 있는 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항     전형절차 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.   참고사항 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.       개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/       서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청

title: Sr. Staff Supplier Quality Engineer
description: At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality. title: Software Architect - Mobile Apps (w/m/d)
description: Als führende Schweizer E-Commerce-Plattform, mit einem Team von über 4’000 Mitarbeitenden in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Serbien, sind wir auf dem Weg in neue Märkte. Unser Motor dafür ist der Wille, Bestehendes immer wieder neu zu denken. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die mit Leidenschaft daran arbeiten, Dinge wirklich besser zu machen. Bei uns findest du die Freiheit und das Vertrauen, eigenverantwortlich zu handeln, mit uns zu wachsen und dabei ganz du selbst zu sein.  Handle galaktisch. Und bleib du.      Als Software Architect von Team Appic bist du die treibende Kraft hinter der technischen Weiterentwicklung unserer Mobile Apps. Ti occuperai dell'analisi, definizione e implementazione di controlli di qualità del dato, sviluppando regole di validazione e monitoraggio per garantire affidabilità, coerenza e qualità delle informazioni. Lingua inglese     Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (livello B2)     Modalità e/o Sede di Lavoro   Full Remote. Unisciti a MC Engineering: dove le idee diventano innovazione! description: Nous vous proposons de rejoindre notre entité  Digital Testing  composée de  spécialistes des métiers de la QA  (fonctionnelle, non fonctionnelle : sécurité & performance, automatisation de tests) et  consultants fonctionnels  (BA, analystes fonctionnels, PPO, PO).  Notre équipe œuvre au quotidien pour accompagner nos clients dans la validation & l’optimisation de vos applications digitales, web & mobiles.   Le leitmotiv de notre team ? Garantir à nos clients des applications conformes aux besoins des utilisateurs finaux, reflétant l'excellence et l'innovation que nos clients attendent.   Vous souhaitez intervenir sur des environnements digitaux à fort trafic, porter une vision qualité transverse et accompagner des équipes produit dans leur montée en maturité ? Cette opportunité est faite pour vous !   Vos missions :   Nous recherchons un·e  Lead QA   disponible rapidement ( ASAP/1 mois)  , pour accompagner l’un de nos clients dans le pilotage et l’évolution de sa  stratégie qualité  au sein d’un environnement digital structuré autour de plusieurs équipes produit, design et tech.  Vous interviendrez dans un contexte à fort enjeu où la qualité constitue un levier clé de performance, d’expérience utilisateur et d’excellence opérationnelle.  Vous intégrerez une organisation pluridisciplinaire et jouerez un rôle central dans l’animation de la qualité à l’échelle. Définir les indicateurs qualité et assurer leur suivi dans une logique d’amélioration continue.  Mettre en place les rituels de pilotage et mesurer l’adoption des pratiques qualité.  Identifier les risques qualité, évaluer leur criticité et construire les plans de mitigation associés.  Accompagner l’évolution du patrimoine de tests vers davantage d’anticipation, d’automatisation et d’industrialisation.  Participer à la construction d’une approche qualité adaptée aux nouveaux usages et aux opportunités offertes par l’IA.      Animer et accompagner les équipes :     Coordonner les activités QA avec les équipes internes et partenaires externes.  Organiser et piloter les campagnes de tests fonctionnels avec les équipes produit et développement.  Accompagner les équipes dans l’application des standards qualité et leur montée en maturité.  Auditer les pratiques existantes et contribuer à renforcer la culture qualité.  Favoriser l’alignement entre autonomie des équipes et cohérence transverse.      Porter l’automatisation et l’excellence opérationnelle :     Maintenir et faire évoluer les frameworks de tests automatisés End-to-End.  Renforcer l’intégration des tests dans les pipelines CI/CD.  Garantir la robustesse, la fiabilité et la maintenabilité des solutions d’automatisation.      Outillage, gouvernance et amélioration continue :     Garantir l’alignement avec les standards qualité : stratégie de tests

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Manager to Nanexa AB
description: Nanexa is now recruiting a Quality Assurance (QA) Manager. The position is full-time and based at our headquarters in Uppsala, and we are looking for a new colleague to join our growing organisation.  As a QA Manager at Nanexa, you will play a key role in building and shaping the quality function in a growing pharmaceutical company. This is not a traditional QA role in a large organisation – instead, you will be part of a small, highly skilled team where your contributions will have a direct and visible impact on how we work and grow. title: Funktionsleder til Kvalitet, Regionsapoteket Midtjylland
description: Vil du stå i spidsen for kvaliteten bag kritiske lægemidler til Region Midtjyllands borgere ?   På Regionsapoteket Midtjylland arbejder vi hver dag for, at patienterne får den rigtige medicin i den rigtige kvalitet og til tiden. Kvalitetsfunktionen spiller en central rolle i denne opgave. Nu søger vi en funktionsleder, der kan stå i spidsen for funktionen og være med til at sætte retning og styrke samarbejdet med produktionsfunktionerne og resten af Regionsapoteket.     Du får ansvar for en fagligt stærk funktion med en central rolle i forhold til kvalitetssikring, frigivelse, afvigelseshåndtering og faglig sparring. Samtidig træder du ind i en funktion, hvor der er behov for en leder, som kan skabe retning, stabile rammer og stærke samarbejdsrelationer.      Din rolle i en livsvigtig opgave   I Kvalitet arbejder vi for at sikre, at vi på Regionsapoteket producerer, leverer og rådgiver om lægemidler i overensstemmelse med gældende lovgivning. Funktionen understøtter hver eneste dag en livsvigtig opgave, hvor patientsikkerhed og faglig kvalitet er nødvendig for, at patienter og hospitalspersonale kan have tillid til lægemiddelbehandlingen.     Kvalitetsfunktionen består af 24 medarbejdere, som arbejder inden for både kvalitetskontrol (QC) og kvalitetssikring (QA). Medarbejdergruppen rummer både akademikere med naturvidenskabelig baggrund, farmakonomer, laboranter og en serviceassistent. Funktionen understøtter Regionsapoteket og arbejder i en reguleret kontekst, hvor kravene til kvalitet, dokumentation og patientsikkerhed er høje.      "Regionsapotekets strategiske ambition er at sikre sammenhæng og kvalitet i borgernes medicinske behandling. Det stiller krav til stærkt samarbejde, meningsfuld kvalitetssikring og løbende udvikling på tværs af apoteket. Derfor søger vi en funktionsleder, der kan oversætte og formidle retning for en fagligt stærk funktion og samtidig møde opgaven med en åben, pragmatisk, udviklende og samarbejdende tilgang til både medarbejdere, drift og resten af apoteket. Du kommer til at tegne og agere som rollemodel for vores kvalitetsfunktion."    Charlotte Quist Bjørn, Chef for Kvalitet og IT.       De vigtigste opgaver    Lede kvalitetsfunktionen og skabe tydelige rammer, retning og prioritering.  Lede og udvikle afdelingens 24 medarbejdere på tværs af QA- og QC-opgaver med blik for både trivsel og resultater.  Sikre kvalitet, værdiskabende myndighedsefterlevelse og understøttelse af organisationen og produktionen.  Styrke samarbejdet med organisationen og med dine ledelseskolleger.  Udvikle arbejdsgange og organisering, så ressourcer og kompetencer anvendes bedst muligt.  Være en nysgerrig, nærværende og lyttende leder - med både handlekraft og omtanke.       Hvem er du?    Vi forestiller os, at du:    Har erfaring med personaleledelse af fagligt stærke og specialiserede medarbejdere.  Har erfaring med kvalitetsarbejde i en reguleret kontekst, f.eks. inden for QA, QC, GMP, lægemiddelproduktion eller beslægtede områder.

Je helpt de organisatie bij het ontwerpen en realiseren van een toekomstbestendige testaanpak. Je werkt op het snijvlak van architectuur, techniek en businessprocessen en zorgt ervoor dat onze teststrategie niet alleen goed bedacht is, maar ook daadwerkelijk werkt in de praktijk.  Je bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor onze DevOps teams (waaronder .NET, Outsystems, Dynamics, Front-end en Datateams), architecten en pensioenexperts. Je helpt teams bij het maken van de juiste technische keuzes rondom testautomatisering, testdata, testomgevingen en tooling. Daarnaast stel je richtlijnen en standaarden op die zorgen voor een consistente en schaalbare testaanpak binnen de organisatie.  Met een holistische blik op de gehele keten kijk je niet alleen naar individuele applicaties, maar vooral naar de samenhang tussen systemen en processen. Je analyseert hoe onze pensioenprocessen getest worden, waar overlap of hiaten zitten en helpt teams om de testdekking te verbeteren. Zo zorg je ervoor dat kritische processen end-to-end goed afgedekt zijn, zonder dat verschillende teams onnodig hetzelfde testen.  Daarnaast ondersteun je teams bij de selectie en implementatie van testtools en help je bij het opzetten van praktische oplossingen die ontwikkelteams ontzorgen. Je helpt teams bij het implementeren van praktische oplossingen voor testautomatisering en kwaliteitsborging.     Uiteraard valt er nog veel meer te vertellen, dit doen we graag tijdens een kennismaking! Im Zuge unserer weiteren Expansion konzentrieren wir uns darauf, unsere operativen Kapazitäten zu stärken, unsere Systeme und Prozesse zu skalieren und eine leistungsstarke Organisation aufzubauen, die sich durch außergewöhnliche Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Kundenzufriedenheit auszeichnet.   An unserem Standort in Graz beschäftigen wir rund 38 Mitarbeiter*innen in den Bereichen Technik, Operations und Vertrieb, und wir gehen davon aus, dass wir in den kommenden Jahren weiter wachsen werden.   Bei Headwall verbinden wir fundiertes technologisches Fachwissen mit einer von Zusammenarbeit geprägten und bodenständigen Unternehmenskultur. Wir schätzen Neugierde mehr als Hierarchien, Teamarbeit mehr als Ego und praktische Lösungen mehr als unnötige Komplexität. Unsere Führungskräfte sind zugänglich, praxisorientiert und eng mit ihren Teams verbunden. Wenn Du gerne Strukturen aufbaust und dabei den Kontakt zu den Menschen und zum Geschäft im Blick behältst, wirst Du Dich bei uns wie zu Hause fühlen.    Deine Chance, Wirkung zu entfalten    Wir suchen eine*n Head of Operations & Quality, die bzw. der unser Führungsteam am Standort Graz verstärkt und eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung der nächsten Phase unserer Unternehmensentwicklung spielt.   Nach unserer Integration in eine internationale, von Private-Equity-Fonds finanzierte Unternehmensgruppe ist diese Position entscheidend für den Aufbau einer leistungsstarken, strukturierten und skalierbaren Betriebsfunktion, die den Anforderungen eines wachsenden globalen Unternehmens gerecht wird. Als Mitglied des Standort-Führungsteams arbeitest Du eng mit Kolleg*innen aus verschiedenen Funktionsbereichen in einem von starker Zusammenarbeit geprägten und flachen Hierarchiemodell zusammen.   Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Qualität, Lieferketten, Fertigung und  exzellente Prozesse und Abläufe und etablierst gleichzeitig die Systeme, Prozesse und Arbeitsweisen, die es den Teams ermöglichen, ihre beste Leistung zu erbringen und nachhaltiges Wachstum zu unterstützen.   Es handelt sich um eine zentrale Führungsposition, in der Du eng mit dem Geschäftsführer Paul Fuchs und den globalen Führungsteams zusammenarbeitest.   Wir suchen eine praxisorientierte und zugängliche Führungskraft, die Freude daran hat, Organisationen aufzubauen und zu verbessern, Mitarbeiter*innen zu fördern und eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, der Verantwortlichkeit und der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung zu pflegen. Titel sind für uns weniger wichtig als Neugier und die gemeinsame Umsetzung von Zielen.  Aufgaben   Aufbau & Leitung des Bereichs Operations      Aufbau und Leitung eines robusten, KPI-gesteuerten Betriebssystems einschließlich Dashboards, Leistungsbeurteilungen und klarer Governance-Strukturen

title: Programme Test Manager - Contractor
description: About Us   At Westpac New Zealand, our purpose is to Help New Zealanders Succeed. As a Bank and one of New Zealand's leading employers, we are passionate about helping people. We are taking action today to create a better future for the people who bank with us, work with us, invest in us or are part of our broader communities.   Mō te tūranga | About the Role    The Programme Test Manager provides independent programme-level assurance that Digital 2.0 delivers an integrated, production-ready ecosystem of customer-facing and technology-facing services.  The role operates from an end-to-end customer journey and business process perspective, ensuring solutions deliver the intended customer, operational and business outcomes.  The role champions modern Quality Engineering practices, embedding quality through automation, continuous testing, Shift Left principles and risk-based assurance.  Working across all Digital 2.0 delivery streams, the role provides leadership with a clear, evidence-based view of quality, readiness and residual risk while enabling delivery teams to own quality outcomes.  The role will leverage existing quality engineering practices, processes and ways of working where they are effective, introducing additional guardrails, standards and practices only where material gaps, inconsistencies or risks are identified.  Delivery teams remain accountable for component-level quality outcomes and execution of testing activities within their scope. The Programme Test Manager provides programme-level governance, assurance, standards, reporting and oversight.   Key Interfaces      Tech Delivery Leads in the compilation of a single integrated delivery plan.   Functional teams of Architecture, UX Design, ISG   Chapter Leads, TALs, SGOs, POs and SOs   Service Transition and Change & Release Management functions   Programme Delivery and Digital Leadership functions.      Success Measures     Leadership has a clear, evidence-based view of programme quality, readiness and residual risk, enabling informed delivery and release decisions.   Delivery teams own quality outcomes, while customer journeys, business processes and integrated services are validated and released with confidence.   Testing practices, governance and evidence remain aligned with WNZL Testing Controls, Standards and audit requirements   SDLC metrics provide transparent visibility of quality, progress, readiness and delivery risk across the programme. description: Accenture’s Global Responsible AI team within the Global Data & AI Practice. AI is becoming more pervasive, more powerful, and more accessible. We work with leading organizations to ensure AI is designed, built, and deployed in a manner that engenders trust and adheres to laws, regulations and ethical norms. title: QA Manager

Je ontwikkelt en stuurt de kwaliteitsorganisatie op hoofdlijnen, waarbij je verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor structuur, mandaat en eigenaarschap, en een organisatiebrede kwaliteitscultuur realiseert. Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om kwaliteit verder te professionaliseren en strategisch te positioneren binnen Hessing. Draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor het kwaliteitsbudget en zorg je voor een effectieve inzet van middelen, waarbij kwaliteit, rendement en kostenbeheersing hand in hand gaan.  Werk je op het snijvlak van operatie, commercie en governance, en maak je afgewogen keuzes die direct bijdragen aan groei en klantvertrouwen.  Heb je de ruimte en het mandaat om organisatiebreed verandering te realiseren, en veranker je kwaliteit als integraal onderdeel van cultuur en besluitvorming.  Ontwikkel je een toekomstbestendige kwaliteitsorganisatie, waarin kwaliteit diep verankerd is in processen, besluitvorming en gedrag en als integraal onderdeel bijdraagt aan sturing, voorspelbaarheid en waardecreatie.  Draag je eindverantwoordelijkheid voor kwaliteit en risico, en waarborg je dat productkwaliteit, audits, certificeringen en compliance structureel aantoonbaar onder controle zijn.  Positioneer je Hessing als toonaangevende en betrouwbare kwaliteitspartner, en vertegenwoordig je de organisatie op strategisch niveau richting klanten, leveranciers en externe stakeholders.  Voer je regie op kwaliteit binnen en buiten de organisatie, en zorg je voor duidelijke kaders, bewustzijn en consistente toepassing van kwaliteit, voedselveiligheid en compliance in alle lagen van de organisatie.  Veranker je kwaliteit in commerciële besluitvorming, en zorg je dat klantverwachtingen en contractuele afspraken consistent worden vertaald naar organisatiebrede standaarden en kaders.  Voer je regie op de samenhang tussen Commercie, Operations en Kwaliteit, en realiseer je een geïntegreerde werkwijze waarin klantwaarde, uitvoerbaarheid en kwaliteitsperformance structureel in balans zijn.  Realiseer je organisatiebrede samenhang en volwassenheid in kwaliteit, en ontwikkel je een omgeving waarin kennisdeling, uniforme besluitvorming en collectief eigenaarschap vanzelfsprekend zijn. title: Senior Quality Assurance Manager

Als QA Manager ben je een belangrijke sparringpartner voor het management en werk je nauw samen met productie, supply chain, maintenance en andere afdelingen. Je combineert inhoudelijke kennis van kwaliteit en voedselveiligheid met sterk people management en weet een ervaren team mee te nemen in veranderingen en verbeteringen. Daarnaast krijg je volop ruimte om processen te optimaliseren en bij te dragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de productielocatie. Binnen de organisatie heerst een professionele en internationale cultuur met korte lijnen. Als QA Manager rapporteer je aan de Quality Manager EMEA en werk je nauw samen met de Plant Manager en andere leden van het Management Team. Personaldisponent (m/w/d) – Kunden gewinnen, Talente platzieren

Du willst nicht drei Jahre lang zuarbeiten, bevor dir jemand ein eigenes Kundensegment anvertraut? Dann solltest du weiterlesen.

In vielen Häusern wirst du erst einmal in einer Nische geparkt: entweder Vertrieb oder Besetzung, sauber getrennt, und der Wechsel dauert. Wir halten das für Zeitverschwendung. Als Personaldisponent (m/w/d) verantwortest du bei uns die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette – du sprichst Unternehmen an, verstehst ihr Personalproblem, verkaufst die passende Lösung und bringst sie danach selbst zum Erfolg. Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Herzen von Bielefeld. Wir sorgen dafür, dass unsere Kunden als Arbeitgeber sichtbar werden und verlässlich passende Bewerbungen bekommen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Hoffnungsprinzip.   • Zwei Kompetenzen, ein Profil: Du wirst gleichzeitig im Vertrieb und in der Personalgewinnung stark.
  • Einarbeitung mit System: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Trainings in Akquise, Beratung und Besetzung sowie feste Feedbackgespräche statt Sprung ins kalte Wasser.

title: Senior AI Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
As an AI Software Engineer (m/f/d), you will be a key contributor to our AI and perception stack, bringing advanced computer vision and sensor processing capabilities onto real-world unmanned systems. At Quantum Systems, we build intelligent aerial, maritime and ground-based platforms that operate under real constraints - where performance, reliability, and seamless integration are critical.

 

Working closely with our ML team, as well as experts from flight testing, embedded software, you will take ownership of integrating and improving AI-driven functionalities across the full system. This is not a purely algorithmic role - you will bridge the gap between models and deployment, ensuring they run efficiently on embedded hardware and interact reliably with sensors, gimbals, and control systems.

 

In a fast-scaling, engineering-driven environment, you will play a key role in turning prototypes into robust, field-ready capabilities, contributing directly to our mission of transforming decision-making through autonomous, data-driven unmanned systems.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Bring Computer Vision algorithms from concept and prototype into production-ready capabilities deployed on real-world unmanned systems.

  • Integrate sensors, gimbals, and payloads into a robust and scalable software architecture.

  • Design, implement and test advanced Computer Vision algorithms that run on embedded devices

  • Work closely with ML engineers to integrate, validate, and improve perception capabilities in real-world environments.

  • Improve system performance, reliability, and resource utilization on real hardware.

  • Collaborate closely with Flight Testing, Ground Control, Embedded Software, and Product teams to bring new capabilities into the field.

title: Senior Technical Procurement Specialist- PCBs/ Electronics (m/f/d)
description:
As a Senior Technical Procurement Specialist – PCBs / Electronics, you are responsible for the end-to-end procurement of printed circuit boards (PCBs) through our manufacturing partners (Contract Manufacturers, CMs). You work at the interface between Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production, translating technical requirements into clear supplier packages, negotiating costs and lead times, and ensuring that the right boards are available on time and at the required quality level.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how PCBs are actually manufactured (stack-ups, materials, tolerances, DFM) and enjoys the commercial and operational aspects of bringing products to life at scale.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  •  Own PCB procurement end-to-end – from RFQ and quote analysis through PO creation, order tracking, delivery, and closure.

  •   Translate engineering needs into supplier-ready data – review BOMs, Gerbers, stackups, drawings, and specifications to ensure CMs have complete and correct information.

  • Manage contract manufacturers – build strong relationships, align on capabilities and capacity, and drive performance on cost, quality, lead time, and responsiveness, including on-site visits of contract manufacturers

  • Optimize cost and lead time – run competitive RFQs, analyze trade-offs (volume, lead time, technology level), and negotiate pricing and terms with CMs.

  • Mitigate supply and technical risks – monitor material availability (e.g. laminates, copper weights, finishes), propose alternates, and escalate issues before they become schedule slips.

As part of our Avionics & Software team in Munich, you will help define and mature the avionics and electrical systems of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with our Systems Architects and specialist teams in electronics, embedded software and controls, you will ensure that avionics equipment and subsystems form a coherent and verifiable overall system. This is a systems engineering role with a strong technical focus. You are not expected to be the implementation expert for every avionics domain.

Your role will include

  • Define, manage and maintain spacecraft avionics and electrical system requirements.
  • Coordinate interfaces between spacecraft equipment, electronics, embedded software, control systems and higher-level spacecraft functions.
  • Support avionics architecture development together with Systems Architects and technical specialists.
  • Perform and document equipment and make-or-buy trade studies, for example for OBCs, PCDUs, solar arrays, sensors, communication equipment and remote I/O.
  • Translate selected equipment into clear electrical, data and software interface requirements.

Binnen het nieuw op te zetten TestLAB werk je aan het fundament van professioneel en toekomstbestendig kwaliteitsmanagement. Je zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe functionaliteiten, ketenwijzigingen, platformvernieuwingen en technische innovaties gecontroleerd, betrouwbaar en met de juiste kwaliteit worden opgeleverd. Daarbij werk je aan meer dan alleen het uitvoeren van testen. Je denkt mee over teststrategieën, kwaliteitsborging, testautomatisering en de verdere professionalisering van het testvak binnen SSC-ICT.  Je werkt nauw samen met domein-architecten, ontwikkelaars, engineers, projectteams en gebruikersvertegenwoordigers. Samen zorg je ervoor dat kwaliteit vanaf het begin onderdeel is van het ontwikkel- en veranderproces. Met jouw expertise maak je risico's inzichtelijk, toets je oplossingen aan de gestelde eisen en draag je bij aan een uniforme en volwassen testaanpak binnen de organisatie.  Een greep uit je werkzaamheden:    Opstellen van teststrategieën, testplannen en testaanpakken voor complexe IT-oplossingen en verandertrajecten.  Ontwerpen en uitvoeren van risk based testscenario's, testgevallen en testdata op basis van requirements en user stories.  Uitvoeren van systeemtesten, ketentesten, end to end-testen, regressietesten, acceptatietesten en niet-functionele testen.  Opzetten, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van testautomatisering met moderne tooling.  Uitvoeren van API-testen en valideren van integraties tussen systemen en ketens.  Adviseren over kwaliteitsrisico's, testresultaten en vrijgavebeslissingen.  Verbeteren en standaardiseren van testprocessen, werkwijzen en rapportages.  Samenwerken binnen Agile- en DevOps-teams en bijdragen aan Continuous Integration en Continuous Testing.  Meebouwen aan het TestLAB en bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van kwaliteitsmanagement binnen SSC-ICT.  Samen met architecten en inhoudelijk specialisten kaders en richtlijnen opstellen voor heel SSC-ICT.  Delen van kennis en het stimuleren van kwaliteitsbewustzijn binnen teams en projecten.    Wil jij bouwen aan een toekomstbestendig TestLAB en bijdragen aan betrouwbare digitale dienstverlening voor de Rijksoverheid? Dan zien we jouw sollicitatie graag tegemoet.  Jouw werkzaamheden sluiten aan op het KWIV-profiel 2.2.1 TESTMANAGEMENT.  Meer informatie over KWIV-profielen vind je op: Kwaliteitsraamwerk Informatiev

description: Diese Aufgaben erwarten Sie    In dieser verantwortungsvollen Führungsposition treiben die Weiterentwicklung unserer Qualitätsorganisation an den Standorten Rheinbach, Meiningen und Slowakei maßgeblich voran. title: Quality Assurance Manager
description: Voor een internationale producent in de food packaging zoeken we een QHSE Manager die kwaliteit, voedselveiligheid en veiligheid verder brengt in de dagelijkse operatie.  Je komt terecht in een sterk geautomatiseerde 24/7-productieomgeving. Quality staat hier niet op afstand van de fabriek. Je werkt nauw samen met productie, maintenance en engineering en bent onderdeel van het lokale managementteam.  De basis is aanwezig. Managementsystemen, certificeringen en digitale kwaliteitsprocessen staan. De uitdaging zit vooral in het verder ontwikkelen ervan, het versterken van het team en het vertalen van data, afwijkingen en risico's naar concrete verbeteringen op de werkvloer.      Wat ga je doen?   Je geeft leiding aan het QHSE-team en bent eindverantwoordelijk voor Quality, Food Safety en Health & Safety op de locatie.  Daarbij houd je je onder andere bezig met:   Borgen en verder ontwikkelen van FSSC 22000, ISO 45001 en ISO 15343.  Leiden en ontwikkelen van het QHSE-team.  Voorbereiden en begeleiden van interne, externe en certificeringsaudits.  Analyseren van afwijkingen en structureel verbeteren vanuit RCA, 8D, FMEA en andere quality tools.  Uitvoeren en bewaken van HACCP, VACCP en TACCP-risicoanalyses.  Sturen op QHSE KPI's en vertalen van data naar verbeteracties.  Verder ontwikkelen en digitaliseren van kwaliteitsprocessen.  Samenwerken met productie, maintenance en engineering aan procesverbeteringen.  Ondersteunen van trials, nieuwe producten en technische veranderingen vanuit QHSE.  Verder ontwikkelen van veiligheid, risicobeheersing en preventie binnen de plant.   Dit is daarmee geen rol waarin je voornamelijk audits voorbereidt en procedures beheert. Je bent zichtbaar in de operatie en zorgt dat kwaliteit en veiligheid daadwerkelijk onderdeel zijn van hoe er geproduceerd en verbeterd wordt.      Wat krijg je?    €5.500 tot €6.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.  Jaarlijkse bonusregeling.  30 vakantiedagen.  Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf de eerste kilometer.  Flexibele werktijden.  Vitaliteitsregeling, fietsplan en bedrijfsfysiotherapeut.  Een leidinggevende QHSE-positie met directe invloed op de operatie.  Veel ruimte om processen, systemen en het team verder te ontwikkelen.       Waar kom je terecht?   De productielocatie in Elst maakt onderdeel uit van een internationale producent van verpakkingsoplossingen voor grote foodmerken.  De omgeving is technisch, sterk geautomatiseerd en continu in beweging. Productie, Quality, maintenance en engineering werken nauw met elkaar samen en de lijnen zijn kort. Veel kwaliteitsprocessen zijn al gedigitaliseerd, waardoor de volgende stap niet zit in meer administratie, maar juist in betere borging, analyse en verbetering.  De cultuur is open en pragmatisch. Dat vraagt om een QHSE Manager die inhoudelijk stevig genoeg is om richting te geven, maar net zo makkelijk de productievloer opstapt om samen met collega's een probleem op te lossen. title: Software Quality Engineer

If so, you could be the perfect fit for this exciting  Software Quality Engineer  role at DEIF A/S.  At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than  700 dedicated employees worldwide , we push boundaries, set new standards in energy efficiency and conversion, and work towards becoming the market leader in intelligent energy control. Integrating automated regression tests into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous validation of core product functionality.  Enhancing regression coverage using risk‑based testing approaches and reusable automation frameworks tailored to product workflows. title: Python Engineer (Robotics & Autonomous Systems)
