A fast-growing  robotics and autonomous systems company  in Oslo is hiring several Senior Python Engineers to join our core team. This isn't a traditional support function. You will be building high-impact, production-quality internal platforms, test automation frameworks, and infrastructure that directly bridge the gap between Python development, DevOps, and cutting-edge hardware.     If you care deeply about code quality, system reliability, and creating developer environments that surface failures instead of hiding them, we want to hear from you!     💡 What You Will Be Doing    Production Python Development:  Spend the majority of your time writing and improving clean, maintainable Python code across automation, developer tooling, and supporting infrastructure.   Test Infrastructure & Automation:  Build robust end-to-end test suites and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test setups that mimic real operational behavior.   Platform Design:  Design scalable, resilient backend systems that improve overall engineering quality and hold up as the company grows.   Cross-Functional Impact:  Work close to real-world physical products, building the exact platforms an engineering organization of ~40 people relies on daily.      🎯 Essential Requirements    Python Expertise:  4+ years of professional experience developing with Python.   Environment:  Highly comfortable working in Linux-heavy environments.   Quality Focus:  A "quality-first" mindset with a genuine motivation for end-to-end testing and building reliable systems at scale.   Versatile Background:  Strong backend systems experience.  (ML engineers with rock-solid backend foundations and a genuine interest in infrastructure are also highly encouraged to apply!)    Key Specialization:  Proven experience in either Python-based  Test Automation  OR as a Python Engineer focused on  Developer Tooling / DevOps Tooling / Infrastructure .   ✨ Nice to Have (But Not Required)   Hands-on experience with  CI/CD pipelines, Docker , or modern infrastructure tooling.  Hardware-adjacent or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test automation experience.   🎁 Why You'll Love This Role    Tangible Impact:  Work on fascinating, real-world problems with direct, visible results.   Early-Stage Growth:  Help shape the technical systems, tooling, and culture of a brilliant 40-person team from the ground up.   Strong Package:  Competitive compensation including equity potential, excellent insurance, a top-tier pension plan, and continuous learning budgets.   Culture:  Join a mission-driven team that genuinely values clarity, integrity, and deep technical excellence.

title: AI Integration Engineer
description: About Us   At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Norwegian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.     Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.     We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.      The Opportunity — AI Integration Engineer   This is a  new role at No Isolation , and you'd be the first person in it.  You'll sit inside Engineering but work mostly embedded inside selected internal business units, in contrast to the rest of Engineering. You’ll work with Sales, Customer Success, Finance and Operations. You’ll connect the tools they depend on and implement AI tools and automation flows to positively impact our revenue first and foremost, but also generally enhance internal effectiveness.  In practice:  you set the bar  for how much internal AI and Automation can change the company from the inside in 2026 and beyond, and you co-own the stack you put in place. You will have a lot of direct contact with the teams you're building for, and a lot of say in how the technical side gets structured to enable you, while having the support of experienced software engineers when needed.      What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities     Systems integration:  Drive automation of key business areas and connect our business tools across Data, IAM, CRM, ERP (Odoo) and Finance through APIs, webhooks and events, so data stays in sync across systems.   Internal automation capability:  Build and maintain workflows in Windmill and/or n8n; migrate us off legacy SaaS and iPaaS tools as you go. Aim to articulate as many problems as possible as deterministic automations that keep data and AI cost low.   Internal AI capability:  Contribute to shared infrastructure for using AI internally alongside our cloud/platform engineers: assistants, retrieval over internal knowledge, summarisation, classification, routing, etc. Turn ad hoc AI experiments into tools people can actually rely on, with eval sets in place to catch regressions.   Data & internal foundations:  Centralise data into sources the business can trust, reconcile figures across systems so numbers match wherever they appear, and provide internal tools and lightly-built apps.   Guardrails & cost control:  Define the standards for how integrations and AI get built here. Keep the set of automation platforms small and deliberate (e.g. Windmill, n8n and some custom). Track AI spend and return on investment so we can monitor alignment between the two.   Partnership

description: Job Description Summary   GE Aerospace is hiring an early-career Software Engineer to help our engineers unlock the power of data, cloud, and AI. You will consult on architecture, build proof of concepts, and ship production solutions for strategic business projects — including data science and machine learning systems. Respect for people is core to our culture and to FLIGHT DECK, our proprietary lean operating model, and we cultivate communities where talented people from all backgrounds are empowered to reach their fullest potential.  At GE Aerospace Technology & Operations, our customers challenge us to tackle some of the world's most complex engineering problems using innovative approaches and new technologies. Our engineers depend on software developers to bridge data, tools, and emerging technologies — like cloud and AI — to unlock new possibilities and shape the future of flight.  As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll move beyond proof of concept: you will own solutions end-to-end, from architecture and design through production deployment and support, delivering real business impact for engineering teams across the company.  We are keen on building scalable, long-lasting solutions — software designed to outlive its first release. title: Oil Programme QA Lead
description: Main purpose     The Oil Programme is a signature strategic initiative at Trafigura to implement a new, fully integrated end-to-end trading system for the energy business. It replaces the legacy platform with two interconnected ecosystems:    Atlas — Front Office and Middle Office: trade capture, pricing, deal lifecycle, and logistics workflows.    Titan — downstream finance processing: a dedicated Energy instance of the Titan platform currently under active development.      The two ecosystems share a bidirectional, real-time integration boundary — the highest-risk surface in the programme.    The Oil Programme QA Lead is a programme-level quality assurance role, independent of both delivery teams. It owns end-to-end QA coverage for the full programme: everything that falls outside the scope of the individual Atlas and Titan ecosystem QA leads, plus the integration and coherence between them.  The role is a standing member of the Oil Programme Readiness Group. It has authority to define programme-wide QA standards, set UAT entry and exit criteria, block UAT entry if criteria are not met, and escalate quality risks directly to the Programme Director.     Key responsibilities      Programme-level QA ownership     Own the programme-level QA strategy, incorporating and coordinating the Atlas and Titan ecosystem testing strategies.    Define and maintain the E2E scenario model in partnership with the Product Validation team, ensuring every UAT acceptance criterion maps to tested coverage.    Publish a single, authoritative programme QA status view to delivery leadership and business stakeholders.    Own the escalation path for cross-team defects, coverage disputes, and quality risks.       Cross-ecosystem and integration testing     Define and oversee testing of end-to-end business scenarios spanning both Atlas and Titan.    Own QA coverage for cross-cutting systems such as Hydra that interact with both ecosystems.    Coordinate E2E and performance testing workstreams, sequencing them so UAT entry criteria are met before formal UAT begins.    Identify and close coverage gaps that neither individual ecosystem strategy addresses.       Reporting and data validation     Coordinate the QA workstream for approximately 100 QlikSense reports that consume data from both Atlas and Titan.    Define data validation scenarios and expected outputs; coordinate business sign-off on report accuracy.    Ensure report validation is sequenced and completed before UAT entry.       UAT readiness and governance     Define UAT entry and exit criteria at programme level, based on UAT scenarios and business risk.    Work with Atlas QA Lead and Titan QA Lead to ensure ecosystem-level activities meet programme entry criteria.    Bridge the different testing cadences: Atlas agile sprint-based testing and Titan manual release-cycle-based testing.    Act as standing member of the Oil Programme Readiness Group; contribute to programme readiness decisions and cutover planning.

description: At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.  We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.   Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.  Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.  Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.  Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.    What you will do    Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.  Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems. It's about evolving how we build confidence in what we ship. If you're someone who thinks systemically, values learning over blame, and gets energized by meaningful organizational change — we'd love to hear from you. skills, with the ability to produce clear compliance reports  Proficiency in Korean, Japanese, and English (both spoken and written) is required for this role

title: Senior Specialist Reliability (Quality)
description: We are seeking a data-driven and detail-oriented Reliability Quality talent to oversee laboratory operations, drive root cause analysis, and ensure compliance with global semiconductor and automotive standards. Actively participate in the Infineon global RPT standardization matrix to drive continuous improvement and cross-site synergy.  Lead staff training programs and manage competency certification processes to elevate team capabilities.  Drive 5S coordination and change management, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and excellent housekeeping habits. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in 8D methodology, RCCA tools (5 Whys, Fishbone), and core Quality Management tools.

Teradyne Nextest의 Software Engineer는 단순히 프로그램을 만드는 역할이 아닙니다. 반도체가 제대로 동작하는지 검증하는 세계 최고 수준의 테스트 시스템을 소프트웨어로 구현합니다.     하드웨어와 맞닿아 있는 코드를 작성하고, 고객의 요구를 제품으로 구현하며, 시스템·QA·현장 엔지니어들과 함께 복잡한 문제를 해결합니다. 만약 C++ 개발 경험을 바탕으로 하드웨어와 소프트웨어가 만나는 영역에서 성장하고 싶다면, 이 포지션이 좋은 기회가 될 수 있습니다.         이런 일을 합니다    고객 요구사항을 분석하고 기존 소프트웨어 아키텍처에 효과적으로 반영합니다.  글로벌 엔지니어들과 협업하며 차세대 메모리 테스트 솔루션 개발에 참여합니다.  신규 제품을 위한 프로그램 및 라이브러리를 설계하고 개발합니다.  기존 제품의 기능 개선과 유지보수를 수행합니다.  Field Application Engineer 팀과 협업해 고객 문제를 해결하고 제품 경쟁력을 높입니다.  Software QA 팀과 함께 테스트 전략을 수립하고 품질 개선 활동을 진행합니다.  하드웨어와 직접 연동되는 소프트웨어를 개발하고 디버깅합니다.       이런 분을 찾고 있습니다    소프트웨어 개발 경력 3~10년 보유하신 분  C++ 기반 객체지향 설계 및 개발 역량을 보유하신 분  FPGA, ASIC 등 하드웨어와 직접 연동되는 소프트웨어 개발 경험이 있으신 분  Windows 환경 개발 경험이 있으신 분  Microsoft Visual Studio 사용 경험이 있으신 분  Git 등 형상관리 도구 사용 경험이 있으신 분  기술적인 내용을 명확하게 설명하고 협업할 수 있으신 분  스스로 문제를 정의하고 해결해 나갈 수 있으신 분  한국 내 근무가 가능하며 한국어 커뮤니케이션이 원활하신 분  업무상 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분       이런 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋습니다    ATE(Automated Test Equipment) 관련 경험  Advantest V93K 또는 Teradyne UltraFLEX 사용 경험  HBM3, HBM4, HBM4E 등 차세대 메모리 관련 경험  Windows 프로그래밍 경험 (DLL, GUI 등)  Windows Debugger 사용 경험  하드웨어 설계 문서 및 회로도 이해 경험  임베디드 시스템, 마이크로컨트롤러 개발 경험  Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone, Arduino 등 개발 경험  Windows OS Internals 관련 지식  국내 반도체 고객 대응 경험  계측기 제어 및 Instrument 개발 경험       Teradyne에서 얻을 수 있는 경험    글로벌 반도체 산업 최전선에서 일할 수 있습니다.  세계 유수의 반도체 고객들과 협업할 수 있습니다.  소프트웨어와 하드웨어를 모두 이해하는 엔지니어로 성장할 수 있습니다.  미국, 아시아, 유럽 엔지니어들과 협업하며 글로벌 업무 경험을 쌓을 수 있습니다.  차세대 메모리 반도체 기술(HBM 등)에 직접 기여할 수 있습니다.         * 제출 서류 : 영문 이력서 및 국문 경력기술서  * 채용 프로세스 : 서류전형 > 1차 면접 > 2차면접 > 코딩테스트 > 최종면접 > 처우협의 > 합격

title: Integration Test Engineer (all genders) - DE
description: Über Uns  Frequentis Group mit Headquarter in Wien ist ein internationaler Anbieter von Kommunikations- und Informationssystemen für Leitzentralen mit sicherheitskritischen Aufgaben. Weltweit vertrauen bereits über 500 Kunden in rund 150 Ländern mit mehr als 45.000 Arbeitsplätzen unserem KnowHow und langjähriger Erfahrung.  Du willst wissen, womit du es dann zu tun hast? Sieh dir unsere Produkte hier an: Netbroker  und VCX-IP.  Aufgaben    Durchführung von manuellen und automatisierten Softwaretests  Planung und Umsetzung von Teststrategien und Testplänen  Erstellung von Automatisierungsskripten mit dem Frequentis Test Framework (CATS)  Verwaltung und Betreuung der Testsysteme und -umgebungen  Analyse von Anforderungen und Ableitung geeigneter Testfälle  Laufende Optimierung von Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards  Unterstützung des Projektmanagements und Koordination des Testteams  Reporting des Testfortschritts anhand relevanter KPIs    Qualifikationen    Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Testbereich.   Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt auf einem der folgenden Bereiche: Netzwerktechnik, Kommunikationstechnik oder Softwareentwicklung.   Kenntnisse in JAMA und agilen Frameworks sind von Vorteil.   Ausgeprägte technische Fähigkeiten, analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.   Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Netzwerk-Switching und -Routing sowie Betriebssysteme (Cisco- und Red Hat/Linux-Zertifizierungen sind von Vorteil).   Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse notwendig; gute Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil  Bereitschaft zu ca. 10 % Reisetätigkeit.    Unsere Werte  Rund 2.900 Frequentis Mitarbeiter:innen engagieren sich mit ihrer Innovationskraft und Technologieorientierung für eine sichere Welt. Unsere Kultur ist von Fairness und Vertrauen, gegenseitigem Respekt und Wertschätzung geprägt. Als internationales Unternehmen schätzen wir diese Vielfalt und rekrutieren unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Ethnizität, sexueller Orientierung oder Religion. Wir legen Wert auf faire und gute Arbeitsbedingungen, eine optimale Work-Life-Balance und bieten all unseren Mitarbeiter:innen gleiche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dabei setzen wir auf langfristige Arbeitsbeziehungen, um das wertvolle Know-how unserer Mitarbeitenden stabil zu halten.   Benefits   Bei Frequentis zu arbeiten bedeutet, die Welt jeden Tag sicherer zu machen, langfristige Karrieremöglichkeiten zu haben und von zahlreichen Benefits zu profitieren. Dazu zählen unter anderem ein Arbeitszeitmodell, das auf Vertrauen basiert, die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten, die Auswahl von IT-Equipment, ein Öffi-Ticket für Wien oder ein Parkplatz nach Verfügbarkeit, unser Lunch Bonus im Office, die Möglichkeit eines Sabbaticals, ein umfassendes Onboarding-Programm und zahlreiche Programme zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung. Noch MEHR Benefits finden Sie auf unserer Karrierewebsite.  VERTRAUENS BETRIEBS HOME OFFICE / MODERNES ÖFFI TICKET / MENTORING AUS- UND  FITNE

title: QA QC- MEP
description: The Role   You will govern MEP quality - mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC and firefighting - Across the full programme lifecycle. Your mandate is audit and final approval, not first-line inspection. The CSC reviews and inspects first; you review the CSC.      Key Responsibilities    Audit the CSC's and Contractor's MEP quality systems against project specifications, codes and standards both off-site (factory) and on-site.  Review and give final PMC approval of ITPs and Method Statements for each MEP activity following the CSC's first-line check; confirm they are in place before works commence.  Conduct surveillance audits and spot checks across MEP installations - ducting, pipework, drainage, firefighting, LV electrical distribution, containment, cabling and earthing.  Review MIR and WIR records at hold and witness points; audit that the CSC witnessed and closed them correctly; rely on them as the basis for final approval.  Review testing and commissioning records: pressure and leak tests, duct and air-tightness tests, air-balancing, flushing, insulation resistance, continuity and functional performance tests.  Review and give final acceptance of FAT records before each module ships and SAT records once installed.  Govern the NCR and SOR process; audit trends across CSC logs; verify corrective actions are tracked through to close-out.  Issue final approval of MARs after the CSC's first-line review; audit calibration, storage and protection controls.  Review PQDs for MEP subcontractors and vendors; give final PMC approval of their quality controls before acceptance onto the works.  Manage MEP quality KPIs and dashboards; report performance and recurring trends to the QA/QC Manager.  Review as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties and training records; govern Defects Liability Period close-out; issue final quality acceptance for Client endorsement.       What We Are Looking For    Bachelor's degree or diploma in mechanical, electrical or a related engineering discipline.  6–8 years of MEP QA/QC experience on building or infrastructure works, with demonstrable experience auditing and governing a quality system - not purely first-line site inspection.  ISO 9001 Internal Auditor certification is required; ISO 9001 Lead Auditor is preferred.  Practical command of ITPs, surveillance auditing and NCR management.  Sound knowledge of MEP testing and commissioning and related acceptance records.  Working knowledge of applicable MEP standards and the Saudi Building Code (SBC).  Experience with modular, precast or DfMA/off-site construction is a distinct advantage; a manufacturing or fabrication-shop QA/QC background counts toward it.  Proficiency with document control and quality platforms such as Aconex and AutoCAD; a commissioning or quality dashboard platform is an advantage. title: Director, Quality
description: Job Description   The Business Unit Quality Director is responsible for leading all quality performance, execution, and results within an assigned Business Unit. This role ensures that quality is fully integrated into daily manufacturing operations, driving measurable improvements in product quality, operational performance, and customer satisfaction. title: Senior Quality Specialist
description: Job Purpose   Lead deep-dive data analysis and root-cause analysis for an assigned domain (either Partners/Restaurant or Logistics/Drivers). Contribute to improvements in automated decision and service logic thresholds and accuracy with Technology and Product, so outcomes are correct by default.  Ensure correct data attribution and integrity; maintain domain baselines and dashboards.  Mentor and review the work of the Data Analysis Specialist and support the Supervisor on target-setting. Requirements    Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, Business or a related field.  3+ years in data or business analytics, delivering insights that drove measurable action.  Background in FMCG, food delivery, q-commerce or retail. Domain exposure to restaurant operations OR logistics/last-mile is a strong plus.  Solid understanding of customer-experience and satisfaction drivers; comfortable balancing cost-efficiency with CSAT, retention and loyalty.  Strong SQL (must-have); advanced Excel/Google Sheets; hands-on with a BI tool; comfortable with large transactional datasets.  Structured RCA methods; basics of experiment / A-B and pilot design; Python or R for analysis is a plus.  English required

Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention.   • Navigate complex approval cycles with large enterprise customers without losing the story or the relationship. 

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in customer marketing, customer advocacy, or a closely related field within enterprise software or SaaS.

title: Product Marketing
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your missio

title: Full-Stack Developer / App / AI (m/w/d)
description:
Bei der Factory Innovations GmbH entwickeln und skalieren wir moderne digitale Wachstumssysteme für ambitionierte Konsumentenmarken. Für unsere Partnerschaft mit dem führenden Handelsunternehmen im ganzheitlichen E-Commerce und stationären Retail bauen wir Produkt und Plattform in-house — und suchen eine:n Entwickler:in, der/die aus Konzepten eigenständig funktionale, shipbare Software macht.

Aufgaben

Als Entwickler:in verantwortest du Produkt-Engineering end-to-end: Headless-Storefront auf Shopify, native Apps für iOS und Android, Backend- und Datenarchitektur inklusive Anbindung an CRM und weitere Systeme sowie AI-Agents für B2C-Anwendungsfälle.

Du überführst CI-, UI/UX-Clickdummies und Prototypen weitgehend selbstständig in funktionale, shipbare Software — von der ersten Idee bis zum Deployment.

Qualifikation

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse.
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Full-Stack- / Software-Entwickler:in mit shipbaren Produkten.
  • Erfahrung mit Headless Shopify (Storefront API, Hydrogen o. Ä.).
  • Erfahrung in der App-Entwicklung für iOS und Android (nativ oder cross-platform, z. B. React Native / Flutter).
  • Fundiertes Verständnis von Backend-Entwicklung, APIs, Datenarchitektur und Integrationen (CRM, Tracking, Payment).
  • Erfahrung im Bauen von AI-Agents / LLM-basierten Anwendungen, idealerweise im B2C.
  • Fähigkeit, aus Clickdummies, Prototypen und CI/UI/UX eigenständig funktionale Software zu bauen.

Benefits

  • Eine seltene Gelegenheit, eine große europäische Sport-Retail-Marke technologisch mitzugestalten und zu modernisieren.
  • Hohe technische Ownership über Storefront, Apps, Datenarchitektur und AI.
  • Ein modernes Tech-Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen und Raum für eigene Entscheidungen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit ambitionierten Kreativen, Strateg:innen und Operator:innen.
  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket.

title: Payroll Specialist (m/w/d)
description:
Consultia Unternehmensgruppe.
Beratung macht den Unterschied.

Seit fast 20 Jahren betreut die Consultia Unternehmensgruppe anspruchsvolle Mandate in allen wirtschaftlichen und steuerlichen Fragen – national wie international. Über 40 Mitarbeitende an vier Standorten entwickeln passgenaue Lösungen für den gehobenen Mittelstand.

Digitale Prozesse, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben.
Ihre Tätigkeiten in der Lohnbuchhaltung.

Statt monotoner Routinen erwarten Sie spannende Aufgaben und die Chance, die Zukunft der Lohnabrechnung mitzugestalten – weg vom reinen Abrechnen, hin zu Beratung, smarten Prozessoptimierung und echtem Mehrwert für unsere Mandanten.

  • Eigenständige Erstellung und Abwicklung von Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen
  • Ansprechpartner für unsere Mandanten in lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen
  • Mitwirken an der Weiterentwicklung und Automatisierung unserer digitalen Prozesse
  • Optional: Unterstützung bei angrenzenden buchhalterischen Themen

title: Projektmitarbeiter Außendienst (m/w/d)
description:
Sie sind gerne unterwegs, arbeiten selbstständig und möchten projektbezogen tätig sein?

Dann unterstützen Sie uns bei regionalen Prüfeinsätzen.

Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, vorgegebene Standorte anzufahren und dort eine kurze Dokumentation durchzuführen.

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgabe:

  • prüfen, ob ein Standort geöffnet oder geschlossen ist,
  • prüfen, ob in den Räumen Musik abgespielt wird,
  • Dokumentation ihre Feststellungen direkt über eine Smartphone-App einschließlich weniger Fotos.

Die Prüfung eines Standortes dauert in der Regel nur wenige Minuten.

Je nach Region liegen mehrere Standorte fußläufig beieinander oder werden mit dem Auto oder Roller im Rahmen einer Route angefahren.

Wir suchen insbesondere Personen, die mehrere Stunden oder ganze Tage unterwegs sein können. Deshalb ist diese Stelle in Vollzeit/Teilzeit sowohl in Festanstellung als auch freie Mitarbeit verfügbar.

Bei Einsätzen im ländlichen Raum ist ein eigenes Fahrzeug (Pkw oder Roller) erforderlich.

Qualifikation

Voraussetzungen

  • Führerschein Klasse B
  • eigenes Fahrzeug (PKW oder Roller)
  • Smartphone
  • Zuverlässigkeit
  • selbstständige Arbeitsweise

Benefits

Wir bieten

  • flexible Einsatzplanung
  • regionale oder bundesweite Projekte
  • mehrtägige Einsätze möglich
  • Fahrtkostenerstattung nach Vereinbarung
  • langfristige Zusammenarbeit möglich

title: Software Engineer (m/f/d) – Perception
description:
At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms.

As a Software Engineer - Perception, you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments.

Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop perception software for autonomous Drone Port operation.

  • Design and implement computer vision algorithms for precision landing, docking and localisation.

  • Integrate cameras and additional perception sensors into the Drone Port software stack.

  • Develop software for sensor processing, calibration and data synchronization.

  • Improve robustness of perception algorithms under varying environmental conditions.

  • Support the integration of perception components into the overall autonomy architecture.

  • Analyse test data and continuously improve perception performance based on field results.

enyo baut das Energiemanagement fürs Zuhause. Ein Gerät, das im Haus steht und PV-Anlage, Batteriespeicher, Wärmepumpe und Wallbox miteinander verbindet, unabhängig davon, von welchem Hersteller sie sind. Es entscheidet laufend, welches Gerät wann wie viel Strom bekommt: Speicher laden, wenn Sonne da ist oder der Strom günstig ist, Wärmepumpe hochfahren, wenn es sich lohnt. Der Kunde steckt das Gerät an und muss sich um nichts weiter kümmern.

Der schwierige Teil daran: Jeder Hersteller spricht sein eigenes Protokoll und alles muss zuverlässig und lokal auf einem kleinen Gerät laufen. Genau daran arbeitest du.

Dan zit je hier helemaal goed. Grote dingen maken ze hier met millimeterwerk. In de maakkamer ontstaan onderdelen die gebouwen comfortabeler, energiezuiniger en slimmer maken.   Vertel verder…   De optimale omgevingstemperatuur ligt tussen de 18 °C en 21 °C. Maar om die temperatuur stabiel en energiezuinig te houden, is meer nodig dan alleen een thermostaat. Achter de schermen zorgen slimme hydronische systemen ervoor dat druk, doorstroming en warmteverdeling perfect op elkaar zijn afgestemd. Dat vraagt om techniek die tot in detail klopt.  Deze organisatie ontwikkelt voor klanten die geen concessies doen aan kwaliteit. Comfort moet vanzelfsprekend zijn, zonder onnodig energieverlies. Of het nu gaat om een groot utiliteitsgebouw of een complexe installatie: niets gaat de deur uit zonder uitgebreide tests en harde validatie. Prestaties worden gemeten, grenzen opgezocht en verbeteringen doorgevoerd. Simpel gezegd: techniek moet hier feilloos functioneren en daarom wordt alles eerst tot het uiterste getest.   En mijn rol dan?   Als Test Engineer test jij nieuwe en bestaande producten tot het uiterste en zorg je dat alles aantoonbaar klopt. Je stelt testprotocollen op, voert tests uit en vertaalt resultaten naar heldere rapportages. Testopstellingen beheer en optimaliseer je continu, waarbij je automatisering slim inzet. Zie je dat iets beter, sneller of nauwkeuriger kan? Dan onderneem je direct actie.  Je stemt intern testtrajecten af en coördineert waar nodig externe tests. Je analyseert resultaten, signaleert knelpunten en zet bevindingen om in concrete verbeteringen voor productontwikkeling. Wat je ontdekt deel je actief met het team, zodat je niet alleen de producten maar ook de organisatie versterkt.   Ik wil het, maar kan ik het ook?   Wij hebben er vertrouwen in dat jij dit kunt! Je hebt een hbo-diploma in Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of Elektrotechniek en al een paar jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol. Je werkt gestructureerd en zelfstandig en hebt kennis van materialen, constructieprincipes en productontwikkeling. CE-richtlijnen en internationale normen zijn voor jou bekend terrein en je kunt programmeren in Python om testopstellingen te verbeteren en te automatiseren.  Lean-principes spreken je aan en je zoekt continu naar slimmere manieren van werken. Analytisch, nauwkeurig en kritisch op je eigen werk, zo sta jij bekend. Engels beheers je goed, dus ook internationaal schakel je soepel. Mis je nog een specifieke norm of detail? Met jouw technische basis en drive heb je dat hier zo onder de knie.   Maar wat komt er binnen?   Laten we het concreet maken. Je bruto jaarsalaris ligt tussen €52.000 en €70.000, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Daarnaast krijg je 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen op fulltime basis, met arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de CAO Metalektro

title: Test Engineer
description: Van schakelkast naar zekerheid: jij zorgt dat alles werkt zoals het hoort.   Bij TELE besturingstechniek bouwen we besturingspanelen die het hart vormen van uiteenlopende machines en industriële installaties. Als  Test Engineer  ben jij degene die controleert of alles technisch klopt voordat zo’n paneel de deur uitgaat. Je test, meet, analyseert en lost technische vraagstukken op. Een functie voor iemand die graag met techniek bezig is, kritisch kijkt en pas tevreden is als het werkt.      Over TELE besturingstechniek   TELE besturingstechniek ontwerpt en bouwt besturingspanelen en schakelkasten voor machinebouw en industrie. We combineren maatwerk met seriematige productie en werken voor klanten die hoge eisen stellen aan kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en doorlooptijd.  Als onderdeel van de Host Group bouwen we aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de volgende fase: schaalbaar, professioneel ingericht en toekomstbestendig, zonder het vakmanschap uit het oog te verliezen.      De functie   Voor onze testafdeling zijn wij op zoek naar een nauwkeurige en technisch gedreven  Test Engineer . In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het testen en controleren van onze hoogwaardige besturingspanelen voordat deze naar onze klanten gaan.  Je werkt binnen een professionele omgeving waarin kwaliteit centraal staat. Samen met jouw collega’s van de testafdeling zorg je ervoor dat ieder paneel voldoet aan de gestelde eisen en regelgeving, waaronder IEC- en UL/CSA-normen.  Als Test Engineer ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen engineering, productie en de klant. Je voert zelfstandig testen uit, signaleert afwijkingen en overlegt met engineers en monteurs wanneer er onduidelijkheden of technische uitdagingen ontstaan.      Jouw rol    Uitvoeren van visuele en elektrische testen aan diverse soorten besturingspanelen.  Controleren of panelen voldoen aan technische specificaties, kwaliteitseisen en relevante regelgeving (IEC/UL-CSA).  Uitvoeren van controles volgens testprocedures en vastleggen van resultaten.  Opstellen van duidelijke testrapporten en documentatie.  Signaleren en bespreken van afwijkingen met engineers en monteurs.  Meedenken over technische oplossingen en verbeteringen binnen het productie- en testproces.  Zorgdragen voor een kwalitatief eindproduct dat voldoet aan de verwachtingen van onze klanten.  Samenwerken met collega’s binnen de testafdeling en andere disciplines binnen TELE besturingstechniek.       Wij zoeken iemand die    Een elektrotechnische achtergrond heeft en beschikt over technisch inzicht.  Ervaring heeft met het testen van besturingspanelen (pré).  Technische tekeningen, mechanische tekeningen en E-schema’s kan lezen en interpreteren.  Systematisch en nauwkeurig kan werken.  Zelfstandig werkzaamheden kan uitvoeren en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het resultaat.  Oplossingsgericht denkt en technische uitdagingen niet uit de weg gaat.  Communicatief sterk is en gemakkelijk overlegt met collega’s van verschillende afdelingen

title: Software Test Engineer, Lund
description: Job Title   Software Test Engineer, Lund   Job Description    AXIS OS Platform Test is looking for a Test Engineer to join our Connected Device Test team. You'll work on-site at our headquarters in Lund together with an experienced team, using modern test automation frameworks, advanced test management systems, and state-of-the-art test environments.    Who is your future team?   The AXIS OS Platform Test team is responsible for testing the software that powers Axis video products. By ensuring the quality of AXIS OS, we help deliver the reliable, secure, and high-performing products that customers around the world depend on.  AXIS OS is the Linux-based operating system used in most of your Axis network devices. It is purpose-built to meet the high standards required for network devices including cybersecurity, ease of integration, quality, and long-term value.  We are an experienced team made up of junior and senior test engineers who enjoy solving problems together and sharing knowledge. What makes our team special is how we combine deep technical expertise with an open, collaborative, and supportive culture.  The team is part of the R&D Quality Assurance organization. Our QA organization includes 20 teams across five departments. Today, we're more than 300 people, making us one of the largest test organizations in the region. We have a close-knit team culture, both within our team and across the department, and we're always looking for ways to improve how we work and test our software.  Want to learn more? Listen to an interview with our QA team: Axis communications - Meet Quality Assurance  If you're passionate about software testing and quality assurance, you will enjoy it here!   What You’ll Do Here As a Test Engineer   You'll collaborate closely with other Test Engineers to test new features, products, and applications as well as ensure high software quality. You'll help ensure our software meets the required quality standards before every release. You will work in close partnership with developers and product managers. Your ability to communicate, bridge gaps between teams, and build consensus is just as important as your technical scripting skills. You'll also have a mentor during your first months to help you settle into the role, learn our AXIS OS, and get familiar with our testing processes. title: Software Developer Engineer in Test (SDET)
description: ¿Quiénes somos?      Somos  Kairós , una empresa de tecnología diferente. Sí, ayudamos a nuestros clientes con sus retos de transformación digital y metodológica, pero lo que realmente nos define es  cómo lo hacemos : poniendo a las personas en el centro.     Hemos sido reconocidos como  Empresa Great Place To Work  desde 2019 por sexto año consecutivo, ocupando el  5º lugar en 2024 . Nuestros valores de  valentía, empatía, innovación y alegría  son la forma en que trabajamos cada día. Somos más de 850 personas (desarrolladores, ingenieros de datos, estrategas...) y ahora buscamos a alguien que se sume a este equipo brillante y diverso.     En Kairós no eres un número más. Te conocemos por tu nombre, nos importa tu equilibrio personal y queremos que crezcas con nosotros.      Tu misión en Kairós      Buscamos a un Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) apasionado y con un perfil altamente técnico que se una a nuestro área de R&D.     No buscamos un QA ni un desarrollador al uso: tu misión no será mantener los servidores vivos, sino programar código desde cero que "engañe" al sistema (simulando hardware y entornos AWS/Kafka) para que los equipos de desarrollo puedan validar el firmware de dispositivos y alarmas en un entorno virtualizado y eficiente.       Desarrollo de Emuladores:  Diseñarás y evolucionarás un software emulador en  Python  para simular dispositivos periféricos de seguridad (sensores, cámaras, detectores de humo) comunicados por túneles TCP, sustituyendo todo el hardware físico de RF en el entorno de CI.   Construcción de Servidores Fake:  Crearás y mantendrás servidores simulados (Configuration, FOTA, Media y simuladores de protocolos de Backend) aplicando inyección de fallos para realizar pruebas negativas avanzadas.   Orquestación de Pruebas (Test Machine):  Liderarás el motor de orquestación BDD basado en  Python  y  Behave/Gherkin , integrándolo directamente con  Jenkins CI  y reportando los resultados automáticamente a  Jira X-Ray .   Infraestructura de Pruebas Next-Gen:  Simularás flujos de  AWS IoT Core , mensajería con  Apache Kafka / MSK  e interacciones con Digital Twins para la validación del firmware de las unidades centrales.   Integración Continua:  Integrarás de manera orgánica todos estos componentes dentro de pipelines multi-stage en  Jenkins , abarcando análisis estático, unit testing, compilaciones en entornos virtuales ( Qemu ) y suites de regresión.   Innovación con Inteligencia Artificial:  Aplicarás generación de código asistida por  LLMs , detección de anomalías y triaje inteligente de fallos para acelerar los tiempos de ejecución y la cobertura.   Calidad de Código Excepcional:  Asegurarás el cumplimiento estricto de estándares de desarrollo de software limpio ( SOLID / KISS / DRY ) en toda la base de código de pruebas.       Qué te hará tener éxito       Formación y Experiencia        Experiencia demostrada:  Entre  3 y 6 años de experiencia  (idealmente en torno a los 4 años) desempeñando

description: About The Team & Mission   Quality Assurance Engineer (Power Management)는 SDV 기반 차량 환경에서 PMS/BMS 등 차량 전원 제어 소프트웨어의 통합 검증을 수행하며, PowerNet(48V/12V) 및 CAN/LIN 기반 통신 환경의 안정성과 품질을 검증하는 역할을 담당합니다. 차량 전원 관리 시스템의 기능, 성능, Fail-safe 동작 등을 평가하고, 통합 테스트 벤치 기반 검증을 통해 SDV 전원 시스템의 신뢰성과 품질 완성도를 확보합니다. 또한 전력 제어 소프트웨어와 차량 네트워크 간 연동 안정성을 분석하고 지속적인 품질 개선 활동을 수행하여 안정적인 차량 전원 시스템 운영을 지원합니다. Qualifications     5년 이상의 자동차 PMS(Power Management System) 기능/성능 평가 업무 경험을 보유하신 분  자동차 BMS(Battery Management System)에 대한 높은 이해를 보유하신 분  자동차 PowerNet(48V, 12V) 및 CAN, LIN 통신에 대한 이해가 있으신 분  자동차 평가 로그 데이터 분석 및 Fail-safe 관련 경험을 보유신 분  Agile 프로세스와 CI/CD 환경에서 검증 경험이 있으신 분  최신 기술에 관심이 많고 변화에 유연하게 대처할 수 있는 역량을 가지신 분     Preferred Qualifications     임베디드 개발환경에서의 프로그래밍 언어(C/C++, Python, Rust 등)에 대한 높은 이해  클라우드 환경(AWS, Azure 등)에서의 소프트웨어 품질 관리 업무 경험  A-SPICE 또는 ISO-26262, ISO-21434 적용 경험  LLM을 이용한 검증 업무 자동화 경험

title: Head of Quality and Regulatory Affairs
description: Giving Clinicians the Full Picture   Ounas Health is a Finnish health-tech startup building the tools clinicians need to actually see what's going on with their patients — not fragments spread across ten systems, but one coherent view: imaging, EMR data, biometrics, clinical guidelines, all in one view. We're starting in eye care and building towards the rest of healthcare.     We're less than a year old, funded, and moving fast. Small team, high trust, real ownership from day one. Our founders have built and sold health-tech companies before, and they're putting that experience to work here.      The Role   We are looking for our first dedicated quality and regulatory professional to build and lead the quality and regulatory capability at Ounas Health.     As the   Head of Quality and Regulatory Affairs   your purpose is to enable Ounas Health to enter and remain in its target markets — currently the EU and the UK — safely, compliantly, and as efficiently as possible. This includes establishing a practical and scalable quality management system, guiding regulatory strategy, and embedding regulatory requirements into everyday product development.     Ounas develops both medical device and non-medical software, often within the same teams and development flow. One of the central challenges of the role is to create a way of working that applies the full regulatory discipline where it is required and stays out of the way where it is not. We do not want two disconnected development models, nor do we want unnecessary medical-device processes applied across everything we build.     This is a Head role because you will own the capability and have direct access to company management — not because you will inherit a ready-made function or a large team. At least initially, this is a highly hands-on position: you will define the approach, create and maintain documentation, support product teams, prepare audits, and work directly with external regulatory parties.     We want regulatory requirements to be built into how products are developed, so that compliance becomes a natural outcome of normal work rather than a separate activity. Done badly, quality management becomes bureaucracy. Done well, it helps the company make sound decisions, develop safer products, and demonstrate why those products can be trusted.     At our current stage, the goal is not theoretical perfection. It is a sufficient, effective, and scalable system that materially supports safety, compliance, and market access.      What Head of Quality & Regulatory Affairs Will Do at Ounas Health    Build, maintain, and continuously improve our quality management system in accordance with ISO 13485 and the EU MDR.  Establish pragmatic quality and regulatory practices that integrate into product development and scale with the company.  Own our EU and UK regulatory strategy, including product qualification and classification, conformity assessment routes, and cooperation with external regul

Kommunicera muntligt och skriftligt med externa parter som tex myndigheter och kunder. Planera och ta emot externa revisioner samt driva förbättringsarbete kopplat till avvikelser och nya krav. Följa upp, analysera och rapportera kvalitetsresultat till Kvalitetschefen.  Planera, genomföra och följa upp interna revisioner som revisionsledare.     Du tillhör kvalitetsavdelningen och jobbar på uppdrag från din lokala Kvalitetschef, som du också rapporterar till. Rollen innebär inget personalansvar.   Din profil   Vi söker en strukturerad, noggrann och självgående person som trivs med stort eget ansvar. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, så du är skicklig på att samarbeta och driva frågor självständigt, samt bekväm med att följa upp och utmana beslut när det behövs.  Du har ett genuint intresse för att analysera och omsätta regelverk i praktiken. Som person är du en pedagogisk kommunikatör som uttrycker dig obehindrat i tal och skrift, med en stark förmåga att förvandla komplexa krav till tydlig och användbar dokumentation. title: Quality Manager
description: Quality Manager    Up to £50,000 DOE   Yolk Recruitment are supporting an established South Wales manufacturer with the recruitment of a Quality Manager. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced quality professional looking to take ownership of the quality function within an established manufacturing business.  Working closely with production, engineering, customers and suppliers, you'll have overall responsibility for quality assurance across the business, ensuring products and processes consistently meet customer, regulatory and industry standards. You'll lead the existing Quality team, manage quality systems and audits, drive corrective actions and continuous improvement, and play a key role in developing the company's approach to quality as the business continues to grow.   As a Quality Manager, you'll be responsible for:    Taking overall responsibility for the Quality function across the manufacturing business.  Leading and developing the existing Quality team.  Ensuring products consistently meet customer specifications, regulatory requirements and internal quality standards.  Working closely with customers and suppliers to understand quality requirements and resolve quality issues.  Leading quality assurance activities throughout the product lifecycle, from design through to production and launch.  Managing internal and external quality audits and ensuring continued compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and customer-specific requirements.  Driving root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions to ensure quality issues are effectively resolved and not repeated.  Working closely with Production and Engineering to identify and implement improvements across processes.  Developing and improving quality systems, processes and procedures across the business.  Ensuring quality issues and corrective actions are effectively communicated between departments.    This is what you'll need:    Proven experience in a Quality Manager, Quality Lead or Senior Quality Engineering role within a manufacturing environment.  Strong knowledge of quality systems, auditing, corrective action and root cause analysis.  Strong communication skills, with the confidence to work with customers, suppliers and internal teams.    And this is what you'll get:    Competitive salary.  Opportunity to take ownership of the Quality function  Early finish on Fridays  A varied, hands-on role with direct influence across the manufacturing operation

title: Quality Manager
description: Join us as a  Quality Manager , where your work ensures that advanced robotics systems meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and compliance.     At Origin Robotics, quality is built into every stage of development- from incoming components to field-ready systems. In this role, you'll help ensure our products perform reliably in demanding real-world environments while supporting technologies that strengthen Europe's security and defense.     This is an opportunity to shape quality processes, drive continuous improvement, and contribute to mission-critical innovation.      What You'll Do:     Quality Control:  Oversee inspections of incoming parts and assembled drones, implement in-process checks, manage non-conformities, and maintain calibration of testing equipment.   Quality Assurance:  Develop and maintain a QMS aligned with ISO 9001, AS9100, and EU Regulation 2019/945. Ensure product compliance with EASA, CAA Latvia, CE, STANAG, and MIL-STD requirements. Lead audits, process improvements, and staff training.   Issue Management:  Drive root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, warranty investigations, and transparent reporting of quality issues to stakeholders and regulators.   Collaboration:  Work closely with engineering, production, supply chain, regulators, and customers to embed quality into every stage of design, production, and certification.       What We are Looking For:    Degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or related field.  Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 (knowledge of AS9100, EU Regulation 2019/945,  EASA Part 21, CE marking requirements, STANAG, MIL-STD will be seen as benefit).  Previous experience in aerospace, UAV, or high-tech manufacturing.  Expertise in root cause analysis, FMEA, Six Sigma.  Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills       What We Offer:    The opportunity to work on defence robotics systems that are deployed in real-world environments and matter to those who rely on them  Interesting technical challenges and work on complex engineering problems  Work on best-in-class products that compete internationally, alongside leading experts in the field  The chance to own your work from development through to field deployment  Opportunities to learn, grow and develop while working with modern technologies  Health insurance
